tmdb_overview_en: The house of the director has a door out to the sidewalk. This gate separates the inside from the outside. The interior contains the filmmaker's personal story and his world of objects, thoughts and imaginations. Outer space contains the city of Santiago de Chile. The stories of the world inside the house are interrupted when the doorbell rings unknown and thus come into the film.
synopsis_en: Screened in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2013. Won the Award of Excellence.

tmdb_overview_jp: ペンシルベニア州西部の小さな町で暮らす79歳のミルトンは認知症の初期症状を娘に心配されながらも、受け入れられずに一人暮らしを続けていた。そんなある夜、庭に突如、空から正体不明の飛行物体が墜落し、彼の静かな日常は大きく揺らぎ始める。 周囲に訴えても相手にされない中、同年代の隣人サンディーとジョイスだけが共に飛行物体を目撃し3人は秘密を共有することに。それぞれの孤独を抱えていた3人は忘れかけていた人生の喜びを取り戻し、やがて自らの“これからの人生”と向き合っていく——。
tmdb_overview_en: A flying saucer lands in the backyard of an elderly suburbanite with memory problems, who forms a bond with the scared alien inside.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: A human drama starring the acclaimed actor Ben Kingsley, humorously depicting a lonely elderly man who, after getting caught up in a bizarre commotion with his neighbors, rediscovers the joy of life. Milton, a 79-year-old man living in a small town in western Pennsylvania, continues to live alone despite his daughter Denise worrying about his early symptoms of dementia. One night, an unidentified flying object from the sky crashes into Milton's yard, shaking his peaceful daily life. When no one around him takes him seriously, Milton shares the secret of the flying object with his neighbors Sandy and Joyce, who are around his age and also witnessed it. The three, each carrying their own loneliness, rediscover the forgotten joys of life and face their futures. Harriet Sansom Harris ("The Bodybuilder") plays Sandy, Jane Curtin ("Coneheads") plays Joyce, and Zoe Winters (series "Succession") plays Milton's daughter Denise. The director is Mark Turtletaub, known as a producer for "Little Miss Sunshine" and "Loving."

director: ムハンマド・サウワーフ
country: パレスチナ・日本合作 原題または英題：Voices from Gaza
synopsis: 断片的なニュース映像やSNS動画だけでは見えてこない、2025年現在のパレスチナ・ガザ地区の現実と、そこに生きる人々の声を世界に伝えるドキュメンタリー・プロジェクト「ガザからの声」の第2弾。 ミュージシャンであり、5人の子どもを育てる父親でもあるアハマド・アブ＝アムシャは、ガザ北部のベイトハヌーンに住んでいたが、戦争が始まってから12回もの避難を強いられてきた。2025年1月の停戦発表を受けてベイトハヌーンへ戻ったものの、自宅と音楽スタジオは瓦礫と化していた。同年3月、再び戦闘が始まり避難生活を続ける中、アハマドは音楽で人々の心を支えようと決意。仲間の音楽家とともに子どもたちへ楽器や歌を教え、戦争の不安を和らげる活動を始める。音楽は彼にとって戦争への一種の抵抗であり、世界に声を届ける最も強い方法でもある。アハマドは世界中の芸術家たちへ「不正義に沈黙することは加担だ」とのメッセージを伝え、多くの子どもたちに音楽で喜びを届けることを目標に、今も音楽を奏で続けている。 ガザに拠点を置く映像制作会社アレフ・マルチメディアと東京の映画配給会社アップリンクによる共同プロジェクトで、現地での取材をアレフが行い、編集・配信・劇場公開をアップリンクが担当する。劇場とオンラインで同時に公開される。
movie_title_jp: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
tmdb_overview_en: Ahmad Abu-Amsha is a musician and father of five living through the upheaval of war in Gaza. After repeated displacement, he returned to find his home and music studio reduced to rubble. Seeking a way to help children cope with fear and uncertainty, Ahmad began working with fellow musicians to teach them songs and instruments in a displacement camp. He believes music can offer moments of relief and serve as a powerful way to communicate with the world. This documentary follows his efforts to keep music and hope alive amid continuing hardship.

director_jp: ムハンマド・サウワーフ
synopsis_en: The second installment of "Voices from Gaza," a documentary project that brings to the world the reality of the Gaza Strip in 2025 and the voices of those living there—truths that remain hidden behind fragmented news clips and social media videos. Ahmad Abu-Amsha, a musician and father of five, lived in Beit Hanoun in northern Gaza but has been forced to evacuate 12 times since the start of the war. Following a ceasefire announcement in January 2025, he returned to Beit Hanoun only to find his home and music studio reduced to rubble. In March of the same year, as fighting resumed and his life of displacement continued, Ahmad resolved to support the spirits of his community through music. Alongside fellow musicians, he began teaching instruments and song to children to help ease the anxieties of war. For him, music is a form of resistance and the most powerful way to project his voice to the world. Sending a message to artists worldwide that "silence in the face of injustice is complicity," Ahmad continues to play, aiming to bring joy to as many children as possible. This film is a joint project between Gaza-based production company Aleph Multimedia and Tokyo-based distributor Uplink; Aleph conducted the local filming and reporting, while Uplink handled editing, distribution, and the theatrical release. The film will be released simultaneously in theaters and online.

movie_title: わたしの知らない子どもたち
country: 日本
synopsis: 「すばらしき世界」「永い言い訳」の西川美和が原案・脚本・監督を務め、戦後の日本で家族を失い社会からこぼれ落ちた子どもたちを題材に描いたドラマ。 戦争で家族と日常を奪われた12歳の少女・琴子は、生き延びるため自らの性別を隠し、少年として生きることを選ぶ。進駐軍相手の慰安施設や路上売春が広がるなか、少女であること自体が危険となる現実から逃れるための決断だった。音楽家の父のもとで穏やかに暮らしていた琴子の人生は戦争と敗戦によって一変し、「自分自身を手放す」という過酷な選択を迫られる。一方、かつて琴子が疎開していた学校の教師・曽根は、戦時中は軍国主義教育に加担した側だったが、敗戦により信念も立場も失い、過去の責任と向き合いながら生きることを余儀なくされる。 12歳の琴子役には、オーディションで約500人の中から選ばれた小八重葵美を抜擢。二階堂ふみが女性教師・曽根役を務め、竹野内豊、櫻井海音、花瀬琴音が脇を固める。「国宝」で数々の賞を受賞した作曲家・原摩利彦が音楽を手がけ、劇中にも音楽家役でカメオ出演。「ゴジラ－1.0」で第96回アカデミー賞視覚効果賞に輝いた映像制作プロダクション「白組」がVFXを担い、1945年の街並みをリアルに再現した。

tmdb_overview_en: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.

movie_title_original: わたしの知らない子どもたち
synopsis_en: A drama written, planned, and directed by Miwa Nishikawa of "Under the Open Sky" and "The Long Excuse," depicting children who lost their families and fell through the cracks of society in postwar Japan. Kotoko, a 12-year-old girl who lost her family and daily life to the war, chooses to hide her gender and live as a boy in order to survive. It was a decision made to escape the reality in which being a girl itself was dangerous, as comfort facilities for occupation forces and street prostitution spread. Kotoko's life, which had been peaceful under her musician father, was transformed by the war and defeat, forcing her to make the harsh choice of "letting go of herself." Meanwhile, Sone, a teacher at the school where Kotoko had once been evacuated, had been complicit in militarist education during the war, but with defeat lost both his beliefs and his position, and is compelled to live while confronting the responsibility of his past. For the role of 12-year-old Kotoko, Aimi Kohachi was selected from approximately 500 candidates through an audition. Fumi Nikaido plays the female teacher Sone, with Yutaka Takenouchi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kotone Hanase rounding out the supporting cast. Composer Marihiko Hara, who won numerous awards for "Kokuho," handles the music and also makes a cameo appearance as a musician in the film. The visual effects production company Shirogumi, which won the Visual Effects award at the 96th Academy Awards for "Godzilla Minus One," handled VFX, realistically recreating the streetscape of 1945.

movie_title: ドッグ・レディ ＜ラウラ・シタレラ監督特集＞
tmdb_overview_en: The protagonist of Dog Lady is a woman (Llinás) who lives on the outskirts of Buenos Aires with a pack of dogs, in a house like so many other humble shacks in the urban sprawl of the city.
synopsis_en: A film directed in 2015 by Laura Citarella, a core member of the Argentine filmmaking collective El Pampero Cine, who gained international attention with her 2022 feature mystery film Trenque Lauquen, screened at the Venice International Film Festival, the San Sebastián International Film Festival, and other festivals around the world. A woman crosses a plain surrounded by many dogs. She lives quietly with ten dogs in a hut she built with her own hands on an empty lot on the outskirts of Buenos Aires. She uses no money, speaks no words — a mysterious woman who seems to have slipped outside of society. On the edges of an uncontrollably sprawling metropolis, there spread worlds where mysteries like her could remain mysteries. Starring Verónica Ginas, an actor and the sister of Mariano Ginas, a filmmaker and screenwriter who is a member of El Pampero Cine, the film was co-directed by Verónica and Citarella at Verónica's suggestion. It had its first Japanese theatrical release as part of the special screening series 'Laura Citarella Retrospective: Resonating Secrets,' held to coincide with the theatrical release of Trenque Lauquen.

director: フレデリック・チェン
country: フランス 原題または英題：Dior et Moi
synopsis: 老舗ブランド「クリスチャン・ディオール」全面協力のもと、オートクチュールの裏側に迫ったドキュメンタリー作品。2012年、空席になっていたディオールのアーティスティックディレクターの座に就任したラフ・シモンズ。自身の男性ブランド「ジル・サンダー」で活躍するシモンズだが、その認知度は低く、オートクチュール界での経験は皆無で、この大抜擢は世界中のファッション関係者を驚かせた。通常のコレクションでは半年近くの準備期間が必要とされている中、ディオールでの最初のコレクションまでに、シモンズに与えられた時間はわずか8週間。限られた時間の中で、世界中が注目するメゾンのコレクションを成功させるため奮闘するデザイナーや職人たちの裏側に密着した。
tmdb_overview_jp: 世界的老舗ファッション・ブランド、クリスチャン・ディオールを巡るドキュメンタリー。本社の上階に位置するアトリエに初めてカメラが潜入し、新任デザイナーとお針子たちが奮闘しながら挑むパリ・コレクションを映していく。
tmdb_overview_en: Behind-the-scenes documentary revealing what goes on inside the colourful, privileged, and sometimes stressful Christian Dior fashion house.
synopsis_en: A documentary that goes behind the scenes of haute couture with the full cooperation of the storied brand Christian Dior. In 2012, Raf Simons took over the vacant position of artistic director at Dior. Though Simons had made his mark with his own menswear brand Jil Sander, his name recognition was low and he had no experience in the world of haute couture, so this bold appointment shocked fashion insiders around the world. While a normal collection requires nearly half a year of preparation, Simons was given only eight weeks before his first Dior collection. The film closely follows the designers and artisans as they struggle behind the scenes to make the maison's collection — watched by the entire world — a success within that limited time.

country: 日本・フランス・シンガポール・フィリピン合作
synopsis: 「淵に立つ」「恋愛裁判」などの深田晃司監督が、松たか子を主演に迎えて撮りあげた人間ドラマ。第39回岸田國士戯曲賞を受賞した平田オリザの代表作「東京ノート」に着想を得て、深田監督自らオリジナル脚本を執筆。「東京ノート」の精神を受け継ぎつつ、岡山県奈義町をモデルにした「ナギ」を舞台に新たな物語を描き、企画の立ち上げから9年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 自然豊かな町・ナギで、ひとり創作に打ち込む彫刻家の寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍する友梨が数日間の休暇をとり、別れた夫の姉である寄子のもとを訪れる。若くして妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみ・好浩、息子の春樹とその親友・圭太など、人々との出会いは穏やかな日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。友梨は寄子の彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで彼女の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨自身にも変化が起こりはじめる。 深田監督とは初タッグとなる松たか子が、癒えない喪失を抱えながら彫刻制作に没頭する寄子という複雑なキャラクターを体現。寄子の彫刻のモデルをつとめる友梨を石橋静河、寄子の幼なじみで役場に勤める好浩を松山ケンイチが演じる。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.

synopsis: 「すばらしき世界」「永い言い訳」の西川美和が原案・脚本・監督を務め、戦後の日本で家族を失い社会からこぼれ落ちた子どもたちを題材に描いたドラマ。 戦争で家族と日常を奪われた12歳の少女・琴子は、生き延びるため自らの性別を隠し、少年として生きることを選ぶ。進駐軍相手の慰安施設や路上売春が広がるなか、少女であること自体が危険となる現実から逃れるための決断だった。音楽家の父のもとで穏やかに暮らしていた琴子の人生は戦争と敗戦によって一変し、「自分自身を手放す」という過酷な選択を迫られる。一方、かつて琴子が疎開していた学校の教師・曽根は、戦時中は軍国主義教育に加担した側だったが、敗戦により信念も立場も失い、過去の責任と向き合いながら生きることを余儀なくされる。 12歳の琴子役には、オーディションで約500人の中から選ばれた小八重葵美を抜擢。二階堂ふみが女性教師・曽根役を務め、竹野内豊、櫻井海音、花瀬琴音が脇を固める。「国宝」で数々の賞を受賞した作曲家・原摩利彦が音楽を手がけ、劇中にも音楽家役でカメオ出演。「ゴジラ－1.0」で第96回アカデミー賞視覚効果賞に輝いた映像制作プロダクション「白組」がVFXを担い、1945年の街並みをリアルに再現した。
movie_title_jp: わたしの知らない子どもたち
tmdb_overview_jp: 12歳で孤児となり“少⼥”を棄てた⼥の⼦と、⽣きるために⽣徒を棄てた教師の再生への物語。
tmdb_overview_en: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.
clean_title_jp: わたしの知らない子どもたち
movie_title_original: わたしの知らない子どもたち
synopsis_en: A drama written, planned, and directed by Miwa Nishikawa of "Under the Open Sky" and "The Long Excuse," depicting children who lost their families and fell through the cracks of society in postwar Japan. Kotoko, a 12-year-old girl who lost her family and daily life to the war, chooses to hide her gender and live as a boy in order to survive. It was a decision made to escape the reality in which being a girl itself was dangerous, as comfort facilities for occupation forces and street prostitution spread. Kotoko's life, which had been peaceful under her musician father, was transformed by the war and defeat, forcing her to make the harsh choice of "letting go of herself." Meanwhile, Sone, a teacher at the school where Kotoko had once been evacuated, had been complicit in militarist education during the war, but with defeat lost both his beliefs and his position, and is compelled to live while confronting the responsibility of his past. For the role of 12-year-old Kotoko, Aimi Kohachi was selected from approximately 500 candidates through an audition. Fumi Nikaido plays the female teacher Sone, with Yutaka Takenouchi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kotone Hanase rounding out the supporting cast. Composer Marihiko Hara, who won numerous awards for "Kokuho," handles the music and also makes a cameo appearance as a musician in the film. The visual effects production company Shirogumi, which won the Visual Effects award at the 96th Academy Awards for "Godzilla Minus One," handled VFX, realistically recreating the streetscape of 1945.

tmdb_overview_jp: ペンシルベニア州西部の小さな町で暮らす79歳のミルトンは認知症の初期症状を娘に心配されながらも、受け入れられずに一人暮らしを続けていた。そんなある夜、庭に突如、空から正体不明の飛行物体が墜落し、彼の静かな日常は大きく揺らぎ始める。 周囲に訴えても相手にされない中、同年代の隣人サンディーとジョイスだけが共に飛行物体を目撃し3人は秘密を共有することに。それぞれの孤独を抱えていた3人は忘れかけていた人生の喜びを取り戻し、やがて自らの“これからの人生”と向き合っていく——。
tmdb_overview_en: A flying saucer lands in the backyard of an elderly suburbanite with memory problems, who forms a bond with the scared alien inside.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: A human drama starring the acclaimed actor Ben Kingsley, humorously depicting a lonely elderly man who, after getting caught up in a bizarre commotion with his neighbors, rediscovers the joy of life. Milton, a 79-year-old man living in a small town in western Pennsylvania, continues to live alone despite his daughter Denise worrying about his early symptoms of dementia. One night, an unidentified flying object from the sky crashes into Milton's yard, shaking his peaceful daily life. When no one around him takes him seriously, Milton shares the secret of the flying object with his neighbors Sandy and Joyce, who are around his age and also witnessed it. The three, each carrying their own loneliness, rediscover the forgotten joys of life and face their futures. Harriet Sansom Harris ("The Bodybuilder") plays Sandy, Jane Curtin ("Coneheads") plays Joyce, and Zoe Winters (series "Succession") plays Milton's daughter Denise. The director is Mark Turtletaub, known as a producer for "Little Miss Sunshine" and "Loving."

country: フランス・イタリア・西ドイツ合作 原題または英題：The Trial
synopsis: 「市民ケーン」「黒い罠」などで映画史に名を刻んだオーソン・ウェルズが、フランツ・カフカの同名小説を映画化し、1962年に発表した不条理ドラマ。身に覚えのない罪で逮捕を告げられた男が、正体の見えない裁判と法の迷宮に巻き込まれていく姿を、悪夢のようなモノクロームの映像世界で描き出す。 ある朝、会社員のヨーゼフ・Kは、自室に現れた警官たちから、理由も告げられぬまま逮捕を宣告される。何の罪に問われているのかもわからないまま、彼は奇妙で不可解な裁判制度の世界へと足を踏み入れていく。法廷、弁護士、看護師、画家、司祭など、ヨーゼフ・Kの前にはさまざまな人が現れるが、助けになるはずの人々はみなどこか曖昧で、かえって迷宮を深めていく。ヨーゼフ・Kはやがて、理不尽な世界に追い詰められていく。 ヨーゼフ・K役を「サイコ」のアンソニー・パーキンス、弁護士役をウェルズ自身が演じ、ジャンヌ・モロー、ロミー・シュナイダーらが共演。ザグレブやローマ、そして当時は使われていなかったパリのオルセー駅などで撮影され、荒廃した駅舎や巨大なオフィス、方向感覚を失わせる空間が、ヨーゼフ・Kの置かれた不条理な世界を視覚化した。2026年9月、デジタル修復を施した4Kレストア版で再公開される。
tmdb_overview_en: At the identification of a dead body, a couple and a morgue employee both claim to be related to the deceased, and therefore the rightful recipient of an indemnity of at least 520,000.
synopsis_en: A drama of the absurd released in 1962, in which Orson Welles—who carved his name into film history with Citizen Kane and Touch of Evil—adapted Franz Kafka's novel of the same name. It depicts a man who is informed of his arrest for a crime he has no memory of committing, drawn into an invisible trial and a labyrinth of law, rendered through a nightmarish black-and-white visual world. One morning, office worker Josef K. is declared under arrest by police officers who appear in his room without being told the reason. Without knowing what crime he is being charged with, he steps into the world of a strange and incomprehensible judicial system. Before Josef K. appear all manner of people—a court, lawyers, a nurse, a painter, a priest—but those who should help him are all somehow ambiguous, only deepening the labyrinth. Josef K. is eventually driven into a corner by an irrational world. Anthony Perkins of Psycho plays Josef K., Welles himself plays the lawyer, and Jeanne Moreau and Romy Schneider co-star. Filmed in Zagreb, Rome, and the then-unused Orsay Station in Paris, the desolate station building, gigantic offices, and disorienting spaces visualize the absurd world in which Josef K. finds himself. In September 2026, it will be re-released in a 4K restored version with digital restoration.

tmdb_overview_en: Macabéa has just moved to the big city after her aunt, who raised her, died. She gets a job as a typist and moves into a boarding house with three other women. In her spare time, she listens to a radio station called Time; on Sundays, she likes to ride the metro. Then she meets Olímpico, a northeasterner like herself, who has dreams of becoming a congressman.
synopsis_en: "I am a typist, a virgin, and I like Coke and hot dogs." Based on the novel by Clarice Lispector, known as 'Brazil's Virginia Woolf,' this film shines with an unforgettable brilliance in the history of Brazilian cinema. After 40 years, it receives its first theatrical release in Japan.

synopsis_en: Ginji, driven from his hometown, returns after ten years... This is a representative work marking the starting point of Tai Kato's unique style, with actors wearing no makeup, low-angle cameras, and simultaneous sound recording.

program_title: 『映画を輝かせるために ー蓮實重彦 山田宏一 山根貞男 映画談義集成』刊行記念特集
tmdb_overview_jp: 厳しい撮影を終えて朝帰りをした、ピンク映画の撮影監督べーやんは、妻の奈津子が自殺を図り、睡眠薬を飲んで死んだように眠り込む姿を発見。慌てて彼女を病院へ運び込み、どうにかことなきを得るが、本来その日は、彼女主演のピンク映画の新作のロケ撮影が始まる当日。やむなく代役を立てて映画の撮影を始めるもうまくいかず、ようやく現場に復帰した奈津子も、やはりもうできない、と言い出して、撮影は混乱を極めることに。
tmdb_overview_en: The melodramatic story of a pink crew’s tragi-comedic adventures on location.  A fictionalized adaptation of set photographer Ichiro Tsuda's 1980 book The Location (Za Rokēshon), an illustrated 229-page document about the cameraman’s experiences with pink cast and crew on the sets of several films produced in the late 1970's.
synopsis_en: Be-yan, a cinematographer for pink films who returns home in the morning after a grueling shoot, discovers his wife Natsuko, who attempted suicide, sleeping as if dead after taking sleeping pills. He hurriedly carries her to the hospital and somehow she pulls through, but that day was supposed to be the first day of location shooting for a new pink film starring her. Unable to do otherwise, he starts filming with a stand-in, but it doesn't go well, and Natsuko, who finally returns to the set, also says she can't do it anymore, throwing the shoot into utter chaos.

country: 日本
synopsis: かいせつ 女好きの会社員とギャンブル好きのOLが借金返済に困り強盗を企てるが―。テレビドラマ「男女７人シリーズ」の演出・脚本・主演で描くラブコメディで、東北・北海道と展開する男女の逃避行はロードムービーとしても見応えあり。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Shohei Taguchi is a salaryman who works for a securities company and loves women like no other. One day, he plans to use the cash borrowed from the gangsters and snatch to repay his debt . However, Sayoko Mukai, who said that she used the money of the company for gambling , took over the money. Shohei and Sayoko plan a robbery and steal cash from the gallery, but another man steals it.
synopsis_en: A womanizing office worker and a gambling-addicted OL, struggling to repay their debts, plot a robbery. A romantic comedy directed, written, and starring the talent behind the TV drama 'Men and Women Seven Series,' the man-and-woman runaway journey across Tohoku and Hokkaido is also compelling as a road movie.

country: 日本 原題または英題：Disciples of Hippocrates
synopsis: かいせつ 京都を舞台に、最終学年を迎えた医学生たちの苦悩や挫折を描いた青春グラフィティの名作。医学部出身の大森監督が自身の経験を生かしたシナリオで医大生たちのリアルな日常を描き出す。手塚治虫、鈴木清順のカメオ出演も必見。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_jp: 医学者のヒポクラテスたらんと、京都の大学医科に入学した6人の学生たち。荻野愛作は恋人の妊娠と中絶をきっかけに生死を扱う医者という職業について考え始め、ガリ勉タイプのみどり、妻子持ちの加藤など、個性豊かな面々と医学とは何かを日々模索し続ける。
tmdb_overview_en: The story revolves around Ogino, who is in the last year of his medical studies. Between lectures, exams, on field training, his commitment as a pro-reformist militant and his girlfriend, Ogino is starting to wonder if he's really cut out to be a doctor.
synopsis_en: A masterpiece of youthful coming-of-age drama set in Kyoto, depicting the anguish and setbacks of medical students in their final year. Director Omori, himself a medical school graduate, draws on his own experience in a screenplay that captures the realistic daily lives of medical students. Cameo appearances by Osamu Tezuka and Seijun Suzuki are must-sees.

movie_title: 『 トロピカルミステリー 青春共和国』
synopsis: かいせつ 失踪した同級生を探す女子高生は、若者達が集う謎の島「青春共和国」に辿り着くが、その島には恐ろしい秘密が隠されていた―。84年「風の谷のナウシカ」で歌手デビューした安田成美が同年に初主演した青春ミステリー。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
synopsis_en: A high school girl searching for a missing classmate arrives at a mysterious island called 'Youth Republic' where young people gather, but a terrifying secret lies hidden there. A youth mystery starring Narumi Yasuda, who made her singing debut in 1984 with 'Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind,' in her first lead role that same year.
movie_title_jp: 『 トロピカルミステリー 青春共和国』

country: 日本
synopsis: かいせつ 新宿を舞台に、記憶喪失の男と暴力団幹部の奇妙な友情を描く―。人気の漫画原作を大胆に脚色し、松田が監督・主演を務めたハードボイルド・アクションの野心作。衝撃的な暴力表現を用いた独自の映像世界に魅了される圧巻の一本。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_jp: ヤクザ同士の対立しあう新宿の街に、ふらりと現れた過去の記憶を持たない男。廃屋に住むようになったその男はいつか“風（ふう）さん”と呼ばれるようになった。街の女との心の触れ合い。抗争のさなかにいるはみ出しヤクザとの間に生まれる奇妙な友情。その一方ヤクザの抗争は激化し、“風さん”もその中に巻き込まれて行く。
tmdb_overview_en: A homeless man suffering from memory loss is unbeatable in a fight. He becomes involved with the Yakuza.  It is based on a manga by Carib Marley.
synopsis_en: Set in Shinjuku, this film depicts the strange friendship between a man with amnesia and a yakuza executive. A bold adaptation of a popular manga, this hard-boiled action film is an ambitious work directed by and starring Matsuda. A stunning piece that captivates with its unique visual world employing shocking depictions of violence.

movie_title: エレノアってグレイト。
director: スカーレット・ヨハンソン
tmdb_overview_jp: スカーレット・ヨハンソンの監督デビュー作が日本上陸！ 年の差を超えた友情は「今日だけの嘘」ではじまった——。  長年連れ添った親友のベッシーが亡くなり、心にぽっかり穴が空いてしまったエレノア。疎遠になっている娘の住むニューヨークに来てみたものの、娘や孫にはそれぞれの生活もあって誰も相手にしてくれず。そんなある日、同年代の友人でも作ってみてはどうかと娘に言われ気軽なお茶会に参加するつもりが、ホロコースト生存者がその経験を語り合う自助グループの会に迷い込んでしまう。退出することも出来ずその場しのぎで語り始めた自身の半生。それは、生前忘れたくても忘れられないホロコーストの記憶を語っていた亡き親友ベッシーの人生の物語だった。  大学のレポートのため会に参加していたジャーナリスト志望の学生ニナは、激動の半生に感銘を受けインタビューさせてほしいと申し出るが、今日だけの嘘のつもりで話していたエレノアはもちろん拒否。だが、半年前にユダヤ人である母を亡くし父と二人のぎこちない生活に疎外感を感じているニナに、自身の孤独な境遇を重ね合わせ…。嘘から始まった二人の奇妙な友情関係は日を追うごとに深まり、ダメと分かっていても嘘に嘘を重ね、しまいにはテレビ番組の取材まで入ってしまう。年の差を感じさせない新たな友情の日々に心躍るエレノアをよそに悪気のない嘘は一人歩きし、周囲の人々を巻き込んだ大騒動に発展してしまうのだった…。
tmdb_overview_en: 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein tries to rebuild her life after the death of her best friend. As a result, she moves back to New York City after living in Florida for decades.

synopsis_en: Actress Scarlett Johansson makes her feature directorial debut with this lighthearted drama about the friendship between a powerful elderly woman and a motherless student, sparked by a lie, set against the backdrop of her own Jewish cultural roots. Based on a script by first-time feature screenwriter Tory Kamen, drawing on her own grandmother's and family history, Johansson directs with humor and wit. Eleanor, an elderly woman living in New York, feels a void after losing her longtime friend Bessie. One day, intending to attend a tea party, she accidentally wanders into a support group for Holocaust survivors. There, she improvises a story about Bessie's life, recounting her Holocaust memories. Inspired by the dramatic story, journalism student Nina approaches Eleanor, and a new friendship blossoms. But Eleanor's lie takes on a life of its own, sparking a major uproar. June Squibb ("Thelma") plays the unconventional Eleanor, and Erin Kellyman ("Solo: A Star Wars Story") plays Nina. Rita Zohar, herself a Holocaust survivor, plays Eleanor's late friend Bessie.

movie_title: 【山ドキュ定期便】サンティアゴの扉
tmdb_overview_en: The house of the director has a door out to the sidewalk. This gate separates the inside from the outside. The interior contains the filmmaker's personal story and his world of objects, thoughts and imaginations. Outer space contains the city of Santiago de Chile. The stories of the world inside the house are interrupted when the doorbell rings unknown and thus come into the film.
synopsis_en: Screened in the International Competition section of the Yamagata International Documentary Film Festival 2013. Won the Award of Excellence.

clean_title_jp: エレノアってグレイト。
movie_title_jp: エレノアってグレイト。
director_jp: スカーレット・ヨハンソン
synopsis_en: Actress Scarlett Johansson makes her feature directorial debut with this lighthearted drama about the friendship between a powerful elderly woman and a motherless student, sparked by a lie, set against the backdrop of her own Jewish cultural roots. Based on a script by first-time feature screenwriter Tory Kamen, drawing on her own grandmother's and family history, Johansson directs with humor and wit. Eleanor, an elderly woman living in New York, feels a void after losing her longtime friend Bessie. One day, intending to attend a tea party, she accidentally wanders into a support group for Holocaust survivors. There, she improvises a story about Bessie's life, recounting her Holocaust memories. Inspired by the dramatic story, journalism student Nina approaches Eleanor, and a new friendship blossoms. But Eleanor's lie takes on a life of its own, sparking a major uproar. June Squibb ("Thelma") plays the unconventional Eleanor, and Erin Kellyman ("Solo: A Star Wars Story") plays Nina. Rita Zohar, herself a Holocaust survivor, plays Eleanor's late friend Bessie.

country: フランス・イタリア・西ドイツ合作 原題または英題：The Trial
synopsis: 「市民ケーン」「黒い罠」などで映画史に名を刻んだオーソン・ウェルズが、フランツ・カフカの同名小説を映画化し、1962年に発表した不条理ドラマ。身に覚えのない罪で逮捕を告げられた男が、正体の見えない裁判と法の迷宮に巻き込まれていく姿を、悪夢のようなモノクロームの映像世界で描き出す。 ある朝、会社員のヨーゼフ・Kは、自室に現れた警官たちから、理由も告げられぬまま逮捕を宣告される。何の罪に問われているのかもわからないまま、彼は奇妙で不可解な裁判制度の世界へと足を踏み入れていく。法廷、弁護士、看護師、画家、司祭など、ヨーゼフ・Kの前にはさまざまな人が現れるが、助けになるはずの人々はみなどこか曖昧で、かえって迷宮を深めていく。ヨーゼフ・Kはやがて、理不尽な世界に追い詰められていく。 ヨーゼフ・K役を「サイコ」のアンソニー・パーキンス、弁護士役をウェルズ自身が演じ、ジャンヌ・モロー、ロミー・シュナイダーらが共演。ザグレブやローマ、そして当時は使われていなかったパリのオルセー駅などで撮影され、荒廃した駅舎や巨大なオフィス、方向感覚を失わせる空間が、ヨーゼフ・Kの置かれた不条理な世界を視覚化した。2026年9月、デジタル修復を施した4Kレストア版で再公開される。
tmdb_overview_en: At the identification of a dead body, a couple and a morgue employee both claim to be related to the deceased, and therefore the rightful recipient of an indemnity of at least 520,000.
synopsis_en: A drama of the absurd released in 1962, in which Orson Welles—who carved his name into film history with Citizen Kane and Touch of Evil—adapted Franz Kafka's novel of the same name. It depicts a man who is informed of his arrest for a crime he has no memory of committing, drawn into an invisible trial and a labyrinth of law, rendered through a nightmarish black-and-white visual world. One morning, office worker Josef K. is declared under arrest by police officers who appear in his room without being told the reason. Without knowing what crime he is being charged with, he steps into the world of a strange and incomprehensible judicial system. Before Josef K. appear all manner of people—a court, lawyers, a nurse, a painter, a priest—but those who should help him are all somehow ambiguous, only deepening the labyrinth. Josef K. is eventually driven into a corner by an irrational world. Anthony Perkins of Psycho plays Josef K., Welles himself plays the lawyer, and Jeanne Moreau and Romy Schneider co-star. Filmed in Zagreb, Rome, and the then-unused Orsay Station in Paris, the desolate station building, gigantic offices, and disorienting spaces visualize the absurd world in which Josef K. finds himself. In September 2026, it will be re-released in a 4K restored version with digital restoration.

director: フレデリック・チェン
country: フランス 原題または英題：Dior et Moi
synopsis: 老舗ブランド「クリスチャン・ディオール」全面協力のもと、オートクチュールの裏側に迫ったドキュメンタリー作品。2012年、空席になっていたディオールのアーティスティックディレクターの座に就任したラフ・シモンズ。自身の男性ブランド「ジル・サンダー」で活躍するシモンズだが、その認知度は低く、オートクチュール界での経験は皆無で、この大抜擢は世界中のファッション関係者を驚かせた。通常のコレクションでは半年近くの準備期間が必要とされている中、ディオールでの最初のコレクションまでに、シモンズに与えられた時間はわずか8週間。限られた時間の中で、世界中が注目するメゾンのコレクションを成功させるため奮闘するデザイナーや職人たちの裏側に密着した。
tmdb_overview_jp: 世界的老舗ファッション・ブランド、クリスチャン・ディオールを巡るドキュメンタリー。本社の上階に位置するアトリエに初めてカメラが潜入し、新任デザイナーとお針子たちが奮闘しながら挑むパリ・コレクションを映していく。
tmdb_overview_en: Behind-the-scenes documentary revealing what goes on inside the colourful, privileged, and sometimes stressful Christian Dior fashion house.
synopsis_en: A documentary that goes behind the scenes of haute couture with the full cooperation of the storied brand Christian Dior. In 2012, Raf Simons took over the vacant position of artistic director at Dior. Though Simons had made his mark with his own menswear brand Jil Sander, his name recognition was low and he had no experience in the world of haute couture, so this bold appointment shocked fashion insiders around the world. While a normal collection requires nearly half a year of preparation, Simons was given only eight weeks before his first Dior collection. The film closely follows the designers and artisans as they struggle behind the scenes to make the maison's collection — watched by the entire world — a success within that limited time.

movie_title: わたしの知らない子どもたち
country: 日本
synopsis: 「すばらしき世界」「永い言い訳」の西川美和が原案・脚本・監督を務め、戦後の日本で家族を失い社会からこぼれ落ちた子どもたちを題材に描いたドラマ。 戦争で家族と日常を奪われた12歳の少女・琴子は、生き延びるため自らの性別を隠し、少年として生きることを選ぶ。進駐軍相手の慰安施設や路上売春が広がるなか、少女であること自体が危険となる現実から逃れるための決断だった。音楽家の父のもとで穏やかに暮らしていた琴子の人生は戦争と敗戦によって一変し、「自分自身を手放す」という過酷な選択を迫られる。一方、かつて琴子が疎開していた学校の教師・曽根は、戦時中は軍国主義教育に加担した側だったが、敗戦により信念も立場も失い、過去の責任と向き合いながら生きることを余儀なくされる。 12歳の琴子役には、オーディションで約500人の中から選ばれた小八重葵美を抜擢。二階堂ふみが女性教師・曽根役を務め、竹野内豊、櫻井海音、花瀬琴音が脇を固める。「国宝」で数々の賞を受賞した作曲家・原摩利彦が音楽を手がけ、劇中にも音楽家役でカメオ出演。「ゴジラ－1.0」で第96回アカデミー賞視覚効果賞に輝いた映像制作プロダクション「白組」がVFXを担い、1945年の街並みをリアルに再現した。

synopsis_en: A drama written, planned, and directed by Miwa Nishikawa of "Under the Open Sky" and "The Long Excuse," depicting children who lost their families and fell through the cracks of society in postwar Japan. Kotoko, a 12-year-old girl who lost her family and daily life to the war, chooses to hide her gender and live as a boy in order to survive. It was a decision made to escape the reality in which being a girl itself was dangerous, as comfort facilities for occupation forces and street prostitution spread. Kotoko's life, which had been peaceful under her musician father, was transformed by the war and defeat, forcing her to make the harsh choice of "letting go of herself." Meanwhile, Sone, a teacher at the school where Kotoko had once been evacuated, had been complicit in militarist education during the war, but with defeat lost both his beliefs and his position, and is compelled to live while confronting the responsibility of his past. For the role of 12-year-old Kotoko, Aimi Kohachi was selected from approximately 500 candidates through an audition. Fumi Nikaido plays the female teacher Sone, with Yutaka Takenouchi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kotone Hanase rounding out the supporting cast. Composer Marihiko Hara, who won numerous awards for "Kokuho," handles the music and also makes a cameo appearance as a musician in the film. The visual effects production company Shirogumi, which won the Visual Effects award at the 96th Academy Awards for "Godzilla Minus One," handled VFX, realistically recreating the streetscape of 1945.

movie_title: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
movie_title_en: Voices from Gaza: Episode 2: Ahmad the Musician’s Message
director: ムハンマド・サウワーフ
country: パレスチナ・日本合作 原題または英題：Voices from Gaza
synopsis: 断片的なニュース映像やSNS動画だけでは見えてこない、2025年現在のパレスチナ・ガザ地区の現実と、そこに生きる人々の声を世界に伝えるドキュメンタリー・プロジェクト「ガザからの声」の第2弾。 ミュージシャンであり、5人の子どもを育てる父親でもあるアハマド・アブ＝アムシャは、ガザ北部のベイトハヌーンに住んでいたが、戦争が始まってから12回もの避難を強いられてきた。2025年1月の停戦発表を受けてベイトハヌーンへ戻ったものの、自宅と音楽スタジオは瓦礫と化していた。同年3月、再び戦闘が始まり避難生活を続ける中、アハマドは音楽で人々の心を支えようと決意。仲間の音楽家とともに子どもたちへ楽器や歌を教え、戦争の不安を和らげる活動を始める。音楽は彼にとって戦争への一種の抵抗であり、世界に声を届ける最も強い方法でもある。アハマドは世界中の芸術家たちへ「不正義に沈黙することは加担だ」とのメッセージを伝え、多くの子どもたちに音楽で喜びを届けることを目標に、今も音楽を奏で続けている。 ガザに拠点を置く映像制作会社アレフ・マルチメディアと東京の映画配給会社アップリンクによる共同プロジェクトで、現地での取材をアレフが行い、編集・配信・劇場公開をアップリンクが担当する。劇場とオンラインで同時に公開される。
movie_title_jp: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
tmdb_overview_en: Ahmad Abu-Amsha is a musician and father of five living through the upheaval of war in Gaza. After repeated displacement, he returned to find his home and music studio reduced to rubble. Seeking a way to help children cope with fear and uncertainty, Ahmad began working with fellow musicians to teach them songs and instruments in a displacement camp. He believes music can offer moments of relief and serve as a powerful way to communicate with the world. This documentary follows his efforts to keep music and hope alive amid continuing hardship.
clean_title_jp: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
movie_title_original: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
director_jp: ムハンマド・サウワーフ
synopsis_en: The second installment of "Voices from Gaza," a documentary project that brings to the world the reality of the Gaza Strip in 2025 and the voices of those living there—truths that remain hidden behind fragmented news clips and social media videos. Ahmad Abu-Amsha, a musician and father of five, lived in Beit Hanoun in northern Gaza but has been forced to evacuate 12 times since the start of the war. Following a ceasefire announcement in January 2025, he returned to Beit Hanoun only to find his home and music studio reduced to rubble. In March of the same year, as fighting resumed and his life of displacement continued, Ahmad resolved to support the spirits of his community through music. Alongside fellow musicians, he began teaching instruments and song to children to help ease the anxieties of war. For him, music is a form of resistance and the most powerful way to project his voice to the world. Sending a message to artists worldwide that "silence in the face of injustice is complicity," Ahmad continues to play, aiming to bring joy to as many children as possible. This film is a joint project between Gaza-based production company Aleph Multimedia and Tokyo-based distributor Uplink; Aleph conducted the local filming and reporting, while Uplink handled editing, distribution, and the theatrical release. The film will be released simultaneously in theaters and online.

tmdb_overview_en: Macabéa has just moved to the big city after her aunt, who raised her, died. She gets a job as a typist and moves into a boarding house with three other women. In her spare time, she listens to a radio station called Time; on Sundays, she likes to ride the metro. Then she meets Olímpico, a northeasterner like herself, who has dreams of becoming a congressman.
synopsis_en: "I am a typist, a virgin, and I like Coke and hot dogs." Based on the novel by Clarice Lispector, known as 'Brazil's Virginia Woolf,' this film shines with an unforgettable brilliance in the history of Brazilian cinema. After 40 years, it receives its first theatrical release in Japan.

country: 日本・フランス・シンガポール・フィリピン合作
synopsis: 「淵に立つ」「恋愛裁判」などの深田晃司監督が、松たか子を主演に迎えて撮りあげた人間ドラマ。第39回岸田國士戯曲賞を受賞した平田オリザの代表作「東京ノート」に着想を得て、深田監督自らオリジナル脚本を執筆。「東京ノート」の精神を受け継ぎつつ、岡山県奈義町をモデルにした「ナギ」を舞台に新たな物語を描き、企画の立ち上げから9年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 自然豊かな町・ナギで、ひとり創作に打ち込む彫刻家の寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍する友梨が数日間の休暇をとり、別れた夫の姉である寄子のもとを訪れる。若くして妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみ・好浩、息子の春樹とその親友・圭太など、人々との出会いは穏やかな日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。友梨は寄子の彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで彼女の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨自身にも変化が起こりはじめる。 深田監督とは初タッグとなる松たか子が、癒えない喪失を抱えながら彫刻制作に没頭する寄子という複雑なキャラクターを体現。寄子の彫刻のモデルをつとめる友梨を石橋静河、寄子の幼なじみで役場に勤める好浩を松山ケンイチが演じる。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.

movie_title: オステンデ ＜ラウラ・シタレラ監督特集＞
tmdb_overview_en: Waiting alone for her boyfriend at a hotel, a woman starts paying attention to the mysterious behavior of some guests.
synopsis_en:
The 2011 debut film from Argentine director Laura Citarella, who has garnered significant international acclaim after her four-hour-plus mystery epic *Trenque Lauquen* was named the best film of 2023 by France’s *Cahiers du Cinéma*. The story follows a woman who becomes immersed in the fictions lurking within everyday life.

After winning a radio quiz contest, Laura stays at a hotel in Ostende, near Buenos Aires. It is the off-season at the resort, and while waiting for her boyfriend to join her, she begins to observe a middle-aged man staying at the hotel with two young women. Intrigued by the man’s peculiar behavior, Laura lets her imagination run wild as she attempts to unravel the secret narrative that may be unfolding around him...

The film makes its Japanese theatrical debut as part of the special screening program "Laura Citarella Retrospective: Resonating Secrets," held in conjunction with the theatrical release of *Trenque Lauquen*.

tmdb_overview_en: The melodramatic story of a pink crew’s tragi-comedic adventures on location. synopsis_en: Be-yan, a cinematographer for pink films who returns home in the morning after a grueling shoot, discovers his wife Natsuko, who attempted suicide, sleeping as if dead after taking sleeping pills. He hurriedly carries her to the hospital and somehow she pulls through, but that day was supposed to be the first day of location shooting for a new pink film starring her. Unable to do otherwise, he starts filming with a stand-in, but it doesn't go well, and Natsuko, who finally returns to the set, also says she can't do it anymore, throwing the shoot into utter chaos.

synopsis: かいせつ 京都を舞台に、最終学年を迎えた医学生たちの苦悩や挫折を描いた青春グラフィティの名作。医学部出身の大森監督が自身の経験を生かしたシナリオで医大生たちのリアルな日常を描き出す。手塚治虫、鈴木清順のカメオ出演も必見。

tmdb_overview_jp: 医学者のヒポクラテスたらんと、京都の大学医科に入学した6人の学生たち。荻野愛作は恋人の妊娠と中絶をきっかけに生死を扱う医者という職業について考え始め、ガリ勉タイプのみどり、妻子持ちの加藤など、個性豊かな面々と医学とは何かを日々模索し続ける。
tmdb_overview_en: The story revolves around Ogino, who is in the last year of his medical studies. Between lectures, exams, on field training, his commitment as a pro-reformist militant and his girlfriend, Ogino is starting to wonder if he's really cut out to be a doctor.
synopsis_en: A masterpiece of youthful coming-of-age drama set in Kyoto, depicting the anguish and setbacks of medical students in their final year. Director Omori, himself a medical school graduate, draws on his own experience in a screenplay that captures the realistic daily lives of medical students. Cameo appearances by Osamu Tezuka and Seijun Suzuki are must-sees.

program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ

A bold adaptation of a popular manga, this hard-boiled action film is an ambitious work directed by and starring Matsuda. A stunning piece that captivates with its unique visual world employing shocking depictions of violence.

program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Shohei Taguchi is a salaryman who works for a securities company and loves women like no other. One day, he plans to use the cash borrowed from the gangsters and snatch to repay his debt . However, Sayoko Mukai, who said that she used the money of the company for gambling , took over the money. Shohei and Sayoko plan a robbery and steal cash from the gallery, but another man steals it.
synopsis_en: A womanizing office worker and a gambling-addicted OL, struggling to repay their debts, plot a robbery. tmdb_overview_jp: スカーレット・ヨハンソンの監督デビュー作が日本上陸！ 年の差を超えた友情は「今日だけの嘘」ではじまった——。  長年連れ添った親友のベッシーが亡くなり、心にぽっかり穴が空いてしまったエレノア。疎遠になっている娘の住むニューヨークに来てみたものの、娘や孫にはそれぞれの生活もあって誰も相手にしてくれず。そんなある日、同年代の友人でも作ってみてはどうかと娘に言われ気軽なお茶会に参加するつもりが、ホロコースト生存者がその経験を語り合う自助グループの会に迷い込んでしまう。退出することも出来ずその場しのぎで語り始めた自身の半生。それは、生前忘れたくても忘れられないホロコーストの記憶を語っていた亡き親友ベッシーの人生の物語だった。  大学のレポートのため会に参加していたジャーナリスト志望の学生ニナは、激動の半生に感銘を受けインタビューさせてほしいと申し出るが、今日だけの嘘のつもりで話していたエレノアはもちろん拒否。だが、半年前にユダヤ人である母を亡くし父と二人のぎこちない生活に疎外感を感じているニナに、自身の孤独な境遇を重ね合わせ…。嘘から始まった二人の奇妙な友情関係は日を追うごとに深まり、ダメと分かっていても嘘に嘘を重ね、しまいにはテレビ番組の取材まで入ってしまう。年の差を感じさせない新たな友情の日々に心躍るエレノアをよそに悪気のない嘘は一人歩きし、周囲の人々を巻き込んだ大騒動に発展してしまうのだった…。
tmdb_overview_en: 94-year-old Eleanor Morgenstein tries to rebuild her life after the death of her best friend. As a result, she moves back to New York City after living in Florida for decades.

synopsis_en: Actress Scarlett Johansson makes her feature directorial debut with this lighthearted drama about the friendship between a powerful elderly woman and a motherless student, sparked by a lie, set against the backdrop of her own Jewish cultural roots. Based on a script by first-time feature screenwriter Tory Kamen, drawing on her own grandmother's and family history, Johansson directs with humor and wit. Eleanor, an elderly woman living in New York, feels a void after losing her longtime friend Bessie. One day, intending to attend a tea party, she accidentally wanders into a support group for Holocaust survivors. There, she improvises a story about Bessie's life, recounting her Holocaust memories. Inspired by the dramatic story, journalism student Nina approaches Eleanor, and a new friendship blossoms. But Eleanor's lie takes on a life of its own, sparking a major uproar. June Squibb ("Thelma") plays the unconventional Eleanor, and Erin Kellyman ("Solo: A Star Wars Story") plays Nina. Rita Zohar, herself a Holocaust survivor, plays Eleanor's late friend Bessie.

movie_title: わたしの知らない子どもたち
country: 日本
synopsis: 「すばらしき世界」「永い言い訳」の西川美和が原案・脚本・監督を務め、戦後の日本で家族を失い社会からこぼれ落ちた子どもたちを題材に描いたドラマ。 戦争で家族と日常を奪われた12歳の少女・琴子は、生き延びるため自らの性別を隠し、少年として生きることを選ぶ。進駐軍相手の慰安施設や路上売春が広がるなか、少女であること自体が危険となる現実から逃れるための決断だった。音楽家の父のもとで穏やかに暮らしていた琴子の人生は戦争と敗戦によって一変し、「自分自身を手放す」という過酷な選択を迫られる。一方、かつて琴子が疎開していた学校の教師・曽根は、戦時中は軍国主義教育に加担した側だったが、敗戦により信念も立場も失い、過去の責任と向き合いながら生きることを余儀なくされる。 12歳の琴子役には、オーディションで約500人の中から選ばれた小八重葵美を抜擢。二階堂ふみが女性教師・曽根役を務め、竹野内豊、櫻井海音、花瀬琴音が脇を固める。「国宝」で数々の賞を受賞した作曲家・原摩利彦が音楽を手がけ、劇中にも音楽家役でカメオ出演。「ゴジラ－1.0」で第96回アカデミー賞視覚効果賞に輝いた映像制作プロダクション「白組」がVFXを担い、1945年の街並みをリアルに再現した。

tmdb_overview_en: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.
clean_title_jp: わたしの知らない子どもたち
movie_title_original: わたしの知らない子どもたち
synopsis_en: A drama written, planned, and directed by Miwa Nishikawa of "Under the Open Sky" and "The Long Excuse," depicting children who lost their families and fell through the cracks of society in postwar Japan. Kotoko, a 12-year-old girl who lost her family and daily life to the war, chooses to hide her gender and live as a boy in order to survive. It was a decision made to escape the reality in which being a girl itself was dangerous, as comfort facilities for occupation forces and street prostitution spread. Kotoko's life, which had been peaceful under her musician father, was transformed by the war and defeat, forcing her to make the harsh choice of "letting go of herself." Meanwhile, Sone, a teacher at the school where Kotoko had once been evacuated, had been complicit in militarist education during the war, but with defeat lost both his beliefs and his position, and is compelled to live while confronting the responsibility of his past. For the role of 12-year-old Kotoko, Aimi Kohachi was selected from approximately 500 candidates through an audition. Fumi Nikaido plays the female teacher Sone, with Yutaka Takenouchi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kotone Hanase rounding out the supporting cast. Composer Marihiko Hara, who won numerous awards for "Kokuho," handles the music and also makes a cameo appearance as a musician in the film. The visual effects production company Shirogumi, which won the Visual Effects award at the 96th Academy Awards for "Godzilla Minus One," handled VFX, realistically recreating the streetscape of 1945.

tmdb_overview_en: Macabéa has just moved to the big city after her aunt, who raised her, died. She gets a job as a typist and moves into a boarding house with three other women. In her spare time, she listens to a radio station called Time; on Sundays, she likes to ride the metro. Then she meets Olímpico, a northeasterner like herself, who has dreams of becoming a congressman.
synopsis_en: "I am a typist, a virgin, and I like Coke and hot dogs." Based on the novel by Clarice Lispector, known as 'Brazil's Virginia Woolf,' this film shines with an unforgettable brilliance in the history of Brazilian cinema. After 40 years, it receives its first theatrical release in Japan.

country: 日本・フランス・シンガポール・フィリピン合作
synopsis: 「淵に立つ」「恋愛裁判」などの深田晃司監督が、松たか子を主演に迎えて撮りあげた人間ドラマ。第39回岸田國士戯曲賞を受賞した平田オリザの代表作「東京ノート」に着想を得て、深田監督自らオリジナル脚本を執筆。「東京ノート」の精神を受け継ぎつつ、岡山県奈義町をモデルにした「ナギ」を舞台に新たな物語を描き、企画の立ち上げから9年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 自然豊かな町・ナギで、ひとり創作に打ち込む彫刻家の寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍する友梨が数日間の休暇をとり、別れた夫の姉である寄子のもとを訪れる。若くして妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみ・好浩、息子の春樹とその親友・圭太など、人々との出会いは穏やかな日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。友梨は寄子の彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで彼女の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨自身にも変化が起こりはじめる。 深田監督とは初タッグとなる松たか子が、癒えない喪失を抱えながら彫刻制作に没頭する寄子という複雑なキャラクターを体現。寄子の彫刻のモデルをつとめる友梨を石橋静河、寄子の幼なじみで役場に勤める好浩を松山ケンイチが演じる。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.

movie_title: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
movie_title_en: Voices from Gaza: Episode 2: Ahmad the Musician’s Message
director: ムハンマド・サウワーフ
country: パレスチナ・日本合作 原題または英題：Voices from Gaza
synopsis: 断片的なニュース映像やSNS動画だけでは見えてこない、2025年現在のパレスチナ・ガザ地区の現実と、そこに生きる人々の声を世界に伝えるドキュメンタリー・プロジェクト「ガザからの声」の第2弾。 ミュージシャンであり、5人の子どもを育てる父親でもあるアハマド・アブ＝アムシャは、ガザ北部のベイトハヌーンに住んでいたが、戦争が始まってから12回もの避難を強いられてきた。2025年1月の停戦発表を受けてベイトハヌーンへ戻ったものの、自宅と音楽スタジオは瓦礫と化していた。同年3月、再び戦闘が始まり避難生活を続ける中、アハマドは音楽で人々の心を支えようと決意。仲間の音楽家とともに子どもたちへ楽器や歌を教え、戦争の不安を和らげる活動を始める。音楽は彼にとって戦争への一種の抵抗であり、世界に声を届ける最も強い方法でもある。アハマドは世界中の芸術家たちへ「不正義に沈黙することは加担だ」とのメッセージを伝え、多くの子どもたちに音楽で喜びを届けることを目標に、今も音楽を奏で続けている。 ガザに拠点を置く映像制作会社アレフ・マルチメディアと東京の映画配給会社アップリンクによる共同プロジェクトで、現地での取材をアレフが行い、編集・配信・劇場公開をアップリンクが担当する。劇場とオンラインで同時に公開される。
movie_title_jp: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
tmdb_overview_en: Ahmad Abu-Amsha is a musician and father of five living through the upheaval of war in Gaza. After repeated displacement, he returned to find his home and music studio reduced to rubble. Seeking a way to help children cope with fear and uncertainty, Ahmad began working with fellow musicians to teach them songs and instruments in a displacement camp. He believes music can offer moments of relief and serve as a powerful way to communicate with the world. This documentary follows his efforts to keep music and hope alive amid continuing hardship.
clean_title_jp: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
movie_title_original: ガザからの声 Episode2「ミュージシャン・アハマドのメッセージ」
director_jp: ムハンマド・サウワーフ
synopsis_en: The second installment of "Voices from Gaza," a documentary project that brings to the world the reality of the Gaza Strip in 2025 and the voices of those living there—truths that remain hidden behind fragmented news clips and social media videos. Ahmad Abu-Amsha, a musician and father of five, lived in Beit Hanoun in northern Gaza but has been forced to evacuate 12 times since the start of the war. Following a ceasefire announcement in January 2025, he returned to Beit Hanoun only to find his home and music studio reduced to rubble. In March of the same year, as fighting resumed and his life of displacement continued, Ahmad resolved to support the spirits of his community through music. Alongside fellow musicians, he began teaching instruments and song to children to help ease the anxieties of war. For him, music is a form of resistance and the most powerful way to project his voice to the world. Sending a message to artists worldwide that "silence in the face of injustice is complicity," Ahmad continues to play, aiming to bring joy to as many children as possible. This film is a joint project between Gaza-based production company Aleph Multimedia and Tokyo-based distributor Uplink; Aleph conducted the local filming and reporting, while Uplink handled editing, distribution, and the theatrical release. The film will be released simultaneously in theaters and online.

director: フレデリック・チェン
country: フランス 原題または英題：Dior et Moi
synopsis: 老舗ブランド「クリスチャン・ディオール」全面協力のもと、オートクチュールの裏側に迫ったドキュメンタリー作品。2012年、空席になっていたディオールのアーティスティックディレクターの座に就任したラフ・シモンズ。自身の男性ブランド「ジル・サンダー」で活躍するシモンズだが、その認知度は低く、オートクチュール界での経験は皆無で、この大抜擢は世界中のファッション関係者を驚かせた。通常のコレクションでは半年近くの準備期間が必要とされている中、ディオールでの最初のコレクションまでに、シモンズに与えられた時間はわずか8週間。限られた時間の中で、世界中が注目するメゾンのコレクションを成功させるため奮闘するデザイナーや職人たちの裏側に密着した。
tmdb_overview_jp: 世界的老舗ファッション・ブランド、クリスチャン・ディオールを巡るドキュメンタリー。本社の上階に位置するアトリエに初めてカメラが潜入し、新任デザイナーとお針子たちが奮闘しながら挑むパリ・コレクションを映していく。
tmdb_overview_en: Behind-the-scenes documentary revealing what goes on inside the colourful, privileged, and sometimes stressful Christian Dior fashion house.
synopsis_en: A documentary that goes behind the scenes of haute couture with the full cooperation of the storied brand Christian Dior. In 2012, Raf Simons took over the vacant position of artistic director at Dior. Though Simons had made his mark with his own menswear brand Jil Sander, his name recognition was low and he had no experience in the world of haute couture, so this bold appointment shocked fashion insiders around the world. While a normal collection requires nearly half a year of preparation, Simons was given only eight weeks before his first Dior collection. The film closely follows the designers and artisans as they struggle behind the scenes to make the maison's collection — watched by the entire world — a success within that limited time.

country: フランス・イタリア・西ドイツ合作 原題または英題：The Trial
synopsis: 「市民ケーン」「黒い罠」などで映画史に名を刻んだオーソン・ウェルズが、フランツ・カフカの同名小説を映画化し、1962年に発表した不条理ドラマ。身に覚えのない罪で逮捕を告げられた男が、正体の見えない裁判と法の迷宮に巻き込まれていく姿を、悪夢のようなモノクロームの映像世界で描き出す。 ある朝、会社員のヨーゼフ・Kは、自室に現れた警官たちから、理由も告げられぬまま逮捕を宣告される。何の罪に問われているのかもわからないまま、彼は奇妙で不可解な裁判制度の世界へと足を踏み入れていく。法廷、弁護士、看護師、画家、司祭など、ヨーゼフ・Kの前にはさまざまな人が現れるが、助けになるはずの人々はみなどこか曖昧で、かえって迷宮を深めていく。ヨーゼフ・Kはやがて、理不尽な世界に追い詰められていく。 ヨーゼフ・K役を「サイコ」のアンソニー・パーキンス、弁護士役をウェルズ自身が演じ、ジャンヌ・モロー、ロミー・シュナイダーらが共演。ザグレブやローマ、そして当時は使われていなかったパリのオルセー駅などで撮影され、荒廃した駅舎や巨大なオフィス、方向感覚を失わせる空間が、ヨーゼフ・Kの置かれた不条理な世界を視覚化した。2026年9月、デジタル修復を施した4Kレストア版で再公開される。
tmdb_overview_en: At the identification of a dead body, a couple and a morgue employee both claim to be related to the deceased, and therefore the rightful recipient of an indemnity of at least 520,000.
synopsis_en: A drama of the absurd released in 1962, in which Orson Welles—who carved his name into film history with Citizen Kane and Touch of Evil—adapted Franz Kafka's novel of the same name. It depicts a man who is informed of his arrest for a crime he has no memory of committing, drawn into an invisible trial and a labyrinth of law, rendered through a nightmarish black-and-white visual world. One morning, office worker Josef K. is declared under arrest by police officers who appear in his room without being told the reason. Without knowing what crime he is being charged with, he steps into the world of a strange and incomprehensible judicial system. Before Josef K. appear all manner of people—a court, lawyers, a nurse, a painter, a priest—but those who should help him are all somehow ambiguous, only deepening the labyrinth. Josef K. is eventually driven into a corner by an irrational world. Anthony Perkins of Psycho plays Josef K., Welles himself plays the lawyer, and Jeanne Moreau and Romy Schneider co-star. Filmed in Zagreb, Rome, and the then-unused Orsay Station in Paris, the desolate station building, gigantic offices, and disorienting spaces visualize the absurd world in which Josef K. finds himself. In September 2026, it will be re-released in a 4K restored version with digital restoration.

movie_title: ドッグ・レディ ＜ラウラ・シタレラ監督特集＞
tmdb_overview_en: The protagonist of Dog Lady is a woman (Llinás) who lives on the outskirts of Buenos Aires with a pack of dogs, in a house like so many other humble shacks in the urban sprawl of the city.
synopsis_en: A film directed in 2015 by Laura Citarella, a core member of the Argentine filmmaking collective El Pampero Cine, who gained international attention with her 2022 feature mystery film Trenque Lauquen, screened at the Venice International Film Festival, the San Sebastián International Film Festival, and other festivals around the world. A woman crosses a plain surrounded by many dogs. She lives quietly with ten dogs in a hut she built with her own hands on an empty lot on the outskirts of Buenos Aires. She uses no money, speaks no words — a mysterious woman who seems to have slipped outside of society. On the edges of an uncontrollably sprawling metropolis, there spread worlds where mysteries like her could remain mysteries. Starring Verónica Ginas, an actor and the sister of Mariano Ginas, a filmmaker and screenwriter who is a member of El Pampero Cine, the film was co-directed by Verónica and Citarella at Verónica's suggestion. It had its first Japanese theatrical release as part of the special screening series 'Laura Citarella Retrospective: Resonating Secrets,' held to coincide with the theatrical release of Trenque Lauquen.

movie_title: わたしの知らない子どもたち
country: 日本
synopsis: 「すばらしき世界」「永い言い訳」の西川美和が原案・脚本・監督を務め、戦後の日本で家族を失い社会からこぼれ落ちた子どもたちを題材に描いたドラマ。 戦争で家族と日常を奪われた12歳の少女・琴子は、生き延びるため自らの性別を隠し、少年として生きることを選ぶ。進駐軍相手の慰安施設や路上売春が広がるなか、少女であること自体が危険となる現実から逃れるための決断だった。音楽家の父のもとで穏やかに暮らしていた琴子の人生は戦争と敗戦によって一変し、「自分自身を手放す」という過酷な選択を迫られる。一方、かつて琴子が疎開していた学校の教師・曽根は、戦時中は軍国主義教育に加担した側だったが、敗戦により信念も立場も失い、過去の責任と向き合いながら生きることを余儀なくされる。 12歳の琴子役には、オーディションで約500人の中から選ばれた小八重葵美を抜擢。二階堂ふみが女性教師・曽根役を務め、竹野内豊、櫻井海音、花瀬琴音が脇を固める。「国宝」で数々の賞を受賞した作曲家・原摩利彦が音楽を手がけ、劇中にも音楽家役でカメオ出演。「ゴジラ－1.0」で第96回アカデミー賞視覚効果賞に輝いた映像制作プロダクション「白組」がVFXを担い、1945年の街並みをリアルに再現した。
movie_title_jp: わたしの知らない子どもたち
tmdb_overview_jp: 12歳で孤児となり“少⼥”を棄てた⼥の⼦と、⽣きるために⽣徒を棄てた教師の再生への物語。
tmdb_overview_en: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.
clean_title_jp: わたしの知らない子どもたち
movie_title_original: わたしの知らない子どもたち
synopsis_en: A drama written, planned, and directed by Miwa Nishikawa of "Under the Open Sky" and "The Long Excuse," depicting children who lost their families and fell through the cracks of society in postwar Japan. Kotoko, a 12-year-old girl who lost her family and daily life to the war, chooses to hide her gender and live as a boy in order to survive. It was a decision made to escape the reality in which being a girl itself was dangerous, as comfort facilities for occupation forces and street prostitution spread. Kotoko's life, which had been peaceful under her musician father, was transformed by the war and defeat, forcing her to make the harsh choice of "letting go of herself." Meanwhile, Sone, a teacher at the school where Kotoko had once been evacuated, had been complicit in militarist education during the war, but with defeat lost both his beliefs and his position, and is compelled to live while confronting the responsibility of his past. For the role of 12-year-old Kotoko, Aimi Kohachi was selected from approximately 500 candidates through an audition. Fumi Nikaido plays the female teacher Sone, with Yutaka Takenouchi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kotone Hanase rounding out the supporting cast. Composer Marihiko Hara, who won numerous awards for "Kokuho," handles the music and also makes a cameo appearance as a musician in the film. The visual effects production company Shirogumi, which won the Visual Effects award at the 96th Academy Awards for "Godzilla Minus One," handled VFX, realistically recreating the streetscape of 1945.

tmdb_overview_jp: ペンシルベニア州西部の小さな町で暮らす79歳のミルトンは認知症の初期症状を娘に心配されながらも、受け入れられずに一人暮らしを続けていた。そんなある夜、庭に突如、空から正体不明の飛行物体が墜落し、彼の静かな日常は大きく揺らぎ始める。 周囲に訴えても相手にされない中、同年代の隣人サンディーとジョイスだけが共に飛行物体を目撃し3人は秘密を共有することに。それぞれの孤独を抱えていた3人は忘れかけていた人生の喜びを取り戻し、やがて自らの“これからの人生”と向き合っていく——。
tmdb_overview_en: A flying saucer lands in the backyard of an elderly suburbanite with memory problems, who forms a bond with the scared alien inside.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: A human drama starring the acclaimed actor Ben Kingsley, humorously depicting a lonely elderly man who, after getting caught up in a bizarre commotion with his neighbors, rediscovers the joy of life. Milton, a 79-year-old man living in a small town in western Pennsylvania, continues to live alone despite his daughter Denise worrying about his early symptoms of dementia. One night, an unidentified flying object from the sky crashes into Milton's yard, shaking his peaceful daily life. When no one around him takes him seriously, Milton shares the secret of the flying object with his neighbors Sandy and Joyce, who are around his age and also witnessed it. The three, each carrying their own loneliness, rediscover the forgotten joys of life and face their futures. Harriet Sansom Harris ("The Bodybuilder") plays Sandy, Jane Curtin ("Coneheads") plays Joyce, and Zoe Winters (series "Succession") plays Milton's daughter Denise. The director is Mark Turtletaub, known as a producer for "Little Miss Sunshine" and "Loving."

program_title: 『映画を輝かせるために ー蓮實重彦 山田宏一 山根貞男 映画談義集成』刊行記念特集
『映画を輝かせるために ー蓮實重彦 山田宏一 山根貞男 映画談義集成』刊行記念特集
tmdb_overview_en: A chance meeting between two traveling gamblers leads to a case of mistaken identity when the farmers transporting gold to the governor think they are about to be robbed as the two gamblers face off against each other swords in hand.
synopsis_en: Ginji, driven from his hometown, returns after ten years... This is a representative work marking the starting point of Tai Kato's unique style, with actors wearing no makeup, low-angle cameras, and simultaneous sound recording.

program_title: 『映画を輝かせるために ー蓮實重彦 山田宏一 山根貞男 映画談義集成』刊行記念特集

tmdb_overview_en: At the wedding of Kohei (Hasegawa) and Michiko (Todoroki), a whisper echoes along with a gust of wind. As if manipulated by the mysterious voice, Kohei takes Michiko to stay at a dilapidated mountain villa in his hometown. What awaited him there...

country: 日本
program_title: 『映画を輝かせるために ー蓮實重彦 山田宏一 山根貞男 映画談義集成』刊行記念特集
tmdb_overview_jp: 厳しい撮影を終えて朝帰りをした、ピンク映画の撮影監督べーやんは、妻の奈津子が自殺を図り、睡眠薬を飲んで死んだように眠り込む姿を発見。慌てて彼女を病院へ運び込み、どうにかことなきを得るが、本来その日は、彼女主演のピンク映画の新作のロケ撮影が始まる当日。やむなく代役を立てて映画の撮影を始めるもうまくいかず、ようやく現場に復帰した奈津子も、やはりもうできない、と言い出して、撮影は混乱を極めることに。
tmdb_overview_en: The melodramatic story of a pink crew’s tragi-comedic adventures on location.  A fictionalized adaptation of set photographer Ichiro Tsuda's 1980 book The Location (Za Rokēshon), an illustrated 229-page document about the cameraman’s experiences with pink cast and crew on the sets of several films produced in the late 1970's.
synopsis_en: Be-yan, a cinematographer for pink films who returns home in the morning after a grueling shoot, discovers his wife Natsuko, who attempted suicide, sleeping as if dead after taking sleeping pills. He hurriedly carries her to the hospital and somehow she pulls through, but that day was supposed to be the first day of location shooting for a new pink film starring her. Unable to do otherwise, he starts filming with a stand-in, but it doesn't go well, and Natsuko, who finally returns to the set, also says she can't do it anymore, throwing the shoot into utter chaos.

movie_title: 『 トロピカルミステリー 青春共和国』
synopsis: かいせつ 失踪した同級生を探す女子高生は、若者達が集う謎の島「青春共和国」に辿り着くが、その島には恐ろしい秘密が隠されていた―。84年「風の谷のナウシカ」で歌手デビューした安田成美が同年に初主演した青春ミステリー。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
synopsis_en: A high school girl searching for a missing classmate arrives at a mysterious island called 'Youth Republic' where young people gather, but a terrifying secret lies hidden there. A youth mystery starring Narumi Yasuda, who made her singing debut in 1984 with 'Nausicaä of the Valley of the Wind,' in her first lead role that same year.
movie_title_jp: 『 トロピカルミステリー 青春共和国』

country: 日本
synopsis: かいせつ 新宿を舞台に、記憶喪失の男と暴力団幹部の奇妙な友情を描く―。人気の漫画原作を大胆に脚色し、松田が監督・主演を務めたハードボイルド・アクションの野心作。衝撃的な暴力表現を用いた独自の映像世界に魅了される圧巻の一本。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_jp: ヤクザ同士の対立しあう新宿の街に、ふらりと現れた過去の記憶を持たない男。廃屋に住むようになったその男はいつか“風（ふう）さん”と呼ばれるようになった。街の女との心の触れ合い。抗争のさなかにいるはみ出しヤクザとの間に生まれる奇妙な友情。その一方ヤクザの抗争は激化し、“風さん”もその中に巻き込まれて行く。
tmdb_overview_en: A homeless man suffering from memory loss is unbeatable in a fight. He becomes involved with the Yakuza.  It is based on a manga by Carib Marley.
synopsis_en: Set in Shinjuku, this film depicts the strange friendship between a man with amnesia and a yakuza executive. A bold adaptation of a popular manga, this hard-boiled action film is an ambitious work directed by and starring Matsuda. A stunning piece that captivates with its unique visual world employing shocking depictions of violence.

country: 日本
synopsis: かいせつ 女好きの会社員とギャンブル好きのOLが借金返済に困り強盗を企てるが―。テレビドラマ「男女７人シリーズ」の演出・脚本・主演で描くラブコメディで、東北・北海道と展開する男女の逃避行はロードムービーとしても見応えあり。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Shohei Taguchi is a salaryman who works for a securities company and loves women like no other. One day, he plans to use the cash borrowed from the gangsters and snatch to repay his debt . However, Sayoko Mukai, who said that she used the money of the company for gambling , took over the money. Shohei and Sayoko plan a robbery and steal cash from the gallery, but another man steals it.
synopsis_en: A womanizing office worker and a gambling-addicted OL, struggling to repay their debts, plot a robbery. A romantic comedy directed, written, and starring the talent behind the TV drama 'Men and Women Seven Series,' the man-and-woman runaway journey across Tohoku and Hokkaido is also compelling as a road movie.

country: 日本 原題または英題：Disciples of Hippocrates
synopsis: かいせつ 京都を舞台に、最終学年を迎えた医学生たちの苦悩や挫折を描いた青春グラフィティの名作。医学部出身の大森監督が自身の経験を生かしたシナリオで医大生たちのリアルな日常を描き出す。手塚治虫、鈴木清順のカメオ出演も必見。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_jp: 医学者のヒポクラテスたらんと、京都の大学医科に入学した6人の学生たち。荻野愛作は恋人の妊娠と中絶をきっかけに生死を扱う医者という職業について考え始め、ガリ勉タイプのみどり、妻子持ちの加藤など、個性豊かな面々と医学とは何かを日々模索し続ける。
tmdb_overview_en: The story revolves around Ogino, who is in the last year of his medical studies. Between lectures, exams, on field training, his commitment as a pro-reformist militant and his girlfriend, Ogino is starting to wonder if he's really cut out to be a doctor.
synopsis_en: A masterpiece of youthful coming-of-age drama set in Kyoto, depicting the anguish and setbacks of medical students in their final year. Director Omori, himself a medical school graduate, draws on his own experience in a screenplay that captures the realistic daily lives of medical students. Cameo appearances by Osamu Tezuka and Seijun Suzuki are must-sees.

synopsis: 「海は燃えている　イタリア最南端の小さな島」「旅するローマ教皇」などのドキュメンタリー作品で知られるイタリアの名匠ジャンフランコ・ロージが、世界遺産ポンペイとナポリを舞台に、火山のふもとに広がる壮大な歴史と人々の営みを美しいモノクローム映像で描いたドキュメンタリー。 西暦79年のベスビオ山の噴火によって消えた、古代ローマの都市ポンペイ。一昼夜にして火山灰の下に埋もれ、繁栄していた街の姿がそのまま残されたが、埋没した遺跡は長く続いた発掘や盗掘により元の姿をとどめていない。火山のふもとに広がるナポリの街では、垂れ込める雲の下で人々の営みが続いている。考古学博物館で30年にわたって働く女性マリア、ベスビオ山近郊で遺跡発掘にあたる東京大学チーム、子どもたちの勉強をみる男性ティッティ、船からウクライナ産の小麦をおろすシリア人の青年。ロージ監督はナポリの街で3年半を過ごしながらカメラを回し、この地でつつましく生きる人々の姿と、火山の街の2000年にわたる歴史と現在、そして未来への希望を映し出していく。 「ブルータリスト」のダニエル・ブルンバーグが音楽を担当。2025年・第82回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門にて審査員特別賞を受賞。
movie_title_jp: ポンペイ、雲の下に生きる
tmdb_overview_en: Naples faces dual volcanic threats from Vesuvius and Campi Flegrei. Amid increasing tremors, archaeologists work as residents live anxiously, haunted by Pompeii's fate while emergency services strain.
clean_title_jp: ポンペイ、雲の下に生きる
synopsis_en: A documentary by renowned Italian master Gianfranco Rosi, known for such documentary works as "Fire at Sea" and "The Traveling Pope," set in the World Heritage sites of Pompeii and Naples, depicting the grand history and people's lives spread at the foot of a volcano in beautiful monochrome imagery. Pompeii, the ancient Roman city that vanished in the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD, was buried under volcanic ash in a single day and night, preserving the appearance of the prosperous city as it was, but the buried ruins no longer retain their original form due to long-continued excavation and looting. In the city of Naples spread at the foot of the volcano, people's lives continue beneath the hanging clouds. Maria, a woman who has worked at the archaeological museum for 30 years; a University of Tokyo team excavating ruins near Mount Vesuvius; Titti, a man who tutors children; a Syrian young man unloading Ukrainian wheat from a ship. Director Rosi spent three and a half years in Naples while running his camera, capturing the lives of people living modestly in this land, along with the 2,000-year history, present, and hope for the future of the volcano city. Daniel Blumberg of "The Brutalist" handled the music. The film won the Special Jury Prize in the competition section of the 82nd Venice International Film Festival in 2025.

country: フランス 原題または英題：La Venue de l'avenir
synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

country: カナダ・ハンガリー合作 原題または英題：Blue Heron
synopsis: 1990年代後半のカナダ・バンクーバー島を舞台に、8歳の少女の視点から家族と過ごしたかけがえのない日々をつづったヒューマンドラマ。 1990年代後半の夏。ハンガリー系移民の家族とともにバンクーバー島に移り住んだ8歳の少女サーシャは、豊かな自然に囲まれた土地で、兄たちや新しい友人と過ごしながら、少しずつ居場所を見つけていく。しかし、長兄ジェレミーは問題行動を繰り返しており、家族は限界を迎えそうになっていた。両親はジェレミーの問題を専門家に相談するなかで、困難な選択を迫られる。20年後、映画監督となったサーシャは、カメラを手に家族の過去をたどるなかで、幼い頃には見えなかった家族の姿を見つめ直していく。 監督・脚本は、本作が長編デビューとなるハンガリー系カナダ人の新鋭ソフィー・ロムバリ。これまでも「家族の記憶」「喪失」「写真や映像による記憶の再生」をテーマに短編作品を制作してきたロムバリ監督が、自身の家族との実体験をもとにフィクションとして再構築し、理解できない他者を見つめ続けることの尊さを描き出す。2025年・第50回トロント国際映画祭で最優秀カナダ映画新人賞を受賞したほか、世界各地で高く評価された。
tmdb_overview_jp: 1990年代後半の夏、8歳の少女サーシャはハンガリー系移民の家族とともにカナダ・バンクーバー島に移り住む。豊かな自然に囲まれた土地で、サーシャは兄たちや新しい友人たちと過ごしながら、少しずつ居場所を見つけていく。ところが、一番上の兄ジェレミーは「問題行動」を繰り返し、家族は限界を迎えつつある。両親はジェレミーの問題を専門家たちに相談する中、困難な選択を迫られていた。20年後、映画監督となったサーシャは、カメラを手に家族の過去をたどり始める──。
tmdb_overview_en: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.
synopsis_en: In the summer of the late 1990s, eight-year-old Sasha moves to Vancouver Island, Canada, with her family of Hungarian immigrants. Surrounded by rich nature, Sasha gradually finds her place while spending time with her older brothers and new friends. However, her eldest brother Jeremy repeatedly engages in 'problem behavior,' and the family is reaching its limit. As the parents consult experts about Jeremy's problems, they are forced to make a difficult choice. Twenty years later, Sasha, now a film director, begins tracing her family's past with a camera in hand—

country: 日本
synopsis: 名匠・小津安二郎の代表作で、東京で暮らす子どもたちを訪ねた老夫婦の姿を通し、戦後日本における家族関係の変化を描いた不朽の名作。ローポジションやカメラの固定といった“小津調”と形容される独自の技法で、親子の関係を丁寧に描き出す。尾道で暮らす老夫婦・周吉ととみは、東京で暮らす子どもたちを訪ねるため久々に上京する。しかし医者の長男・幸一も美容院を営む長女・志げもそれぞれの生活に忙しく、両親を構ってばかりいられない。唯一、戦死した次男の妻・紀子だけが彼らに優しい心遣いを見せるのだった。
tmdb_overview_jp: 戦後変わりつつある家族の関係をテーマに人間の生と死までをも見つめた深淵なドラマ。故郷の尾道から20年ぶりに東京へ出てきた老夫婦。成人した子どもたちの家を訪ねるが、みなそれぞれの生活に精一杯だった。唯一、戦死した次男の未亡人だけが皮肉にも優しい心遣いを示すのだった……。
tmdb_overview_en: The elderly Shukishi and his wife, Tomi, take the long journey from their small seaside village to visit their adult children in Tokyo. Their elder son, Koichi, a doctor, and their daughter, Shige, a hairdresser, don't have much time to spend with their aged parents, and so it falls to Noriko, the widow of their younger son who was killed in the war, to keep her in-laws company.
synopsis_en: A timeless masterpiece by the master Yasujiro Ozu, this film depicts the changing family relationships in post-war Japan through the story of an elderly couple visiting their children in Tokyo. Using his signature "Ozu style"—characterized by low camera angles and static shots—he meticulously portrays the parent-child dynamic. Shukishi and Tomi, an elderly couple living in Onomichi, travel to Tokyo for the first time in a while to visit their children. However, their eldest son, Koichi, a doctor, and their eldest daughter, Shige, who runs a beauty salon, are both too busy with their own lives to pay much attention to their parents. Only Noriko, the widow of their second son who died in the war, shows them genuine kindness and consideration.

country: カナダ・ハンガリー合作 原題または英題：Blue Heron
synopsis: 1990年代後半のカナダ・バンクーバー島を舞台に、8歳の少女の視点から家族と過ごしたかけがえのない日々をつづったヒューマンドラマ。 1990年代後半の夏。ハンガリー系移民の家族とともにバンクーバー島に移り住んだ8歳の少女サーシャは、豊かな自然に囲まれた土地で、兄たちや新しい友人と過ごしながら、少しずつ居場所を見つけていく。しかし、長兄ジェレミーは問題行動を繰り返しており、家族は限界を迎えそうになっていた。両親はジェレミーの問題を専門家に相談するなかで、困難な選択を迫られる。20年後、映画監督となったサーシャは、カメラを手に家族の過去をたどるなかで、幼い頃には見えなかった家族の姿を見つめ直していく。 監督・脚本は、本作が長編デビューとなるハンガリー系カナダ人の新鋭ソフィー・ロムバリ。これまでも「家族の記憶」「喪失」「写真や映像による記憶の再生」をテーマに短編作品を制作してきたロムバリ監督が、自身の家族との実体験をもとにフィクションとして再構築し、理解できない他者を見つめ続けることの尊さを描き出す。2025年・第50回トロント国際映画祭で最優秀カナダ映画新人賞を受賞したほか、世界各地で高く評価された。
tmdb_overview_jp: 1990年代後半の夏、8歳の少女サーシャはハンガリー系移民の家族とともにカナダ・バンクーバー島に移り住む。豊かな自然に囲まれた土地で、サーシャは兄たちや新しい友人たちと過ごしながら、少しずつ居場所を見つけていく。ところが、一番上の兄ジェレミーは「問題行動」を繰り返し、家族は限界を迎えつつある。両親はジェレミーの問題を専門家たちに相談する中、困難な選択を迫られていた。20年後、映画監督となったサーシャは、カメラを手に家族の過去をたどり始める──。
tmdb_overview_en: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.
synopsis_en: In the summer of the late 1990s, eight-year-old Sasha moves to Vancouver Island, Canada, with her family of Hungarian immigrants. Surrounded by rich nature, Sasha gradually finds her place while spending time with her older brothers and new friends. However, her eldest brother Jeremy repeatedly engages in 'problem behavior,' and the family is reaching its limit. As the parents consult experts about Jeremy's problems, they are forced to make a difficult choice. Twenty years later, Sasha, now a film director, begins tracing her family's past with a camera in hand—

tmdb_overview_jp: 平山は娘の文子が相談もなしに結婚を決めたことを激怒する。知人の娘の縁談には寛容だが、自分の娘の結婚には冷静になれない父親の姿を描いた、小津監督初のカラー作品。
tmdb_overview_en: Wataru's outwardly liberal views on marriage are severely tested when his daughter declares her love for a coworker and is adamant to live her own way, instead of agreeing to an arranged marriage. Outwitted by his female relatives, Hirayama stubbornly refuses to admit defeat.
synopsis_en: Hirayama is furious when his daughter Fumiko decides to marry without consulting him. This film depicts a father who is tolerant of marriage proposals for acquaintances' daughters but cannot remain calm when it comes to his own daughter's marriage. It is Ozu's first color film.

movie_title: ポンペイ、雲の下に生きる
movie_title_jp: ポンペイ、雲の下に生きる
director: ジャンフランコ・ロージ
country: イタリア 原題または英題：Sotto le nuvole
synopsis: 「海は燃えている　イタリア最南端の小さな島」「旅するローマ教皇」などのドキュメンタリー作品で知られるイタリアの名匠ジャンフランコ・ロージが、世界遺産ポンペイとナポリを舞台に、火山のふもとに広がる壮大な歴史と人々の営みを美しいモノクローム映像で描いたドキュメンタリー。 西暦79年のベスビオ山の噴火によって消えた、古代ローマの都市ポンペイ。一昼夜にして火山灰の下に埋もれ、繁栄していた街の姿がそのまま残されたが、埋没した遺跡は長く続いた発掘や盗掘により元の姿をとどめていない。火山のふもとに広がるナポリの街では、垂れ込める雲の下で人々の営みが続いている。考古学博物館で30年にわたって働く女性マリア、ベスビオ山近郊で遺跡発掘にあたる東京大学チーム、子どもたちの勉強をみる男性ティッティ、船からウクライナ産の小麦をおろすシリア人の青年。ロージ監督はナポリの街で3年半を過ごしながらカメラを回し、この地でつつましく生きる人々の姿と、火山の街の2000年にわたる歴史と現在、そして未来への希望を映し出していく。 「ブルータリスト」のダニエル・ブルンバーグが音楽を担当。2025年・第82回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門にて審査員特別賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_en: Naples faces dual volcanic threats from Vesuvius and Campi Flegrei. Amid increasing tremors, archaeologists work as residents live anxiously, haunted by Pompeii's fate while emergency services strain.
clean_title_jp: ポンペイ、雲の下に生きる
synopsis_en: A documentary by renowned Italian master Gianfranco Rosi, known for such documentary works as "Fire at Sea" and "The Traveling Pope," set in the World Heritage sites of Pompeii and Naples, depicting the grand history and people's lives spread at the foot of a volcano in beautiful monochrome imagery. Pompeii, the ancient Roman city that vanished in the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79 AD, was buried under volcanic ash in a single day and night, preserving the appearance of the prosperous city as it was, but the buried ruins no longer retain their original form due to long-continued excavation and looting. In the city of Naples spread at the foot of the volcano, people's lives continue beneath the hanging clouds. Maria, a woman who has worked at the archaeological museum for 30 years; a University of Tokyo team excavating ruins near Mount Vesuvius; Titti, a man who tutors children; a Syrian young man unloading Ukrainian wheat from a ship. Director Rosi spent three and a half years in Naples while running his camera, capturing the lives of people living modestly in this land, along with the 2,000-year history, present, and hope for the future of the volcano city. Daniel Blumberg of "The Brutalist" handled the music. The film won the Special Jury Prize in the competition section of the 82nd Venice International Film Festival in 2025.
