synopsis_en: An original musical animation that fuses the story of Princess Kaguya from Japan's oldest tale, "The Tale of the Bamboo Cutter," with elements of modern entertainment music live performances, brought to life by songs from a stellar lineup of Vocaloid producers. For 17-year-old high school girl Iroha Sakayori, who leads a busy life balancing part-time work and studies, watching the streams of Tsukuyomi Yachiyo—the administrator of the online virtual space "Tsukuyomi" and a hugely popular liver (streamer)—was her daily comfort. One day on her way home, Iroha encounters a cute baby who emerges from a gaming utility pole glowing in seven colors. Unable to leave the baby alone, she takes it home, but the baby rapidly grows into a girl about the same age as Iroha. At the request of this girl, Kaguya—who seems just like Princess Kaguya—Iroha agrees to help with her liver activities on Tsukuyomi. As Iroha produces music as a producer and Kaguya sings, the two gradually grow closer. However, an ominous shadow creeps toward them, seeking to take Kaguya back to the moon. Animation creator Kiyotaka Yamashita, known for opening sequence direction on "Jujutsu Kaisen" (Season 1), "Chainsaw Man," and "Urusei Yatsura," makes his feature directorial debut, with songs provided by renowned Vocaloid producers including ryo (supercell), kz (livetune), 40mP, HoneyWorks, Aqu3ra, and yuigot. Animation production is handled jointly by Studio Colorido ("Penguin Highway," "A Whisker Away") and Yamashita's Studio Chromato. Streaming on Netflix from January 22, 2026. Following its positive reception, it will be released theatrically from February 20, 2026.

synopsis: 織田裕二が湾岸署の刑事・青島俊作を演じ、社会現象を巻き起こした人気シリーズ「踊る大捜査線」の劇場版。青島俊作を主人公とする物語としては約14年ぶりの新作となり、主演の織田裕二をはじめ、監督の本広克行、脚本の君塚良一、プロデューサーの亀山千広らオリジナルのキャスト＆スタッフが再結集。タイトルの「N.E.W.」は「NEXT. EVOLUTION. tmdb_overview_jp: ある日、東京都内で誘拐事件が発生。 犯人は身代金を指定の場所まで持ってくるよう指示をし、 間に合わなければ街を爆破するという。 そして、なぜかその“運び屋”として青島を指名する。 さらに、3Dプリンター拳銃を使用した連続殺人事件も発生。 殺された被害者の一人である科学者が持っていた毒性ウイルスも盗まれており、 警視庁には「ウイルスを街にばらまく」という脅迫文が届く。 警視庁の捜査一課に着任した青島に、史上最悪クラスの難事件が次々に押し寄せる。 “犯人”はいったい―？ 事件解決のため、青島は仲間とともに東京の街を走りに走りまくる！！

synopsis_en: A theatrical installment of the hit series Odoru Daisosasen (Bayside Shakedown), which caused a social phenomenon, with Yuji Oda playing Shunsaku Aoshima of the Wangan Police Station. It is the first new work in approximately 14 years to feature Shunsaku Aoshima as the protagonist, reuniting the original cast and staff including star Yuji Oda, director Katsuyuki Motohiro, screenwriter Ryoichi Kimizuka, and producer Chihiro Kameyama. The N.E.W. in the title stands for NEXT. EVOLUTION. WORLD., and a new story for Shunsaku Aoshima begins with this film. Tokyo, one of the world's greatest metropolises. One day, a kidnapping case known as the 225 Incident occurs. The perpetrator names Aoshima, newly assigned to the First Investigation Division of the Metropolitan Police Department's Criminal Investigation Bureau, as the ransom courier. If the demands are not met in time, the city will be blown up. Furthermore, threats emerge involving a series of murders committed with 3D-printed guns and the release of a stolen toxic virus into the city. Meanwhile, the police organization itself is transforming, with AI determining investigation priorities and even handling warrant requests, but Aoshima races through Tokyo with his unchanging convictions. New faces joining the cast include Shuri, Shirasu Jin, and Takahisa Masuda, while veterans such as Yusuke Santamaria, Miki Maya, Miki Mizuno, Masahiro Komoto, Susumu Terajima, Atsushi Ito, Satoru Saito, Takehiko Ono, and Soichiro Kitamura also return. Music is handled by Akihiko Matsumoto, who has scored the previous series, and the theme song is Love Somebody, the series staple performed by Yuji Oda.

tmdb_overview_jp: 舞台は1993年。かつて、共に天才格闘家として名を馳せ、兄弟のような存在であったリュウとケン。ある理由により疎遠になった二人のもとに、謎の女性格闘家・春麗が現れ、“ワールドウォリアー・トーナメント（世界格闘王決定戦）”の招待状が差し出される。世界最強の猛者たち“ストリートファイター”と戦うことになった二人は、その拳で運命を変えることができるのか？

synopsis_en: A Hollywood live-action adaptation of Capcom's legendary series "Street Fighter," which was born as an arcade game in Japan in 1987 and established the fighting game genre. It is 1993. Ryu and Ken, once renowned as genius martial artists and like brothers to each other, had grown estranged for a certain reason. Before them appears a mysterious female fighter, Chun-Li, who presents an invitation to the "World Warrior Tournament." Ryu and Ken throw themselves into a fierce battle against the world's strongest Street Fighters, with no rules, no limits, and no mercy. But as the tournament progresses, a conspiracy hidden within the competition comes to light, and a nightmare the two thought they had buried in the past resurfaces. The director is Kitao Sakurai, born in Japan and raised in America. Noah Centineo of "Black Adam" plays Ken, Andrew Koji of "Bullet Train" plays Ryu, and Callina Liang of "Bad Genius" plays Chun-Li, with Curtis "50 Cent" Jackson as Mike Bison, David Dastmalchian as Vega, and Jason Momoa as Blanka. In the Japanese dub, voice actors familiar from the games, including Hiroki Takahashi as Ryu, reprise their roles.

tmdb_overview_en: After the events of Rebellion, the world appears to be in balance—but that peace is fragile. As a new threat connected to Walpurgisnacht emerges, Homura Akemi is forced to face the consequences of her choices and question how far she is willing to go to protect Madoka.

synopsis_en: The fourth theatrical film in the TV anime "Puella Magi Madoka Magica," which aired from January to April 2011 and became a major sensation. A sequel to the 2013 film "Puella Magi Madoka Magica the Movie: Rebellion," the story unfolds in a world created by Akemi Homura, who became a "demon" out of her feelings for Kaname Madoka. Among the girls of Mitakihara City, a rumor circulates that the "Lizard-san Telephone" will grant wishes in exchange for fighting the curses of this world. Meanwhile, abnormal incidents continue where girls without Soul Gems hunt magical beasts. Calmly observing this situation, Akemi Homura, as the demon reigning over this world, should have everything at her whim—but something suddenly appears to end this distorted daily life. "Nazuka Sokotsune," the place where all witches began; "Walpurgisnacht," the aggregate of multiple witches that once tormented Homura; and two magical girls seeking the "Law of Cycles." In a world that has lost the Law of Cycles, the fate of magical girls begins to turn once more. tmdb_overview_en: The school’s cool, prince-like heroine has never questioned her role—until a fellow “Prince” enters her life and sees her as more than a hero, awakening feelings she’s never faced before.
synopsis_en: A live-action film adaptation of the popular shoujo manga "Uruwashi no Yoi no Tsuki" by Miyuki Yamamori, serialized in Kodansha's "Dessert." This youth love story stars Shunsuke Michieda ("Even If This Love Disappears from the World Tonight") and features Seira Anzai ("Karada Sagashi THE LAST NIGHT") as the heroine, depicting the first love between a boy and girl at the same high school who are each called "Prince." First-year high school student Yoi Takiguchi is called a "Prince" for her androgynous beauty and cool demeanor, but internally she harbors complicated feelings about that perfect prince image. One day, she meets Kohaku Ichimura, an upperclassman at her school who is also called a "Prince" for his flawless looks. The two, each struggling with the gap between their inner selves and how others perceive them, gradually find themselves drawn to each other, closing the distance between them as they confront what it means to be true to themselves. The cast includes Rintaro Mizusawa as Takuto Oji, the third "Prince" who shakes up the relationship between Kohaku and Yoi; Yuki Yoda as Yoshiko, Kohaku's childhood friend; Naohito Fujiki as Yoi's father Seiichi; and friends who watch over the romance between Kohaku and Yoi played by Yuna Hoshino, Saya Suzukawa, Sorato Okura, and Tatsumi Asa. Directed by Kentaro Takemura ("Koukai Uso Nikki"), with screenplay by Yuichi Tokunaga, who has worked on numerous hits including "Tonde Saitama" and "Kaguya-sama: Love Is War."

synopsis_en: A sequel to the 2024 suspense thriller "Matching," written, directed, and scripted by Eiji Uchida of "Midnight Swan," which depicted the terror lurking behind encounters made through dating apps. Uchida returns to the director's chair, setting the story on a matching tour on a southern island where participants are suddenly caught up in a deadly game. Two years have passed since the "App Marriage Serial Murder Case," in which couples who met through a dating app were killed one after another. Rinka Tadashima and Tomu Nagayama overcame the incident and began dating, but Tomu suddenly vanishes from Rinka's presence. At the same time, a series of murders mimicking the earlier case occurs. A large number of white roses are left at the crime scenes, and an X mark is carved into the faces of the victims. Two months after Tomu's disappearance, Rinka joins a matching tour held on a southern island as a staff member. However, what awaits the participants there is a death game in which they will be killed unless they can prove true love. With no escape, the participants' hidden faces are exposed one after another. Eventually, the missing Tomu reappears before Rinka. Alongside returning cast members including Tao Tsuchiya as Rinka and Daisuke Sakuma as Tomu, the film features Kwak Dong-yeon, making his Japanese film debut as Lee Sung-il, a Korean company president participating in the tour; Hana Toyoshima as Airi Ito, the younger sister of Rinka's late best friend; and Yuki Kura as Anran Nomura, who shows an abnormal obsession with the App Marriage Serial Murder Case.

synopsis_en: A suspense action film directed by Takashi Miike, starring Shun Oguri and Lily James, produced as a Hollywood-Japanese joint project. Based on the 1992 American film "Bad Lieutenant," the story is relocated to Tokyo and reimagined. It depicts a corrupt detective (the "bad lieutenant") played by Oguri and an FBI agent played by James who team up as buddies to confront a conspiracy swirling through the city. Kyoji Yabuki is a detective living in the underworld of Shinjuku's Kabukicho, drowning in drugs and gambling, targeted by yakuza, and even rumored to have killed his partner. While spending his days being chased by debt collectors, a series of bizarre serial murders targeting yakuza occurs. Yabuki launches an investigation, identifies the bodies through their tattoos, and a man named Mitsuru Ishizuka emerges as a suspect. Meanwhile, Yabuki is paired with Gwen, an FBI agent who has come to Japan to search for the missing daughter of the next U.S. president. The murder case Yabuki is investigating and the disappearance Gwen is pursuing become intricately intertwined, eventually revealing a certain conspiracy. The star-studded cast includes Shotaro Mamiya, Shuhei Nomura, Nanase Nishino, Yuka Mukai, Takanori Iwata, Keisuke Watanabe, Hideo Nakano, Jun Murakami, Jun Kunimura, Hiroshi Tachi, and world-famous professional wrestler Liv Morgan. Ado performs the theme song, with Grammy Award-winning world-renowned composer Masanori Takumi participating in the music production.

synopsis_en: The concluding theatrical film of the "Rascal Does Not Dream" series, a youth fantasy anime based on Hajime Kamoshida's popular light novels that depicts adolescent emotions through mysterious phenomena. The mysteries left behind regarding "Adolescence Syndrome," which has been portrayed throughout the series, are finally revealed. National idol Mai Sakurajima announces before an audience that she is the true identity of the mysterious popular internet singer Touko Kirishima. The scene is identical to a dream that Mai's boyfriend, Sakuta Azusagawa, had on Christmas Eve. Starting with Mai's shocking confession on April 1st, the impossible events that everyone once saw in their dreams begin to occur one after another. The social media posts with the hashtag "#Dreaming," which claim that dreams come true, also disappear, and Sakuta, whose perception of reality around him no longer matches, receives a message from another version of himself from a world of another possibility, saying: "Please stop Touko Kirishima before reality is rewritten." To restore the rewritten world, Sakuta searches for Touko Kirishima, but... Continuing from the previous film, Soichi Masui directs, Masahiro Yokotani handles the screenplay, Tomomi Tamura serves as character designer, and CloverWorks produces the animation.

tmdb_overview_en: Kazuki Tsukigase is a high school boy who carries a certain secret. In search of a place where no one knows him, he enrolls at Sakijima High School on a remote island.  On Sakijima, there is a place known as the "Cove of Spiriting Away." One early summer day, Kazuki finds a girl lying unconscious in the cove. The girl—Nanao, 16 years old—later regains consciousness in the hospital, but her identity remains unknown. What is the meaning behind the word "1974" that she murmured?

synopsis_en: An animated film adaptation of Akiko Abe's popular youth novel To You, Who Are in a Place Farther Than Anywhere, which won the 22nd Booksellers Award for Kafune. On Saikijima, a remote island rich in abundant nature, there is a place called the "Kamikakushi Inlet." Kazuki Tsukigase, a boy who left the city for certain reasons and enrolled at Saikijima High School, discovers a collapsed girl at the Kamikakushi Inlet one early summer day. The girl's name is Nao Aishika, and since her identity is unknown, she is taken into the care of a man named Takatsu, who helped rescue her along with Kazuki. Worried about Nao, Kazuki visits her frequently, and they gradually grow closer, but eventually Nao tells him something astonishing. Up-and-coming voice actors gather for the cast, including Yosuke Ishihashi as Kazuki, Anna Nagase as Nao, and Shinba Tsuchiya as Kazuki's classmate Kiyoshi Ozaki. Actor Hiroshi Tamaki provides the voice of Takatsu, the man who holds the key to the story. Directed by Junichi Wada (TV anime HIGH CARD), with screenplay by Sayaka Kuwamura (Strobe Edge, Josee, the Tiger and the Fish). Character design and chief animation direction by Hechima (Chou Kaguya-hime!), music by Koji Nakamura of the band SUPERCAR. Animation production by long-established studio TMS Entertainment.

synopsis: ガザで今を生きる人々の姿を記録するドキュメンタリー・プロジェクト「ガザからの声」の第3弾。イスラエル・ガザ間で停戦合意が発表される直前の2025年9月から、停戦後の10月、11月にかけてのガザ市の状況と市民の生活の実態を、現地人の視点から映し出す。 2025年10月10日、約2年にわたり戦争状態にあったイスラエルとガザの間で停戦合意が発表された。その約1カ月前となる9月9日、イスラエル軍はSNSや上空から投下したビラを通じ、ガザ市の住民に対し、海沿いのアル・ラシード通りを経由して南部のアル・マワシへ避難するよう指示した。撮影チームがアル・ラシード通りへ向かうと、いつもは地中海で遊ぶ子どもたちの姿があった場所は、大量の荷物を積んだトラックや馬車、着の身着のまま歩いて南へと避難する人々であふれかえっていた。そして停戦合意を迎えた後、かつて我が家があった場所に戻ってきた人々は、瓦礫の中で少しずつ日常を取り戻そうとする。 監督は、マイケル・ウィンターボトムとの共同監督作「忘れない、パレスチナの子どもたちを」で知られる、ガザ出身の映像作家・ジャーナリストのムハンマド・サウワーフ。ガザの映像制作会社アレフ・マルチメディアと東京の映画配給会社アップリンクによる共同プロジェクトとして制作された。

synopsis: 直木賞受賞作家・辻村深月の同名小説を映画化し、コロナ禍で複雑な思いを抱える中高生たちの青春を、東京都渋谷区、茨城県土浦市、長崎県五島市を舞台に描いたドラマ。 2020年。新型コロナウイルスの感染拡大により登校や部活動が制限されるなか、茨城県立砂浦高校の天文部に所属する2年生・溪本亜紗の提案で、リモート会議を活用し、各地で同時に天体観測をする競技「オンラインスターキャッチコンテスト」が実施されることになる。長崎の五島列島や東京都心の生徒たちも参加してスタートしたこの活動はやがて全国へと拡がり、ある奇跡を起こす。 「交換ウソ日記」の桜田ひよりが亜紗役で主演を務め、亜紗の同級生役で水沢林太郎、長崎の学生役で中野有紗、早瀬憩、東京の学生役で黒川想矢、星乃あんな、亜紗が所属する天文部の顧問役で岡部たかしが共演。2019年のショートフィルム「ワンナイトのあとに」や配信ドラマ「今日も浮つく、あなたは燃える」で話題を集めた山元環が長編商業映画初監督を務め、ドラマ「ケの日のケケケ」の森野マッシュが脚本を担当。「ルックバック」のharuka nakamuraが音楽を手がけた。
tmdb_overview_en: During the COVID-19 pandemic in 2020, when club activities were restricted, Japanese students launched an astronomical observation event called the "Star Catch Contest" via remote meetings. What began as a collaboration between students from Ibaraki, Tokyo, and Nagasaki's Goto Islands soon spread nationwide, leading to an unexpected miracle.
synopsis_en: A drama based on the award-winning novel by Mizuki Tsujimura, depicting the complex emotions of junior high and high school students during the COVID-19 pandemic, set in Tokyo's Shibuya Ward, Tsuchiura City in Ibaraki Prefecture, and Goto City in Nagasaki Prefecture. In 2020, with school attendance and club activities restricted due to the pandemic, Aya Tanimoto, a second-year student in the astronomy club at Ibaraki Prefectural Sunaura High School, proposes an 'Online Star Catch Contest'—a competition using remote meetings to conduct simultaneous astronomical observations across different locations. The activity, joined by students from the Goto Islands in Nagasaki and central Tokyo, eventually spreads nationwide and sparks a miracle. Hiyori Sakurada, known for 'The Fake Diary,' stars as Aya. Rinataro Mizusawa plays her classmate; Arisa Nakano and Ikoi Hayase play students from Nagasaki; Soiya Kurokawa and Anna Hoshino play students from Tokyo; and Takashi Okabe plays the astronomy club advisor. Tamaki Yamamoto, who gained attention for the 2019 short film 'One Night After' and the streaming drama 'Today You're Restless, You're Burning,' makes his feature-length commercial film debut as director. Mash Morino, known for the drama 'Keke no Hi no Kekeke,' writes the screenplay. Haruka Nakamura, known for 'Look Back,' provides the music.

synopsis: 「淵に立つ」「恋愛裁判」などの深田晃司監督が、松たか子を主演に迎えて撮りあげた人間ドラマ。第39回岸田國士戯曲賞を受賞した平田オリザの代表作「東京ノート」に着想を得て、深田監督自らオリジナル脚本を執筆。「東京ノート」の精神を受け継ぎつつ、岡山県奈義町をモデルにした「ナギ」を舞台に新たな物語を描き、企画の立ち上げから9年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 自然豊かな町・ナギで、ひとり創作に打ち込む彫刻家の寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍する友梨が数日間の休暇をとり、別れた夫の姉である寄子のもとを訪れる。若くして妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみ・好浩、息子の春樹とその親友・圭太など、人々との出会いは穏やかな日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。友梨は寄子の彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで彼女の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨自身にも変化が起こりはじめる。 深田監督とは初タッグとなる松たか子が、癒えない喪失を抱えながら彫刻制作に没頭する寄子という複雑なキャラクターを体現。寄子の彫刻のモデルをつとめる友梨を石橋静河、寄子の幼なじみで役場に勤める好浩を松山ケンイチが演じる。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.

tmdb_overview_jp: ラッパーを夢見ながらも、学校にも家にも居場所を見いだせずにいる朴秀美。陸上部のエースで社交的、スクールカースト上位に属しながらも家庭に問題を抱える映画好きの矢口美流紅。大好きな漫画を自己形成の拠り所としている、斜に構えた毒舌キャラ・岩隈真子。未来の見えない田舎町で、欝々とした日々を送る3人の高校生は、自分たちの夢をかなえ、この町を抜け出すためには一獲千金を狙うしかないと考え、同好会「オール・グリーンズ」を結成。ある禁断の課外活動を始めるが……。
tmdb_overview_en: Hidemi Boku and Miruku live in a town with no future in sight. To chase their dreams and leave this place behind, there's only one way out—striking it rich! They form a club called "All Greens" and embark on a forbidden extracurricular adventure…

synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the coming-of-age novel "All Greens" by Namiki Dō, who was a 21-year-old university student at the time and won the 28th Matsumoto Seichō Prize by unanimous decision, generating significant buzz. Park Soo-mi dreams of becoming a rapper but cannot find her place at school or at home. Yaguchi Miruku is the ace of the track team, sociable, and near the top of the school hierarchy, yet harbors problems at home and loves movies. Iwakuma Mako is a cynical, sharp-tongued character who relies on her beloved manga as the foundation of her identity. In a rural town with no future in sight, these three high schoolers living gloomy days conclude that the only way to achieve their dreams and escape this town is to strike it rich, so they form a club called "All Greens" and begin a certain forbidden extracurricular activity... Minami Sara, who drew attention for NHK taiga dramas "The 13 Lords of the Shogun" and "Dear Radiance" as well as the film "Even If You Don't Love Me," plays Park Soo-mi, while Deguchi Natsuki of "Akabane Honeko's Bodyguard" plays the other protagonist, Yaguchi Miruku. Yoshida Mizuki of "Look Back" takes on the role of Iwakuma Mako, who forms "All Greens" alongside the two. The director and screenwriter is Koyama Riki of "Let's Meet at Sarugaku-cho."

synopsis: 1990年代後半のカナダ・バンクーバー島を舞台に、8歳の少女の視点から家族と過ごしたかけがえのない日々をつづったヒューマンドラマ。 1990年代後半の夏。ハンガリー系移民の家族とともにバンクーバー島に移り住んだ8歳の少女サーシャは、豊かな自然に囲まれた土地で、兄たちや新しい友人と過ごしながら、少しずつ居場所を見つけていく。しかし、長兄ジェレミーは問題行動を繰り返しており、家族は限界を迎えそうになっていた。両親はジェレミーの問題を専門家に相談するなかで、困難な選択を迫られる。20年後、映画監督となったサーシャは、カメラを手に家族の過去をたどるなかで、幼い頃には見えなかった家族の姿を見つめ直していく。 監督・脚本は、本作が長編デビューとなるハンガリー系カナダ人の新鋭ソフィー・ロムバリ。これまでも「家族の記憶」「喪失」「写真や映像による記憶の再生」をテーマに短編作品を制作してきたロムバリ監督が、自身の家族との実体験をもとにフィクションとして再構築し、理解できない他者を見つめ続けることの尊さを描き出す。2025年・第50回トロント国際映画祭で最優秀カナダ映画新人賞を受賞したほか、世界各地で高く評価された。
tmdb_overview_jp: 1990年代後半の夏、8歳の少女サーシャはハンガリー系移民の家族とともにカナダ・バンクーバー島に移り住む。豊かな自然に囲まれた土地で、サーシャは兄たちや新しい友人たちと過ごしながら、少しずつ居場所を見つけていく。ところが、一番上の兄ジェレミーは「問題行動」を繰り返し、家族は限界を迎えつつある。両親はジェレミーの問題を専門家たちに相談する中、困難な選択を迫られていた。20年後、映画監督となったサーシャは、カメラを手に家族の過去をたどり始める──。
tmdb_overview_en: A family of six's fresh start on 1990s Vancouver Island unravels as their youngest child, Sasha, witnesses the increasingly dangerous behavior of her older brother, Jeremy.
synopsis_en: In the summer of the late 1990s, eight-year-old Sasha moves to Vancouver Island, Canada, with her family of Hungarian immigrants. Surrounded by rich nature, Sasha gradually finds her place while spending time with her older brothers and new friends. However, her eldest brother Jeremy repeatedly engages in 'problem behavior,' and the family is reaching its limit. As the parents consult experts about Jeremy's problems, they are forced to make a difficult choice. Twenty years later, Sasha, now a film director, begins tracing her family's past with a camera in hand—

synopsis: 「すばらしき世界」「永い言い訳」の西川美和が原案・脚本・監督を務め、戦後の日本で家族を失い社会からこぼれ落ちた子どもたちを題材に描いたドラマ。 戦争で家族と日常を奪われた12歳の少女・琴子は、生き延びるため自らの性別を隠し、少年として生きることを選ぶ。進駐軍相手の慰安施設や路上売春が広がるなか、少女であること自体が危険となる現実から逃れるための決断だった。音楽家の父のもとで穏やかに暮らしていた琴子の人生は戦争と敗戦によって一変し、「自分自身を手放す」という過酷な選択を迫られる。一方、かつて琴子が疎開していた学校の教師・曽根は、戦時中は軍国主義教育に加担した側だったが、敗戦により信念も立場も失い、過去の責任と向き合いながら生きることを余儀なくされる。 12歳の琴子役には、オーディションで約500人の中から選ばれた小八重葵美を抜擢。二階堂ふみが女性教師・曽根役を務め、竹野内豊、櫻井海音、花瀬琴音が脇を固める。「国宝」で数々の賞を受賞した作曲家・原摩利彦が音楽を手がけ、劇中にも音楽家役でカメオ出演。「ゴジラ－1.0」で第96回アカデミー賞視覚効果賞に輝いた映像制作プロダクション「白組」がVFXを担い、1945年の街並みをリアルに再現した。
tmdb_overview_jp: 12歳で孤児となり“少⼥”を棄てた⼥の⼦と、⽣きるために⽣徒を棄てた教師の再生への物語。
tmdb_overview_en: War may be over, but for the children of Miwa Nishikawa’s latest film — adapted from her forthcoming novel — survival has only begun.
clean_title_jp: わたしの知らない子どもたち
synopsis_en: A drama written, planned, and directed by Miwa Nishikawa of "Under the Open Sky" and "The Long Excuse," depicting children who lost their families and fell through the cracks of society in postwar Japan. Kotoko, a 12-year-old girl who lost her family and daily life to the war, chooses to hide her gender and live as a boy in order to survive. It was a decision made to escape the reality in which being a girl itself was dangerous, as comfort facilities for occupation forces and street prostitution spread. Kotoko's life, which had been peaceful under her musician father, was transformed by the war and defeat, forcing her to make the harsh choice of "letting go of herself." Meanwhile, Sone, a teacher at the school where Kotoko had once been evacuated, had been complicit in militarist education during the war, but with defeat lost both his beliefs and his position, and is compelled to live while confronting the responsibility of his past. For the role of 12-year-old Kotoko, Aimi Kohachi was selected from approximately 500 candidates through an audition. Fumi Nikaido plays the female teacher Sone, with Yutaka Takenouchi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kotone Hanase rounding out the supporting cast. Composer Marihiko Hara, who won numerous awards for "Kokuho," handles the music and also makes a cameo appearance as a musician in the film. The visual effects production company Shirogumi, which won the Visual Effects award at the 96th Academy Awards for "Godzilla Minus One," handled VFX, realistically recreating the streetscape of 1945.

synopsis: ファッション業界における人種的多様性を切りひらいた先駆者、ベサン・ハーディソンの知られざる人生に光をあてたドキュメンタリー。 モデル、エージェント、アクティビストとして活躍し、華やかなファッション業界の舞台裏で「誰が美として選ばれ、誰が見えない存在にされてきたのか」という問いを長年にわたり投げかけてきたベサン・ハーディソン。現代のファッションシーンを語るうえで欠かせない存在でありながら、その功績はこれまで十分に語られてこなかった。本作には、ベサンを「第二の母」と慕うモデルのナオミ・キャンベルをはじめ、ゼンデイヤ、イマン、タイソン・ベックフォード、ウーピー・ゴールドバーグ、ラルフ・ローレン、ブルース・ウェーバーら、時代を形づくってきたモデルやクリエイターたちが登場。ベサン本人の言葉や、彼女を取り巻く人々の証言、豊富なアーカイブ映像を通して、ファッション史に埋もれてきたひとりの女性の功績と、母としての葛藤と孤独、そして再生を描くとともに、1970年代から現代へと続くニューヨークのファッション、アート、カルチャーの変遷を鮮やかに映し出す。 ベサン・ハーディソン本人と「ディオールと私」のフレデリック・チェンが共同監督を務めた。

synopsis_en: A documentary shedding light on the unknown life of Bethann Hardison, a pioneer who opened the way for racial diversity in the fashion industry. As a model, agent, and activist, Bethann Hardison has long posed the question behind the glamorous fashion industry's scenes: "Who has been chosen as beauty, and who has been made invisible?" Though indispensable to any discussion of the contemporary fashion scene, her achievements have not been sufficiently told until now. The film features Naomi Campbell, who reveres Bethann as a "second mother," along with Zendaya, Iman, Tyson Beckford, Whoopi Goldberg, Ralph Lauren, Bruce Weber, and other models and creators who shaped their eras. Through Bethann's own words, testimony from those around her, and a wealth of archival footage, it depicts the achievements of a woman buried in fashion history, her struggles and loneliness as a mother, and her rebirth, while vividly capturing the transformations of New York fashion, art, and culture from the 1970s to the present. Bethann Hardison herself and Frederic Cheng of "Dior and I" served as co-directors.

synopsis_en:
The 2011 debut film from Argentine director Laura Citarella, who has garnered significant international acclaim after her four-hour-plus mystery epic *Trenque Lauquen* was named the best film of 2023 by France’s *Cahiers du Cinéma*. The story follows a woman who becomes immersed in the fictions lurking within everyday life.

After winning a radio quiz contest, Laura stays at a hotel in Ostende, near Buenos Aires. It is the off-season at the resort, and while waiting for her boyfriend to join her, she begins to observe a middle-aged man staying at the hotel with two young women. Intrigued by the man’s peculiar behavior, Laura lets her imagination run wild as she attempts to unravel the secret narrative that may be unfolding around him...

The film makes its Japanese theatrical debut as part of the special screening program "Laura Citarella Retrospective: Resonating Secrets," held in conjunction with the theatrical release of *Trenque Lauquen*.

synopsis_en: A film directed in 2019 by Argentine filmmaker Laura Citarella, who drew attention with her feature Trenque Lauquen, selected as the number one film in Cahiers du Cinéma's 2023 year-end top ten. It depicts people confronting the poetry left behind by a certain poet. A poet named Juana Bignozzi has died. A young poet, Mercedes Halfon, who wishes to keep Bignozzi's poetry alive in the world, decides to make a film about Bignozzi together with filmmaker Laura Citarella and others. The women confront Bignozzi's poetry as they sort through her belongings. What began as a project without a plot gradually turns into something more complex and delicate than they had ever anticipated. Produced around the same time as Trenque Lauquen, this work offers glimpses of episodes and themes shared with that film. It had its first Japanese theatrical release as part of the special screening series 'Laura Citarella Retrospective: Resonating Secrets,' held to coincide with the theatrical release of Trenque Lauquen.

synopsis_en: A drama written, planned, and directed by Miwa Nishikawa of "Under the Open Sky" and "The Long Excuse," depicting children who lost their families and fell through the cracks of society in postwar Japan. Kotoko, a 12-year-old girl who lost her family and daily life to the war, chooses to hide her gender and live as a boy in order to survive. It was a decision made to escape the reality in which being a girl itself was dangerous, as comfort facilities for occupation forces and street prostitution spread. Kotoko's life, which had been peaceful under her musician father, was transformed by the war and defeat, forcing her to make the harsh choice of "letting go of herself." Meanwhile, Sone, a teacher at the school where Kotoko had once been evacuated, had been complicit in militarist education during the war, but with defeat lost both his beliefs and his position, and is compelled to live while confronting the responsibility of his past. For the role of 12-year-old Kotoko, Aimi Kohachi was selected from approximately 500 candidates through an audition. Fumi Nikaido plays the female teacher Sone, with Yutaka Takenouchi, Kaito Sakurai, and Kotone Hanase rounding out the supporting cast. Composer Marihiko Hara, who won numerous awards for "Kokuho," handles the music and also makes a cameo appearance as a musician in the film. The visual effects production company Shirogumi, which won the Visual Effects award at the 96th Academy Awards for "Godzilla Minus One," handled VFX, realistically recreating the streetscape of 1945.

synopsis_en: A drama based on an original work by religious figure Ryuho Okawa, questioning "what true happiness is" through the story of a woman tossed about by the temptations of a Cinderella story and sudden wealth. Yuko Kawai, an ordinary woman working at an advertising agency in Tokyo, feels a small sense of impatience at her reality with no open future, yet dreams of marrying a wealthy handsome man. synopsis_en: A hen born and raised on a poultry farm escapes from a shipping truck! Having gained freedom for the first time in her life, she runs through a world full of excitement and danger, eventually arriving at a house where a family with complications lives. While living a new life in a chicken coop in the garden, she experiences first love and decides to incubate and raise the first egg she lays. However, she faces the harsh reality that her precious eggs are collected by humans every day. What is life? What is living? While the hen dreams of the day her children become chicks, the owner family gets caught up in a certain incident. An unexpected fate awaits them both——

synopsis: 「時計じかけのオレンジ」のマルコム・マクダウェルが主演を務め、旧ソ連で50人以上を殺害したとされる実在の猟奇殺人犯アンドレイ・チカチーロをモデルに描いたクライムスリラー。 教師のエヴィレンコは生徒への強姦未遂事件を起こして職を失った後、女性や子どもを次々と殺害しては食べるようになる。連続殺人事件の犯人が捕まらないまま4年が過ぎたころ、捜査に加わることになった検察官レシエフは、エヴィレンコの心の闇に迫っていく。 原作は、デビッド・グリエコがチカチーロの裁判を傍聴して執筆した小説「Il comunista che mangiava i bambini（子どもを食べた共産主義者）」。当初はベルナルド・ベルトルッチ監督が映画化を希望したが病に倒れ逝去したため、原作者グリエコが自ら長編初メガホンをとり完成させた。以前からグリエコ監督の友人であったマクダウェルが実際のチカチーロの映像を参考にしながら殺人鬼エヴィレンコを怪演し、「イコライザー」のマートン・ソーカス、「マリーゴールド・ホテルで会いましょう」のロナルド・ピックアップが共演。日本では長らく未公開のままだったが、2026年10月に劇場初公開。
synopsis_en: Malcolm McDowell, star of A Clockwork Orange, leads this crime thriller modeled on Andrei Chikatilo, the real-life serial killer believed to have murdered more than 50 people in the former Soviet Union. After a teacher named Evilenko loses his job for attempting to rape a student, he begins killing and eating women and children one after another. Four years pass with the serial killer still at large, and when prosecutor Lesiev joins the investigation, he begins to probe the darkness within Evilenko's mind. The source material is David Grieco's novel Il comunista che mangiava i bambini (The Communist Who Ate Children), written after the author attended Chikatilo's trial. Bernardo Bertolucci originally hoped to direct the adaptation, but after he fell ill and passed away, Grieco, the original author, took the helm himself to complete the film as his feature directorial debut. McDowell, long a friend of director Grieco, delivers a chilling performance as the killer Evilenko, drawing on actual footage of Chikatilo, with Mårten Sökas of The Equalizer and Ronald Pickup of The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel co-starring. Long unreleased in Japan, the film finally receives its theatrical premiere in October 2026.

country: アメリカ 原題または英題：CBGB
synopsis: パンク／ニューウェイヴ発祥の地として知られるニューヨークの伝説的ライブハウス「CBGB」の誕生を描いた音楽伝記ドラマ。 1970年代、ニューヨーク。相次ぐ店の失敗と離婚が重なり人生のどん底にいたヒリー・クリスタルは、再起をかけて小さなカントリーバー「CBGB」を開業する。ステージも配線も水回りもすべて手作業のDIYでつくりあげたものの、客は一向に入らず、閑古鳥の鳴く日々が続いていた。そんなある日、無名のロックバンド・テレヴィジョンが店に現れ、ヒリーは“オリジナル曲のみ演奏すること”を条件に彼らを出演させる。これをきっかけに、トーキング・ヘッズ、パティ・スミス、ラモーンズ、ブロンディら無名の若者たちが店に集まるようになる。小さなバーは、表現の場を失っていた彼らが自分の声を見つける実験場として機能しはじめ、やがて世界のロック史を塗り替えるパンク文化の中心地となっていく。 「ハリー・ポッター」シリーズのアラン・リックマンがヒリー・クリスタル役で主演を務め、「ウォッチメン」のマリン・アッカーマンがデボラ・ハリー役、「Smile スマイル」のカイル・ガルナーがルー・リード役、ロックバンド「フー・ファイターズ」のテイラー・ホーキンスがイギー・ポップ役、「フランシス・ハ」のミッキー・サムナーがパティ・スミス役で出演。監督は「ボトル・ドリーム　カリフォルニアワインの奇跡」のランドール・ミラー。
synopsis_en: A music biopic drama depicting the birth of CBGB, the legendary New York live house known as the birthplace of punk and new wave. 1970s, New York. Hilly Kristal, at rock bottom after a string of failed businesses and a divorce, opens a small country bar called "CBGB" to make a comeback. He builds the stage, wiring, and plumbing all by hand in DIY fashion, but customers never come, and the place stays empty day after day. Then one day, an unknown rock band called Television shows up, and Hilly lets them perform on the condition that they play only original songs. This becomes the catalyst for unknown young musicians like Talking Heads, Patti Smith, the Ramones, and Blondie to gather at the venue. The small bar begins to function as an experimental space where those who had lost a place for expression could find their own voice, and eventually becomes the epicenter of punk culture that would rewrite the history of rock worldwide. Alan Rickman of the "Harry Potter" series stars as Hilly Kristal, Malin Åkerman of "Watchmen" plays Deborah Harry, Kyle Gallner of "Smile" plays Lou Reed, Taylor Hawkins of the rock band Foo Fighters plays Iggy Pop, and Mickey Sumner of "Frances Ha" plays Patti Smith. Directed by Randall Miller of "Bottle Shock."

synopsis: パンク／ニューウェイヴ発祥の地として知られるニューヨークの伝説的ライブハウス「CBGB」の誕生を描いた音楽伝記ドラマ。 1970年代、ニューヨーク。相次ぐ店の失敗と離婚が重なり人生のどん底にいたヒリー・クリスタルは、再起をかけて小さなカントリーバー「CBGB」を開業する。ステージも配線も水回りもすべて手作業のDIYでつくりあげたものの、客は一向に入らず、閑古鳥の鳴く日々が続いていた。そんなある日、無名のロックバンド・テレヴィジョンが店に現れ、ヒリーは“オリジナル曲のみ演奏すること”を条件に彼らを出演させる。これをきっかけに、トーキング・ヘッズ、パティ・スミス、ラモーンズ、ブロンディら無名の若者たちが店に集まるようになる。小さなバーは、表現の場を失っていた彼らが自分の声を見つける実験場として機能しはじめ、やがて世界のロック史を塗り替えるパンク文化の中心地となっていく。 「ハリー・ポッター」シリーズのアラン・リックマンがヒリー・クリスタル役で主演を務め、「ウォッチメン」のマリン・アッカーマンがデボラ・ハリー役、「Smile スマイル」のカイル・ガルナーがルー・リード役、ロックバンド「フー・ファイターズ」のテイラー・ホーキンスがイギー・ポップ役、「フランシス・ハ」のミッキー・サムナーがパティ・スミス役で出演。監督は「ボトル・ドリーム　カリフォルニアワインの奇跡」のランドール・ミラー。
synopsis_en: A music biopic drama depicting the birth of CBGB, the legendary New York live house known as the birthplace of punk and new wave. 1970s, New York. Hilly Kristal, at rock bottom after a string of failed businesses and a divorce, opens a small country bar called "CBGB" to make a comeback. He builds the stage, wiring, and plumbing all by hand in DIY fashion, but customers never come, and the place stays empty day after day. Then one day, an unknown rock band called Television shows up, and Hilly lets them perform on the condition that they play only original songs. This becomes the catalyst for unknown young musicians like Talking Heads, Patti Smith, the Ramones, and Blondie to gather at the venue. The small bar begins to function as an experimental space where those who had lost a place for expression could find their own voice, and eventually becomes the epicenter of punk culture that would rewrite the history of rock worldwide. Alan Rickman of the "Harry Potter" series stars as Hilly Kristal, Malin Åkerman of "Watchmen" plays Deborah Harry, Kyle Gallner of "Smile" plays Lou Reed, Taylor Hawkins of the rock band Foo Fighters plays Iggy Pop, and Mickey Sumner of "Frances Ha" plays Patti Smith. Directed by Randall Miller of "Bottle Shock."

country: イタリア 原題または英題：Evilenko
synopsis: 「時計じかけのオレンジ」のマルコム・マクダウェルが主演を務め、旧ソ連で50人以上を殺害したとされる実在の猟奇殺人犯アンドレイ・チカチーロをモデルに描いたクライムスリラー。 教師のエヴィレンコは生徒への強姦未遂事件を起こして職を失った後、女性や子どもを次々と殺害しては食べるようになる。連続殺人事件の犯人が捕まらないまま4年が過ぎたころ、捜査に加わることになった検察官レシエフは、エヴィレンコの心の闇に迫っていく。 原作は、デビッド・グリエコがチカチーロの裁判を傍聴して執筆した小説「Il comunista che mangiava i bambini（子どもを食べた共産主義者）」。当初はベルナルド・ベルトルッチ監督が映画化を希望したが病に倒れ逝去したため、原作者グリエコが自ら長編初メガホンをとり完成させた。以前からグリエコ監督の友人であったマクダウェルが実際のチカチーロの映像を参考にしながら殺人鬼エヴィレンコを怪演し、「イコライザー」のマートン・ソーカス、「マリーゴールド・ホテルで会いましょう」のロナルド・ピックアップが共演。日本では長らく未公開のままだったが、2026年10月に劇場初公開。
synopsis_en: Malcolm McDowell, star of A Clockwork Orange, leads this crime thriller modeled on Andrei Chikatilo, the real-life serial killer believed to have murdered more than 50 people in the former Soviet Union. After a teacher named Evilenko loses his job for attempting to rape a student, he begins killing and eating women and children one after another. Four years pass with the serial killer still at large, and when prosecutor Lesiev joins the investigation, he begins to probe the darkness within Evilenko's mind. The source material is David Grieco's novel Il comunista che mangiava i bambini (The Communist Who Ate Children), written after the author attended Chikatilo's trial. Bernardo Bertolucci originally hoped to direct the adaptation, but after he fell ill and passed away, Grieco, the original author, took the helm himself to complete the film as his feature directorial debut. McDowell, long a friend of director Grieco, delivers a chilling performance as the killer Evilenko, drawing on actual footage of Chikatilo, with Mårten Sökas of The Equalizer and Ronald Pickup of The Best Exotic Marigold Hotel co-starring. Long unreleased in Japan, the film finally receives its theatrical premiere in October 2026.

movie_title_en: Murder in the Front Row: The San Francisco Bay Area Thrash Metal Story
movie_title_original: Murder in the Front Row: The San Francisco Bay Area Thrash Metal Story
country: アメリカ 原題または英題：Murder in the Front Row: The San Francisco Bay Area Thrash Metal Story
synopsis: ヘヴィ・メタルのサブジャンルのなかで群を抜く過激さとスピードを誇り、商業的にも成功を収めたスラッシュ・メタル。その爆心地となった、1980年代のサンフランシスコ・ベイエリア・シーンの真実に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 1980年代初頭、不況にあえぐサンフランシスコ。労働者階級の少年たちは、テープ・トレードを通じてイギリスから手に入れた新しい音楽のうねりに衝撃を受けた。彼らは「もっと速く、もっと激しく」という衝動のままにギターをかき鳴らし、夜ごと仲間たちと集まっては、まだ見ぬ音楽の可能性を追い続けた。華やかさとは無縁だった少年たちは、やがて新たな音楽、スラッシュ・メタルを生み出し、わずか数年間でヘヴィ・メタルの世界地図を塗り替えていく。 日本でも絶大な知名度を誇るMETALLICA、MEGADETH、SLAYER、ANTHRAXのスラッシュ・メタル四天王をはじめ、シーンの最重要バンドであるEXODUSや、TESTAMENT、POSSESSED、DEATH ANGELら、ジャンルを代表するバンドたちが次々と登場。今では世界的スターとなった彼らが秘蔵エピソードの数々を語り尽くし、当時の貴重な映像も織り交ぜながら、初期ベイエリア・スラッシュ・シーンの濃密な数年間を振り返る。
tmdb_overview_en: Murder In The Front Row: The San Francisco Bay Area Thrash Metal Story. In the early 1980’s, a small group of dedicated Bay Area headbangers shunned the hard rock of MTV and Hollywood hairspray bands in favor of a more dangerous brand of metal that became known as thrash! From the tape trading network to the clubs to the record stores and fanzines, director Adam Dubin reveals how the scene nurtured the music and the music spawned a movement.  Murder In The Front Row is told through powerful first person testimony and stunning animation and photography. The film is a social study of a group of young people defying the odds and building something essential for themselves.  Featuring interviews with Metallica, Megadeth, Slayer, Anthrax, Exodus, Testament, Death Angel, Possessed and many more! Narrated by Brian Posehn.
clean_title_jp: マーダー・イン・ザ・フロント・ロウ〜俺たちのベイエリア・スラッシュ物語〜
synopsis_en: A documentary that delves into the truth behind the 1980s San Francisco Bay Area scene, the epicenter of thrash metal—a subgenre of heavy metal that stands out for its extreme intensity and speed and that also achieved commercial success. In the early 1980s, San Francisco was mired in recession. Working-class boys were stunned by a new musical wave they obtained from England through tape trading. Driven by the urge to go "faster, harder," they thrashed their guitars and gathered nightly with friends, chasing the possibilities of a music they had yet to hear. These boys, far removed from glamour, eventually created a new music—thrash metal—and in just a few years redrew the map of the heavy metal world. The film features a parade of bands that represent the genre, including the "Big Four" of thrash metal—METALLICA, MEGADETH, SLAYER, and ANTHRAX, all hugely famous in Japan—as well as EXODUS, one of the scene's most essential bands, and TESTAMENT, POSSESSED, DEATH ANGEL, and others. Now global stars, they recount a wealth of treasured anecdotes, interwoven with rare footage from the era, looking back on the dense few years of the early Bay Area thrash scene.

country: 日本
synopsis: 鴻池留衣による小説「本当にあった話（の話）」（「フェミニストのままじゃいられない」を改題）を、水上恒司が主演を務めて映画化。数十年前に起きた連続殺人事件をもとにした舞台劇の制作現場で主演俳優が暴走していく姿を通し、人間の闇をブラックかつシニカルに描き出す。 1999年。厳格な家庭に縛られてきた近田貴子は恋人との結婚を否定され、ある計画を企てる。その内容は、立派な経歴を持つ男性と結婚して殺害し、その人生を恋人に引き継がせ、夫婦として生きるというものだった。しかし貴子の歪んだ欲望はとどまることを知らず、殺人が繰り返されていく。貴子による「配偶者入れ替え連続殺人事件」から数十年が経った現在。事件を題材にした舞台劇が制作されることになり、夛田が主演の座を射止める。しかし夛田のもつ執着と執念は、相手役の米良や脚本家の垣内、演出家の加藤らを掌握し、すべてを破壊していく。 舞台劇の主演俳優・夛田を水上恒司が演じ、黒木華、山下美月、小池栄子、佐々木蔵之介が共演。監督は、2018年の長編デビュー作「赤色彗星倶楽部」で注目を集め、本作が商業デビュー作となる武井佑吏。
tmdb_overview_jp: 1999年。厳格な家庭に縛られてきた近田貴子は恋人との結婚を否定され、ある計画を企てる。その内容は、立派な経歴を持つ男性と結婚して殺害し、その人生を恋人に引き継がせ、夫婦として生きるというものだった。しかし貴子の歪んだ欲望はとどまることを知らず、殺人が繰り返されていく。貴子による「配偶者入れ替え連続殺人事件」から数十年が経った現在。事件を題材にした舞台劇が制作されることになり、夛田が主演の座を射止める。しかし夛田のもつ執着と執念は、相手役の米良や脚本家の垣内、演出家の加藤らを掌握し、すべてを破壊していく。
tmdb_overview_en: Decades after a shocking serial murder case involving the swapping of spouses, a stage production based on the real-life crimes is being prepared. Inexperienced actor Tada is cast in the lead role, but as he becomes increasingly consumed by the character and begins to blur the line between fiction and reality, his obsession draws the play's cast and crew into his increasingly disturbing delusions. As opening night approaches, the boundary between truth and fiction collapses, leaving everyone to question what is real and what is imagined.
synopsis_en: Based on Rui Konoike's novel "A True Story (About a Story)" (renamed from "Can't Stay a Feminist"), adapted into a film starring Koji Mizukami. Through the figure of a lead actor spiraling out of control at the production site of a stage play based on a serial murder case that occurred decades ago, the film depicts the darkness of humanity in a blackly comedic and cynical manner. In 1999, Takako Konda, who has been bound by a strict family, is denied permission to marry her lover and devises a plan. The plan is to marry a man with an impressive background, murder him, have her lover inherit his life, and live as a married couple. However, Takako's distorted desires know no bounds, and the murders repeat. Decades after Takako's "spouse-swapping serial murders," a stage play based on the case is set to be produced, and Tada wins the lead role. But Tada's obsession and tenacity take hold of his co-star Yora, playwright Kakiuchi, director Kato, and others, destroying everything. Koji Mizukami plays Tada, the lead actor of the stage play, with Haru Kuroki, Mizuki Yamashita, Eiko Koike, and Kuranosuke Sasaki co-starring. Directed by Yuri Takei, who drew attention with his 2018 feature debut "Red Comet Club," with this film marking his commercial debut.

country: 日本
synopsis: 妻子のためにヤクザ稼業から足を洗った男が堅気の世界で奮闘するも苛立ちを募らせていく姿を描き、自主制作作品ながら大ヒットを記録した異色のヤクザ映画。小劇場でキャリアを積んだ金子正次が自ら執筆した脚本をもとに映画初主演を務めたが、金子は本作公開直後に33歳の若さで他界し、本作が唯一の主演映画となった。 新宿・歌舞伎町界隈を縄張りとする三東会幹部の竜二は、アパートの一室に開いた闇のルーレット場を2人の舎弟に仕切らせ、順風満帆な日々を送っていた。そんなある日、金と出世欲だけで動くヤクザの世界に疎ましさを感じた彼は、妻まり子と幼い娘あやと一緒に暮らすため堅気になることを決意。裏社会から足を洗って酒屋で働きはじめた竜二は、平凡で慎ましい家族との生活に心の安らぎを覚えるが……。 監督は金子の学生時代からの友人で本作が長編劇映画初監督となる川島透。2023年10月、公開40周年を記念して作成されたDCP版でリバイバル公開。2026年10月、4Kスキャン2Kリマスター版で公開。
tmdb_overview_jp: 新宿にシマを持つ三東会の幹部、花城竜二。3年前に拘置所に入れられて以来、妻と娘には会っていない。どうしても妻と娘と暮らしたい竜二は足を洗い堅気の世界へ踏み込み、妻と娘とともに新たな人生を歩み始めるが…。
tmdb_overview_en: Ryuji tries quitting the yakuza to actively support his wife and daughter; as he's used to easy money, it's a difficult transition.
synopsis_en: An unconventional yakuza film that depicts a man who quits the yakuza life for the sake of his wife and child, struggling in the straight world while his frustration builds—and which became a major hit despite being an independent production. Masatsugu Kaneko, who built his career in small theaters, wrote the screenplay himself and starred in his first film role, but Kaneko passed away at the young age of 33 shortly after the film's release, making this his only starring film. Ryuji, an executive of the Santo-kai yakuza group controlling the Kabukicho area of Shinjuku, runs an underground roulette parlor in a room of an apartment building through two of his underlings and enjoys smooth-sailing days. One day, feeling disgusted with the yakuza world that runs on money and ambition alone, he resolves to go straight so he can live with his wife Mariko and young daughter Aya. Ryuji leaves the underworld and begins working at a liquor store, finding peace of mind in an ordinary, modest life with his family—but then... The director is Toru Kawashima, a friend of Kaneko since their student days, making his feature film directorial debut. In October 2023, a DCP version created to commemorate the 40th anniversary of its release was given a revival screening. In October 2026, a 4K scan 2K remastered version will be released.

movie_title: 竜二　レストア＆リマスター版
synopsis: 日本アカデミー、毎日映画コンクールなど1983年度の映画賞を総なめにし日本映画の潮流を変えたといわれる傑作が、グレーディング監修に撮影監督の笠松則通を招き、リマスター監督を川島透がつとめて最終確認した完全版として、ついに４Kスキャン２Kリマスターで鮮やかによみがえる！
synopsis_en: A masterpiece that swept the 1983 film awards including the Japan Academy Prize and the Mainichi Film Awards, and is said to have changed the course of Japanese cinema, is finally revived in vivid 4K scan 2K remaster as a complete version, with cinematographer Norimichi Kasamatsu invited to supervise grading and director Toru Kawashima overseeing the remaster and giving final approval!
movie_title_jp: 竜二　レストア＆リマスター版

synopsis: 「佐々木、イン、マイマイン」「若き見知らぬ者たち」の内山拓也監督が、北村匠海を主演に迎えて撮りあげた自伝的作品。内山監督の故郷である新潟県を舞台に、自身の居場所とアイデンティティを模索する孤独な少年が、息をのむような大きな愛を知るまでの20年間を描く。 日本海沿いの町に暮らす少年・大地は、幼少期に暴君のようだった父の影響で言葉を発することができない。現在は母の亜樹と雑居ビル屋上のプレハブに暮らしているが、水商売で生計を立てる母はほとんど家に帰らず、生活も苦しい。やがて大地は亜樹とともに叔母の家に身を寄せるが、彼の居場所はどこにもなく、ひとりで過ごすうちに内気になっていく。そんなある日、父の行方を求めて生家を訪ねたことをきっかけに、大地の運命は大きく揺らぎはじめる。 主人公・大地の青年期を北村匠海が演じ、自分のもとを離れた父への静かな怒りと、母に対する憎しみと愛という相反する感情に揺れる心の内を体現。大地の母・亜樹を宮沢りえ、父・大原を永瀬正敏、大地の少年期を榎本司、加藤庵次、穐本陽月の3人が演じた。2025年・第26回東京フィルメックスのコンペティション部門で審査員特別賞を受賞。また、第76回ベルリン国際映画祭パノラマ部門にも正式出品された。
synopsis_en: Director Takuya Uchiyama, who swept newcomer awards at film festivals with "Sasaki, In, My Mind" and continued with "Young Strangers," consistently gazing at the youth of young people resisting reality and trying to grasp something, leaving a vivid impression on the film world, releases this passionate work—an autobiographical film set in his hometown of Niigata in winter, telling the story of a boy searching for a place to belong and his identity. Playing the adolescent protagonist Daichi is Takumi Kitamura. He brilliantly embodies the quiet anger toward his father who left him and his mother, and the heart wavering between love and hatred—contradictory emotions—toward his mother who raised him single-handedly. As his mother Aki, Rie Miyazawa gives her all to portray a mother whose innocent nature creates a life that instills loneliness in Daichi, yet whose every detail reveals a certain tenderness toward her son. And as his father Ohara, Masatoshi Nagase, with full maturity, shows a man who transforms from a tyrannical figure into one living out a sorrowful remaining life. Also, as the young Daichi, Tsukasa Enomoto, Anji Kato, and Hazuki Akimoto each express the loneliness, love, and life force swirling deep in his heart with innocent yet powerful gazes, driving the entire story forward. Daichi, a boy living in a town along the Sea of Japan, stopped speaking due to the influence of his father, who was like a tyrant during his early childhood. He now lives with his mother Aki, but Aki, forced to make a living through night work, rarely comes home, and their life is hard. Eventually they move in with his aunt, but he has no place anywhere, and spending time alone, he grew introverted. Daichi decides to visit his old home in search of his father's whereabouts. From this point on, his fate is greatly shaken——— Poverty with no emotional anchor, small salvation amid the loneliness of living so as not to be found by anyone, complicated feelings toward his mother. Daichi seems to live as if being swept along, yet he never stops walking. The 20 years until he grasps a faint light and comes to know a breathtaking, immense love are depicted through a perspective rooted in realism, following the boy's figure throughout.

In October 2023, a DCP version created to commemorate the 40th anniversary of its release was given a revival screening. In October 2026, a 4K scan 2K remastered version will be released.

movie_title: 竜二　レストア＆リマスター版
synopsis: 日本アカデミー、毎日映画コンクールなど1983年度の映画賞を総なめにし日本映画の潮流を変えたといわれる傑作が、グレーディング監修に撮影監督の笠松則通を招き、リマスター監督を川島透がつとめて最終確認した完全版として、ついに４Kスキャン２Kリマスターで鮮やかによみがえる！
synopsis_en: A masterpiece that swept the 1983 film awards including the Japan Academy Prize and the Mainichi Film Awards, and is said to have changed the course of Japanese cinema, is finally revived in vivid 4K scan 2K remaster as a complete version, with cinematographer Norimichi Kasamatsu invited to supervise grading and director Toru Kawashima overseeing the remaster and giving final approval!
movie_title_jp: 竜二　レストア＆リマスター版

movie_title: 真実と反逆 〜ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス〜
movie_title_jp: 真実と反逆 ～ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス～
country: リトアニア・アメリカ
synopsis:
沈黙することが「忠誠」、真実を語ることは「反逆」とされたナチス政権下のドイツで、反逆罪で処刑された実在の〝最年少レジスタンス〟ヘルムス・ヒューべナー（1925年-1942年没）。本作は実際に起きた抵抗運動を題材に、「国家の圧力」と「自らの信念」との激しい衝突を描く真実のヒューマンドラマである。史実をなぞるだけに留まらない。〝言葉〟を武器に戦った若者たちの固い友情、捜査や裁判が進むにつれて高まる緊迫感、そして愛する人々へ抱く切なる想い──。多層的なドラマにあらゆる感情がかき立てられ、心の奥に深い余韻が刻まれていく。
1941年、第二次世界大戦下のドイツ。16歳の少年ヘルムス・ヒューベナー（ユアン・ホロックス）は、通っている教会でナチス政権への服従を促され、ヒトラーの圧政に疑問を抱く。ユダヤ人迫害に直面したことをきっかけに、禁止されていた海外ラジオ放送を秘かに聴いた彼は、国家が隠し続けてきた戦争の実態や残虐行為を知ってしまう。正義感に突き動かされたヘルムスは、親友二人を仲間に加え、国家の嘘を暴くビラを町中に配布し、人々に真実を伝えていく。しかしその行為は死刑に値する反逆罪だった。秘密国家警察の捜査が迫るなか、彼らの勇気ある行動は、やがて逃れられない運命へと突き進んでいく──。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1941 Nazi Germany, 16-year-old Helmuth Hübener begins questioning the regime after learning the truth about the war and seeing his Jewish friend persecuted. With two friends, he secretly listens to banned foreign broadcasts and distributes leaflets exposing Nazi lies. As the Gestapo closes in, the teenagers face mounting danger for choosing conscience over obedience. Based on the true story of one of Germany’s youngest resistance fighters.
clean_title_jp: 真実と反逆 ～ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス～
synopsis_en: A human drama set in Germany during World War II, depicting the life-risking struggle of a young resistance fighter who stood up to tell the truth about the Nazis. Based on Helmuth Hübener, the youngest real-life resistance member executed for treason under the Nazi regime, it portrays the fierce clash between 'state pressure' and 'personal conviction.' In 1941, Germany during World War II. Sixteen-year-old Helmuth Hübener is urged at church to submit to the Nazi regime and begins to question Hitler's tyranny. After witnessing the persecution of Jews, he listens to forbidden foreign radio broadcasts and learns of the war's true state and atrocities that the state had kept hidden. Driven by a sense of justice, Helmuth recruits two close friends and distributes leaflets exposing the state's lies throughout town, spreading the truth to the people. But that act was treason, punishable by death. As the Secret State Police close in, their courageous actions hurtle toward an inescapable fate. Matt Whitaker, who directed a 2002 documentary exploring the real Helmuth Hübener, serves as director, screenwriter, and producer, reconstructing the story based on that film's research into a feature film.

cinema_name: ヒューマントラストシネマ有楽町

movie_title: 進行曲　マーチングボーイズ
movie_title_jp: 進行曲　マーチングボーイズ
country: 台湾 原題または英題：進行曲 Marching Boys
synopsis: 1990年代の台湾を舞台に、マーチングバンド部の活動に青春をかける男子高校生たちの姿を、実話をもとに描いた青春ドラマ。 1990年代の台北。台湾屈指の進学校である建国高校に通うジャン・ハオは、ひとり息子の医学部進学を望む父親の期待を背負い、プレッシャーを抱えながら高校生活を送っていた。そんなある日、彼はマーチングバンド部の活動に興味を持ち、父親に内緒で入部する。天才肌だが自由気ままな問題児のリウ・ジーチュワンや、責任感の強い優等生の部長タイチェンらと共に、部活動に励むジャン・ハオだったが……。 監督は、映画「角頭　彷徨人」やテレビドラマ「We Best Love 永遠の1位／2位の反撃」などで知られるジャン・ルイジー。若手俳優ムー・センが主人公ジャン・ハオを好演し、台湾のアカデミー賞といわれる台湾金馬奨で新人俳優賞にノミネートされた。共演に「セデック・バレ」のマー・ジーシアン。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1992, five years after Taiwan lifted martial law, Jiang, a high school student destined for a top medical college, secretly joins the school’s marching band to chase his passion for music. When the band faces closure due to its outdated focus on martial music, Jiang and his fellow members rally together, determined to save it and reclaim its honor in a prestigious competition.
clean_title_jp: 進行曲 マーチングボーイズ
synopsis_en: A coming-of-age drama based on a true story, set in 1990s Taiwan, depicting high school boys who devote their youth to the activities of a marching band club. In 1990s Taipei. Jiang Hao, who attends Jianguo High School, one of Taiwan's most prestigious schools, lives his high school life under pressure, carrying the expectations of his father who wants his only son to enter medical school. One day, he takes an interest in the marching band club's activities and joins without telling his father. Alongside the naturally gifted but free-spirited troublemaker Liu Zhi-Chuan and the highly responsible honor student and club president Tai-Chen, Jiang Hao throws himself into club activities, but... The director is Jiang Rui-Zhi, known for the film "Gatao: Like Father Like Son" and the TV drama "We Best Love: No. 1 For You / Fighting Mr. 2nd." Young actor Moon Sen gives a fine performance as protagonist Jiang Hao and was nominated for Best New Performer at the Golden Horse Awards, Taiwan's equivalent of the Academy Awards. Ma Zhi-Xiang of "Seediq Bale" co-stars.

country: フランス 原題または英題：La Venue de l'avenir
synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

movie_title: 私たちは、ちょうどいい。
movie_title_jp: 私たちは、ちょうどいい。
director: トレイシー・レイモン
country: アメリカ 原題または英題：Bob Trevino Likes It
synopsis: 疎遠になった父をSNSで探していた女性が、父と同姓同名の見知らぬ男性とかけがえのない友情を育んでいく姿を描いたヒューマンドラマ。本作が長編デビュー作となるトレイシー・レイモンが監督・脚本を手がけ、自身の実体験に着想を得て撮りあげた。 住み込みで友人の介助をしながら暮らすリリー・トレヴィノ。幼い頃に母に捨てられ、父とも疎遠になっていた彼女は、孤独を抱えながら生きていた。そんなある日、電話にも出ない父と連絡を取ろうとSNSで彼を探しはじめたリリーは、父と同姓同名の見知らぬ男性ボブ・トレヴィノに友達申請を送ってしまう。建設会社で働きながら妻ジーニーと支え合って生きてきたボブは心優しく、自分のことよりも相手を優先してしまう性格だった。偶然つながったリリーの孤独に気づいたボブは、彼女にそっと寄り添うようになる。何気ないメッセージのやり取りを重ねていくうちに、リリーとボブの間には少しずつ特別な友情が芽生えはじめる。 テレビドラマ「ユーフォリア EUPHORIA」のバービー・フェレイラがリリー・トレヴィノ、「シェフ　三ツ星フードトラック始めました」のジョン・レグイザモがボブ・トレヴィノを演じた。2024年SXSW（サウス・バイ・サウスウエスト映画祭）で審査員特別賞と観客賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_jp: 住み込みで友人の介助をしながら暮らすリリー・トレヴィノ。 幼い頃に母に捨てられ、父とも疎遠になった彼女は、孤独を抱えながら生きていた。ある日、父と連絡を取ろうと SNS で父を探し始めたリリー。だが、父だと思って友達申請を送った相手は、父と同姓同名の見知らぬ男性、ボブ・トレヴィノだった。 ボブは建設会社で働く心優しい男性。妻ジーニーと支え合いながら生きてきた彼は、自分のことよりも相手を優先してしまう性格だった。偶然つながったリリーの孤独に気づいたボブは、彼女にそっと寄り添いはじめる。 何気ないメッセージのやり取りを重ねるうちに、リリーとボブの間には少しずつ特別な友情が芽生えていく。ただの人違いだったはずの出会いは、やがてふたりにとってかけがえのない居場所になっていく――。
tmdb_overview_en: Lily Trevino unexpectedly befriends an online stranger who shares her self-centered father’s name. This new Bob Trevino’s support could transform her life.
clean_title_jp: 私たちは、ちょうどいい。
synopsis_en: A human drama depicting a woman searching for her estranged father on social media, who instead develops an irreplaceable friendship with a complete stranger sharing her father's exact name. This feature debut by director and screenwriter Tracy Raymond was inspired by her own real-life experiences. Lily Trevino lives as a live-in caregiver for a friend. Abandoned by her mother at a young age and estranged from her father, she lives with loneliness. One day, trying to contact her father who doesn't even answer the phone, she begins searching for him on social media and accidentally sends a friend request to a stranger named Bob Trevino, who shares her father's exact name. Bob, who works at a construction company and lives supporting each other with his wife Jeanie, is kind-hearted and prioritizes others over himself. Noticing Lily's loneliness through their chance connection, Bob gently begins to be there for her. As they exchange casual messages, a special friendship gradually blossoms between Lily and Bob. Barbie Ferreira of the TV series "Euphoria" plays Lily Trevino, and John Leguizamo of "Chef" plays Bob Trevino. The film won the Special Jury Award and the Audience Award at SXSW 2024.

cinema_name: ヒューマントラストシネマ有楽町
country: 韓国
synopsis: 会社を解雇された労働者とその妻。ドキュメンタリー映画監督とその夫。 思いがけず出会った2組の夫婦は、それぞれの隠れた欲望に向き合っていく。 『バーニング 劇場版』のイ・チャンドン監督 8年ぶりの最新作。キャストには、『シークレット・サンシャイン』のチョン・ドヨン、『ペパーミント・キャンディー』『オアシス』のソル・ギョングといったイ・チャンドン監督作で名演を残した二人をはじめ、『パラサイト 半地下の家族』のチョ・ヨジョン、『密輸 1970』やドラマ『ムービング』のチョ・インソンなど豪華キャストが集結。第83回ヴェネツィア国際映画祭コンペティション部門、第51回 トロント国際映画祭スペシャルプレゼンテーション部門に出品されている。
tmdb_overview_jp: まったく異なる人生を歩む2 組の夫婦の交錯する日常を捉え、平穏に見えた日々に少しずつ亀裂が生まれていく様子を描き出す。
tmdb_overview_en: A laid-off worker and his wife cross paths with a documentary filmmaker and her spouse and confront their hidden desires.
synopsis_en: Capturing the intersecting daily lives of two couples leading completely different lives, this depicts how cracks gradually form in days that appeared peaceful.

cinema_name: ヒューマントラストシネマ有楽町
cinema_address: 東京都千代田区有楽町2-7-1 有楽町イトシア・イトシアプラザ 4F
director: マチュー・カソヴィッツ
country: フランス
synopsis: パリ郊外〈バンリュー〉。移⺠や低所得労働者が多く暮らす団地で暴動が発⽣した。ユダヤ系のヴィンツ、アラブ系のサイード、アフリカ系のユベール──異なるルーツを持つ3⼈の若者は、警察による少年への暴⾏事件をきっかけに緊張が⾼まる街で、警官が紛失した⼀丁の拳銃を⼿にする。 1995年、実際に起きた事件に着想を得て製作された『憎しみ』。当時27歳だったマチュー・カソヴィッツが、移⺠系住⺠への差別や貧困、警察による暴⼒といったフランス社会の⽭盾を背景に、鮮烈なモノクロ映像と緊迫感あふれる演出で、⾏き場のない怒りを抱えた若者たちの24時間を描き出した。第48回カンヌ国際映画祭では監督賞を受賞。作品を「反警察的」と受け⽌めた映画祭の警備担当警察官たちが、レッドカーペットを歩く監督・キャストに背を向けて抗議するという異例の出来事も⼤きな話題となった。 主演は、本作で⼀躍世界にその名を知らしめた、当時28歳のヴァンサン・カッセル。坊主頭にストリートファッション、鏡に向かって『タクシードライバー』のトラヴィスを真似るヴィンツ役で強烈な存在感を放ち、その後フランスを代表する俳優のひとりとなった。サイード役にはサイード・タグマウイ、ユベール役にはユベール・クンデ。街を歩き、くだらない冗談を交わし、時に苛⽴ちをぶつけ合う3⼈の姿を、ヒップホップをはじめとする当時のユースカルチャーとともに圧倒的な熱量でスクリーンに刻みつけた。
tmdb_overview_en: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.
director_jp: マチュー・カソヴィッツ
synopsis_en: A drama set in the Paris suburbs in the 1990s, depicting one fateful day in the lives of young people filled with anger and nowhere to direct it. Then-27-year-old Mathieu Kassovitz wrote and directed, inspired by actual events. Against a backdrop of social issues such as discrimination against immigrant residents, poverty, and police violence, it vividly captures 24 hours in the lives of three young people alienated from society through striking black-and-white cinematography and tension-filled direction, winning the Best Director award at the 48th Cannes International Film Festival in 1995. It influenced not only film but also the broader culture of the time, including music and fashion, becoming a youth film representative of 1990s France. movie_title_jp: 進行曲　マーチングボーイズ
country: 台湾 原題または英題：進行曲 Marching Boys
synopsis: 1990年代の台湾を舞台に、マーチングバンド部の活動に青春をかける男子高校生たちの姿を、実話をもとに描いた青春ドラマ。 1990年代の台北。台湾屈指の進学校である建国高校に通うジャン・ハオは、ひとり息子の医学部進学を望む父親の期待を背負い、プレッシャーを抱えながら高校生活を送っていた。そんなある日、彼はマーチングバンド部の活動に興味を持ち、父親に内緒で入部する。天才肌だが自由気ままな問題児のリウ・ジーチュワンや、責任感の強い優等生の部長タイチェンらと共に、部活動に励むジャン・ハオだったが……。 監督は、映画「角頭　彷徨人」やテレビドラマ「We Best Love 永遠の1位／2位の反撃」などで知られるジャン・ルイジー。若手俳優ムー・センが主人公ジャン・ハオを好演し、台湾のアカデミー賞といわれる台湾金馬奨で新人俳優賞にノミネートされた。共演に「セデック・バレ」のマー・ジーシアン。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1992, five years after Taiwan lifted martial law, Jiang, a high school student destined for a top medical college, secretly joins the school’s marching band to chase his passion for music. When the band faces closure due to its outdated focus on martial music, Jiang and his fellow members rally together, determined to save it and reclaim its honor in a prestigious competition.
clean_title_jp: 進行曲 マーチングボーイズ
synopsis_en: A coming-of-age drama based on a true story, set in 1990s Taiwan, depicting high school boys who devote their youth to the activities of a marching band club. In 1990s Taipei. Jiang Hao, who attends Jianguo High School, one of Taiwan's most prestigious schools, lives his high school life under pressure, carrying the expectations of his father who wants his only son to enter medical school. One day, he takes an interest in the marching band club's activities and joins without telling his father. Alongside the naturally gifted but free-spirited troublemaker Liu Zhi-Chuan and the highly responsible honor student and club president Tai-Chen, Jiang Hao throws himself into club activities, but... The director is Jiang Rui-Zhi, known for the film "Gatao: Like Father Like Son" and the TV drama "We Best Love: No. 1 For You / Fighting Mr. 2nd." Young actor Moon Sen gives a fine performance as protagonist Jiang Hao and was nominated for Best New Performer at the Golden Horse Awards, Taiwan's equivalent of the Academy Awards. Ma Zhi-Xiang of "Seediq Bale" co-stars.

country: フランス 原題または英題：La Venue de l'avenir
synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

movie_title: 真実と反逆 〜ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス〜
movie_title_jp: 真実と反逆 ～ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス～
country: リトアニア・アメリカ
synopsis:
沈黙することが「忠誠」、真実を語ることは「反逆」とされたナチス政権下のドイツで、反逆罪で処刑された実在の〝最年少レジスタンス〟ヘルムス・ヒューべナー（1925年-1942年没）。本作は実際に起きた抵抗運動を題材に、「国家の圧力」と「自らの信念」との激しい衝突を描く真実のヒューマンドラマである。史実をなぞるだけに留まらない。〝言葉〟を武器に戦った若者たちの固い友情、捜査や裁判が進むにつれて高まる緊迫感、そして愛する人々へ抱く切なる想い──。多層的なドラマにあらゆる感情がかき立てられ、心の奥に深い余韻が刻まれていく。
1941年、第二次世界大戦下のドイツ。16歳の少年ヘルムス・ヒューベナー（ユアン・ホロックス）は、通っている教会でナチス政権への服従を促され、ヒトラーの圧政に疑問を抱く。ユダヤ人迫害に直面したことをきっかけに、禁止されていた海外ラジオ放送を秘かに聴いた彼は、国家が隠し続けてきた戦争の実態や残虐行為を知ってしまう。正義感に突き動かされたヘルムスは、親友二人を仲間に加え、国家の嘘を暴くビラを町中に配布し、人々に真実を伝えていく。しかしその行為は死刑に値する反逆罪だった。秘密国家警察の捜査が迫るなか、彼らの勇気ある行動は、やがて逃れられない運命へと突き進んでいく──。
tmdb_overview_en: In 1941 Nazi Germany, 16-year-old Helmuth Hübener begins questioning the regime after learning the truth about the war and seeing his Jewish friend persecuted. With two friends, he secretly listens to banned foreign broadcasts and distributes leaflets exposing Nazi lies. As the Gestapo closes in, the teenagers face mounting danger for choosing conscience over obedience. Based on the true story of one of Germany’s youngest resistance fighters.
clean_title_jp: 真実と反逆 ～ナチスと闘った若きレジスタンス～
synopsis_en: A human drama set in Germany during World War II, depicting the life-risking struggle of a young resistance fighter who stood up to tell the truth about the Nazis. Based on Helmuth Hübener, the youngest real-life resistance member executed for treason under the Nazi regime, it portrays the fierce clash between 'state pressure' and 'personal conviction.' In 1941, Germany during World War II. Sixteen-year-old Helmuth Hübener is urged at church to submit to the Nazi regime and begins to question Hitler's tyranny. After witnessing the persecution of Jews, he listens to forbidden foreign radio broadcasts and learns of the war's true state and atrocities that the state had kept hidden. Driven by a sense of justice, Helmuth recruits two close friends and distributes leaflets exposing the state's lies throughout town, spreading the truth to the people. But that act was treason, punishable by death. As the Secret State Police close in, their courageous actions hurtle toward an inescapable fate. Matt Whitaker, who directed a 2002 documentary exploring the real Helmuth Hübener, serves as director, screenwriter, and producer, reconstructing the story based on that film's research into a feature film.

country: フランス
synopsis: パリ郊外〈バンリュー〉。移⺠や低所得労働者が多く暮らす団地で暴動が発⽣した。ユダヤ系のヴィンツ、アラブ系のサイード、アフリカ系のユベール──異なるルーツを持つ3⼈の若者は、警察による少年への暴⾏事件をきっかけに緊張が⾼まる街で、警官が紛失した⼀丁の拳銃を⼿にする。 1995年、実際に起きた事件に着想を得て製作された『憎しみ』。当時27歳だったマチュー・カソヴィッツが、移⺠系住⺠への差別や貧困、警察による暴⼒といったフランス社会の⽭盾を背景に、鮮烈なモノクロ映像と緊迫感あふれる演出で、⾏き場のない怒りを抱えた若者たちの24時間を描き出した。第48回カンヌ国際映画祭では監督賞を受賞。作品を「反警察的」と受け⽌めた映画祭の警備担当警察官たちが、レッドカーペットを歩く監督・キャストに背を向けて抗議するという異例の出来事も⼤きな話題となった。 主演は、本作で⼀躍世界にその名を知らしめた、当時28歳のヴァンサン・カッセル。坊主頭にストリートファッション、鏡に向かって『タクシードライバー』のトラヴィスを真似るヴィンツ役で強烈な存在感を放ち、その後フランスを代表する俳優のひとりとなった。サイード役にはサイード・タグマウイ、ユベール役にはユベール・クンデ。街を歩き、くだらない冗談を交わし、時に苛⽴ちをぶつけ合う3⼈の姿を、ヒップホップをはじめとする当時のユースカルチャーとともに圧倒的な熱量でスクリーンに刻みつけた。
tmdb_overview_en: After a chaotic night of rioting in a marginal suburb of Paris, three young friends, Vinz, Hubert and Saïd, wander around unoccupied waiting for news about the state of health of a mutual friend who has been seriously injured when confronting the police.

country: 日本
synopsis: 宗教家の大川隆法による原作をもとに、シンデレラストーリーや一獲千金の誘惑に翻弄される女性の姿を通して、「本当の幸福とは何か」を問いかけるドラマ。 都内の広告代理店に勤める平凡な女性・河合夕子は、未来が開けていない現実に小さな焦りを感じながらも、お金持ちのイケメンとの結婚を夢見ていた。28歳を目前にしたある日、夕子は夜道で偶然出くわした八卦見（占い師）に、「今夜、最初に会う人にイエスと言うかノーと言うかで、あなたの運命は大きく変わる」と告げられる。その直後、怪しげな黒マントの男が夕子に声をかけ、影を売るだけで1年間どんな願いもかなえてくれると持ちかける。夕子は深く考えずに誘いに乗り、自分の影を男に売ってしまう。影をなくした夕子には、不思議な幸運が次々と舞い込むようになるが……。 「夜明けを信じて。」などの長谷川奈央が夕子役で映画単独初主演を務め、青木涼、田中宏明、芦川よしみ、目黒祐樹、田村亮が共演。「二十歳に還りたい。」の赤羽博監督がメガホンをとった。
synopsis_en: A drama based on an original work by religious figure Ryuho Okawa, questioning "what true happiness is" through the story of a woman tossed about by the temptations of a Cinderella story and sudden wealth. Yuko Kawai, an ordinary woman working at an advertising agency in Tokyo, feels a small sense of impatience at her reality with no open future, yet dreams of marrying a wealthy handsome man. One day, just before turning 28, Yuko is told by a fortune-teller she happens to encounter on a night street, "Whether you say yes or no to the first person you meet tonight will greatly change your destiny." Immediately after, a suspicious man in a black cloak approaches Yuko and offers to grant any wish for one year if she simply sells her shadow. Without thinking deeply, Yuko takes him up on the offer and sells her shadow. Mysterious good fortune begins pouring in for the shadowless Yuko, but then... Nao Hasegawa of "Believing in the Dawn" makes her solo film debut in the lead role as Yuko, with Ryo Aoki, Hiroaki Tanaka, Yoshimi Ashikawa, Yuki Meguro, and Ryo Tamura co-starring. Hiroshi Akabane of "I Want to Go Back to 20" directs.

country: 日本
synopsis: 「ハイキック・ガール！」「KG カラテガール」など数々のアクション映画で活躍してきた武田梨奈が、暗殺者役で主演を務めたクライムアクション。 天涯孤独のレイは、小さな海辺の町で時計の修理屋として働きながら、ひっそりと暮らしている。しかし彼女の正体は凄腕の暗殺者で、バーの店主から殺しの依頼を受けては確実に標的を仕留めてきた。一方、幼少期をレイと施設で共に過ごした男も同じ町に住んでおり、彼女のライバルとして暗殺業をこなしていた。レイは町にやってきたある男と宿命の出会いを果たし、彼に惹かれていく。 主人公レイ役の武田がCG・ワイヤーなしでバトルアクションとガンアクションを熱演し、レイと宿命の出会いを果たす男をダンス＆ボーカルグループ「FANTASTICS」の瀬口黎弥、レイと同じ裏社会に生きる孤独な暗殺者を萩原聖人が演じる。共演に嶋田久作、有森也実、特別出演に布施博。監督・脚本は「ニート・ニート・ニート」「殺る女」の宮野ケイジ。
tmdb_overview_en: The story revolves around Rei ( Rina Takeda ), a watch repair woman who lives a quiet life in a small seaside town. However, she is actually a skilled and lethal assassin who carries out jobs for the local bar owner ( Kyusaku Shimada ), moving like a shadow and eliminating criminal agitators from various organizations. One day, a man ( Leiya Seguchi ) arrives in the village, and Rei finds herself drawn to him. It was a fated encounter, one that will seal their fate and condemn them to a situation where only one will remain standing.
synopsis_en: This is a hard-boiled opera—a rarity in Japan—brought to you by Rina Takeda, known as one of Japan's foremost action stars and accomplished actresses, FANTASTICS performer Reiya Seguchi, and Masato Hagiwara. Takeda plays a woman who has lived the fate of an assassin. Here Takeda unleashes her full potential, performing battle action and gun action without CG or wires. Co-starring is Seguchi, a performer in the dance-and-vocal group FANTASTICS, who takes on the role of a man tossed about by the threads of fate with Rei, played by Takeda. In addition, Hagiwara plays a lonely assassin who lives in the same underworld as Rei, and these characters fuse with the beautiful sea and nostalgic townscape of Kozushima (in the Izu Islands) to create a noir action film. The supporting cast is also luxurious, with Kyusaku Shimada, Narimi Arimori, and a special appearance by Hiroshi Fuse in key roles. Music is handled by Jaw Maran, a singer-songwriter who produces in New York and Los Angeles and excels at R&B spanning Asia including Japan, Korea, China, and Burma. What greatly enhances the film's noir action is Keiji Tsujii, who has swept through Japan's action world, delivering fight scenes too fast for the eye to follow. Director Keiji Miyano brings all these attractions together into a hard-boiled opera that fuses a story confronting one's outlook on life with action and magnificent locations. Rei (Takeda), a watch repairer, is all alone in the world, quietly living in a small seaside town. But her real profession is assassin. Taking assassination requests from Ito (Shimada), the owner of a certain bar, she is a highly skilled assassin who finishes off her targets. In the same town, Kaji (Hagiwara), a fellow assassin who spent time with her in a facility as a child, also plies the trade as a formidable rival. Rei shadows and takes down members of a group engaged in evil deeds, but one day she finds herself drawn to a man named Shunsuke (Seguchi) who visits the town. It is a fated encounter—and the arrival of a destiny in which one of them must leave this world.

cinema_name: ヒューマントラストシネマ渋谷
cinema_address: 東京都渋谷区渋谷1-23-16 ココチビル 7・8F
country: 日本
synopsis: 「ミッシング」「空白」「ヒメアノ～ル」の𠮷田恵輔が監督・脚本を手がけ、過去に囚われたまま大人になった2人の青年と、彼らの運命を狂わせていく「メンター（助言者）」の存在を描いた人間ドラマ。 ある日、龍之介と拓海という2人の少年の無邪気な花火遊びが、アパート火災を引き起こした。アパートは全焼し、巻き込まれた住人の埜本は妻子を失い自身も全身に火傷を負った。その日を境に、龍之介と拓海の時間は止まってしまう。15年後、龍之介は罪の意識に蓋をし、アーチェリーのオリンピック日本代表候補として前に進もうとしていた。その一方で、拓海は罪の記憶から抜け出せず、陰鬱な日々を過ごしていた。そんな2人の前に、埜本が突然姿を現す。2人に恨みの言葉をぶつけることもなく優しく接する埜本に、龍之介はどこか違和感を抱き、拓海は救いの光を見いだす。やがて埜本は、拓海にとって心の拠りどころとなるメンターのような存在となっていく。 「ヤクザと家族 The Family」「月」などの磯村勇斗が龍之介役、アイドルグループ「Aぇ！ group」のメンバーで本作が個人として初の映画主演となる末澤誠也が拓海役で主演を務め、物語の鍵を握るメンターの埜本役で綾野剛が共演。
tmdb_overview_jp: 15年前の夏に起きたある火災事故から始まる。少年の無邪気な花火遊びがアパートを全焼させ、黒焦げの妻を抱えた男・埜本（のもと）が、燃えさかるアパートの一室から姿を現す。あまりにも強烈な記憶を前に、当事者であった少年たち——龍之介と拓海の時間は、あの日を境に止まってしまった。  やがて大人になった二人は、まったく異なる道を歩んでいる。龍之介（磯村勇斗）は罪に蓋をし、アーチェリーのオリンピック日本代表候補として前へ進もうとする。一方、拓海（末澤誠也）はいまだ罪の記憶から抜け出せず、陰鬱な日々に立ちすくんでいた。そんな二人の前に、あの火傷の男・埜本が再び現れる。しかし彼は恨みの言葉を口にすることなく、「君はもう、充分に償ったよ」と静かに語りかける。不気味なほどに優しいその姿は、やがて彼らにとっての “mentor／メンター”（助言者・導き手）となっていく——。
tmdb_overview_en: Fifteen years ago, an innocent fireworks accident caused by two boys, Ryunosuke and Takumi, destroyed an apartment building. One resident, Nomoto, lost his wife and child in the fire and suffered severe burns across his body. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke tries to live a "normal" life while suppressing his guilt, whereas Takumi remains emotionally trapped in the past. When Nomoto suddenly reappears before them, the expected confrontation never comes. Instead, he shows an unsettling kindness—one that deeply disturbs Ryunosuke, yet offers a fragile sense of salvation to Takumi. As their paths cross once again in a reunion that should never have happened, the lives of these three individuals begin to shift in ways that will irrevocably alter their futures.
synopsis_en: A human drama directed and written by Keisuke Yoshida of "Missing," "Blank," and "Himeanole," depicting two young men who grew up trapped by their past and the "mentor" figure who sends their fates spiraling. One day, two boys named Ryunosuke and Takumi's innocent fireworks play causes an apartment fire. The apartment burns to the ground, and a resident caught in the blaze, Nomoto, loses his wife and child and suffers burns over his entire body. From that day on, time stops for Ryunosuke and Takumi. Fifteen years later, Ryunosuke has sealed away his guilt and is trying to move forward as a candidate for Japan's Olympic archery team. Takumi, meanwhile, cannot escape the memory of his sin and lives out gloomy days. Suddenly, Nomoto appears before the two. Ryunosuke feels a sense of unease at Nomoto's gentle treatment of them, without ever hurling words of resentment, while Takumi finds a glimmer of salvation. Eventually, Nomoto becomes a mentor-like figure and emotional anchor for Takumi. Hayato Isomura of "Yakuza and the Family" and "Moon" plays Ryunosuke, and Seiya Suezawa, a member of the idol group "Ae! group" making his first solo film lead, plays Takumi, with Go Ayano co-starring as the mentor Nomoto, who holds the key to the story.

synopsis: ふたりの少年の30年にわたる友情と再会を通して、人が生きることの意味を静かに問いかけた長編アニメーション映画。 平成の日本の田舎町。自分が“普通”であることに悩む小学3年生の内気な少年・翼は、クラスの人気者で“特別”な存在である暁太郎と出会い、親友になる。ふたりだけの遊びや意味のない会話、夕暮れの帰り道など、小さな世界の中でかけがえのない時間を過ごす翼と暁太郎だったが、日常は少しずつ歪みはじめる。暁太郎はクラスの中で浮いた存在となり、噂や視線が彼を囲むようになる。翼はその変化に気づきながらも、何も言えず、何もしないという選択を重ねてしまう。やがて取り返しのつかない事件が起こり、ふたりの関係は大きく変わっていく。 YOASOBI「優しい彗星」のMVなどを手がけたアニメーション作家・門脇康平が長編初監督を務め、緻密な世界観と写実的な映像表現で描き出す。“普通”の青年・翼役で坂東龍汰、“特別”な存在の暁太郎役で岡山天音が声優を務め、オーディションで選ばれた槙木悠人と中込佑玖が幼少期の翼と暁太郎の声をそれぞれ担当。音楽プロデューサーのYaffleが音楽を手がけた。2026年・第39回東京国際映画祭「アニメーション」部門上映作品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 小学三年生の夏、内気な少年のつばさは、クラスの人気者である暁太郎と出会い、親友になる。小さな世界の中で、かけがえのない時間を過ごしていくふたり。しかし、ある些細な事件をきっかけに、ふたりの関係は引き裂かれて——。  30年以上にわたる少年たちの友情と再会を通して、人が生きることの意味を静かに問いかける物語。
tmdb_overview_en: One summer in the third grade, a quiet boy named Tsubasa meets Gyotaro, a boy everyone in the class looked up to, and the two become close friends. Within their small world, they share irreplaceable moments—until a small incident suddenly tears them apart.
genres: サイエンスフィクション
synopsis_en: "Pipiro rirori ro. Secret mission on Earth complete. Returning to space!" In a certain rural town in the Heisei era, Tsubasa, a shy boy troubled by being "ordinary," meets Akitaro, the class idol and a "special" presence, in the spring of his third year of elementary school, and they become best friends. Games just for the two of them, meaningless conversations, the walk home at dusk—— The world was certainly theirs. But from a certain day onward, Akitaro became an outcast in the class, and rumors and stares surrounded him. Eventually, an irreversible incident occurs. "Hey, what would you do if I were an alien?" Is this a coming-of-age story of two people, or a memory they want to erase? A story of a friendship spanning 30 years, an endlessly blue tale of departure——
