synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the sequel to the original work, directed by Suzuki, who wrote the screenplay for "The Unruly Guys Behind Bars." Inmates whose sole purpose in life is playing softball during breaks dream of a legendary match against the guards that once took place in the prison... The cast of inmates is wonderfully unique!

synopsis: かいせつ ヤクザの家業を継がずに銀行マンになったトオル(仲村)は、仕事も恋も順風満帆だったが、やがて思いもしない抗争に巻き込まれてしまう―。小林信彦の短編を森田が大胆に脚色し映画化した、一風変わったヤクザ映画。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Despite his efforts of living a normal life as a banker, the life of Toru, the only son of the Yubari Family, becomes disrupted by trouble brought on by his father. When his father’s battle against his rival group the Miike Family ignites, Toru becomes more involved in the turf war than he wished for.
synopsis_en: Toru (Nakamura), who became a bank employee instead of inheriting the family yakuza business, had everything going well in both work and love, but eventually gets caught up in an unexpected gang war. A quirky yakuza film adapted for the screen by Morita, who boldly reworked Kobayashi Nobuhiko's short story.

synopsis: かいせつ 「ヤングジャンプ」に連載された人気漫画を、人気絶頂のアイドル二人の主演で映画化。革ジャンが似合うイカした美人教師・エリーと男子生徒との、禁断の恋の駆け引きを描く。80年代の大人びた若者達の、今見ると驚きの習性も見所。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Based on the comic by Mako Takami.
synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the popular manga serialized in "Young Jump," starring two idols at the peak of their popularity. It depicts the forbidden love game between a cool, beautiful teacher named Ellie who looks great in a leather jacket and a male student. The surprisingly mature habits of 80s youth, which are shocking when viewed today, are also a highlight.

director: セドリック・クラピッシュ
country: フランス 原題または英題：La Venue de l'avenir
synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

tmdb_overview_en: A publishing company is working on a book about Umezu’s life. The lead editor, Sakura, knows that Umezu’s late mother Ichie was very influential to his work. As the investigation continues, bizarre incidents begin occurring one after another. Soon, the grudge of a mother who should be dead sparks mounting fear around Umezu.

cinema_address: 神奈川県逗子市新宿1-5-14
tmdb_overview_en: Matthias is a master of pretense, from cultured boyfriend to perfect son or marital coach. He makes a career of being someone else. The real challenge begins when he has to be himself.
synopsis_en: A perfect son, a cultured lover, a thug for those who want to play hero on a date—'My Companion' is an agency that provides ideal individuals for any situation. Matthias, their top performer, perfectly plays the required roles, living through various personalities every day. However, when his girlfriend Sofia tells him 'I don't feel the real you' and they break up, his perfect mask begins to quietly peel away. Furthermore, an unexpected incident with a client causes Matthias's gears to gradually start grinding, and eventually the boundary between reality and fiction becomes blurred...

country: 韓国 原題または英題：The Ugly
synopsis: 「新感染　ファイナル・エクスプレス」のヨン・サンホ監督が2018年に発表した自身初のグラフィックノベルを映画化したサスペンスミステリー。 生まれつき目が見えないハンデを乗り越え、著名な篆刻家（てんこくか）となったイム・ヨンギュ。息子のドンファンは偉大な父を敬い、事業を陰ながら支えていた。そんなドンファンに、警察から40年前に消息不明になった母チョン・ヨンヒの遺体が地中深くから発見されたとの知らせが届く。ヨンヒは何者かに殺された可能性があるという。あるドキュメンタリー番組のプロデューサーの提案で、ドンファンは母の死の真相を探り始める。調査を進める中で、ドンファンはヨンヒが「醜い顔」をしていたという証言を次々と耳にし、ショックに打ちひしがれる。やがて、ドンファンは母の死をめぐるある事実に直面する。 「ただ悪より救いたまえ」「密輸 1970」のパク・ジョンミンが主人公ドンファン役を務めたほか、回想シーンに登場する若き日のヨンギュ役も演じた。父ヨンギュ役は「小川のほとりで」のクォン・ヘヒョ、ヨンヒ役はヨン監督のNetflix映画「啓示」のシン・ヒョンビンが担当した。
tmdb_overview_en: One day while overseeing a documentary crew filming his blind father at work, Im Dong-hwan gets a phone call that his missing mother’s remains have been found after forty years. Determined to find the truth of her disappearance, Dong-hwan embarks on a twisted odyssey through his family’s traumatic past, uncovering dark secrets along the way.
synopsis_en: Yeong-gyu is a blind seal engraver who carves the most beautiful stamps in South Korea. To his son Dong-hwan, his father was 'a miracle itself.' But one day, the skeletal remains of his mother Yeong-hui, who disappeared 40 years ago, are discovered—and it holds the potential of being a 'murder.' To uncover the truth behind the death of the mother whose face he never knew, Dong-hwan traces the testimonies of those who knew her. Yet, all he hears are strange words: 'She had a face as ugly as a monster.' Why was his mother so disparaged? Is it the truth, or a distorted memory? What eventually emerges is not the 'face' of one woman, but the prejudice, malice, and collective madness lurking within humanity. The moment the sealed truth is revealed, a powerful shock that will go down in film history strikes the audience!

country: 日本
synopsis: 「佐々木、イン、マイマイン」「若き見知らぬ者たち」の内山拓也監督が、北村匠海を主演に迎えて撮りあげた自伝的作品。内山監督の故郷である新潟県を舞台に、自身の居場所とアイデンティティを模索する孤独な少年が、息をのむような大きな愛を知るまでの20年間を描く。 日本海沿いの町に暮らす少年・大地は、幼少期に暴君のようだった父の影響で言葉を発することができない。現在は母の亜樹と雑居ビル屋上のプレハブに暮らしているが、水商売で生計を立てる母はほとんど家に帰らず、生活も苦しい。やがて大地は亜樹とともに叔母の家に身を寄せるが、彼の居場所はどこにもなく、ひとりで過ごすうちに内気になっていく。そんなある日、父の行方を求めて生家を訪ねたことをきっかけに、大地の運命は大きく揺らぎはじめる。 主人公・大地の青年期を北村匠海が演じ、自分のもとを離れた父への静かな怒りと、母に対する憎しみと愛という相反する感情に揺れる心の内を体現。大地の母・亜樹を宮沢りえ、父・大原を永瀬正敏、大地の少年期を榎本司、加藤庵次、穐本陽月の3人が演じた。2025年・第26回東京フィルメックスのコンペティション部門で審査員特別賞を受賞。また、第76回ベルリン国際映画祭パノラマ部門にも正式出品された。
synopsis_en: Director Takuya Uchiyama, who swept newcomer awards at film festivals with "Sasaki, In, My Mind" and continued with "Young Strangers," consistently gazing at the youth of young people resisting reality and trying to grasp something, leaving a vivid impression on the film world, releases this passionate work—an autobiographical film set in his hometown of Niigata in winter, telling the story of a boy searching for a place to belong and his identity. Playing the adolescent protagonist Daichi is Takumi Kitamura. He brilliantly embodies the quiet anger toward his father who left him and his mother, and the heart wavering between love and hatred—contradictory emotions—toward his mother who raised him single-handedly. As his mother Aki, Rie Miyazawa gives her all to portray a mother whose innocent nature creates a life that instills loneliness in Daichi, yet whose every detail reveals a certain tenderness toward her son. And as his father Ohara, Masatoshi Nagase, with full maturity, shows a man who transforms from a tyrannical figure into one living out a sorrowful remaining life. Also, as the young Daichi, Tsukasa Enomoto, Anji Kato, and Hazuki Akimoto each express the loneliness, love, and life force swirling deep in his heart with innocent yet powerful gazes, driving the entire story forward. Daichi, a boy living in a town along the Sea of Japan, stopped speaking due to the influence of his father, who was like a tyrant during his early childhood. He now lives with his mother Aki, but Aki, forced to make a living through night work, rarely comes home, and their life is hard. Eventually they move in with his aunt, but he has no place anywhere, and spending time alone, he grew introverted. Daichi decides to visit his old home in search of his father's whereabouts. From this point on, his fate is greatly shaken——— Poverty with no emotional anchor, small salvation amid the loneliness of living so as not to be found by anyone, complicated feelings toward his mother. Daichi seems to live as if being swept along, yet he never stops walking. The 20 years until he grasps a faint light and comes to know a breathtaking, immense love are depicted through a perspective rooted in realism, following the boy's figure throughout.

country: 日本
synopsis: スマホに触れている時だけ見える透明な怪物に狙われた少女の物語を没入感たっぷりに描いた青春ホラー。2021年の縦型短編映画「スマホラー！」で注目を集めた西山将貴監督が長編初メガホンをとり、自身が学生時代に抱えていた孤独や居場所のなさといった“影”を物語の核に、構想から6年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 ミックスルーツを持つエレナは、田舎町の高校に転校するがクラスになじめず、明るく話しかけてくる隣席のアカリにも心を開くことができずにいた。そんな中、スマホにつながったイヤホンを常に手放さないクラスの問題児・猫歌（にゃん）の死をきっかけに、エレナの周囲で奇妙な現象が起こりはじめる。イヤホンを通じて聞こえる足音と、スマホを手にしている時だけ見える「怪物」に常に追いかけられるようになったエレナは、やがて猫歌のようにスマホを手放せなくなってしまう。 自身も14歳から映画制作を続ける監督で俳優のシエラ璃砂がエレナ役で主演を務め、エレナの友人アカリを奥野みゆ、クラスの問題児・猫歌を平澤瑠菜が演じた。VFXを担当するのは、これまで西山監督の全作品でタッグを組み、アカデミー賞視覚効果賞を受賞した「ゴジラ－1.0」のCG制作にも参加したCao Moji（佐藤昭一郎）。イギリスの第33回レインダンス映画祭にて国際長編映画賞にノミネート。
synopsis_en:
An immersive youth horror film, this story follows a young girl targeted by a transparent monster visible only when she touches her smartphone. Director Masaki Nishiyama, who garnered attention for his 2021 vertical short film *Sma-Horror!*, makes his feature-length debut with this project. Drawing from the "shadows" of loneliness and alienation he felt during his own student years, Nishiyama spent six years bringing this vision to life.

Elena, a girl of mixed heritage, transfers to a high school in a rural town. Struggling to fit in, she finds herself unable to open up to Akari, a cheerful classmate who tries to befriend her. However, following the death of the class troublemaker, Nyan—who was never seen without earphones plugged into her phone—strange phenomena begin to occur around Elena. Haunted by footsteps heard through her earphones and pursued by a "monster" visible only when she holds her smartphone, Elena soon finds herself unable to let go of her device, just like Nyan.

Sierra Risa, an actor and director who has been making films since age 14, stars as Elena. Miyu Okuno plays her friend Akari, while Runa Hirasawa portrays the troubled Nyan. The VFX are handled by Cao Moji (Shoichiro Sato), a long-time collaborator of Nishiyama who also contributed to the CG for the Academy Award-winning *Godzilla Minus One*. The film was nominated for Best International Feature at the 33rd Raindance Film Festival in the UK.

country: 日本・フランス・シンガポール・フィリピン合作
synopsis: 「淵に立つ」「恋愛裁判」などの深田晃司監督が、松たか子を主演に迎えて撮りあげた人間ドラマ。第39回岸田國士戯曲賞を受賞した平田オリザの代表作「東京ノート」に着想を得て、深田監督自らオリジナル脚本を執筆。「東京ノート」の精神を受け継ぎつつ、岡山県奈義町をモデルにした「ナギ」を舞台に新たな物語を描き、企画の立ち上げから9年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 自然豊かな町・ナギで、ひとり創作に打ち込む彫刻家の寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍する友梨が数日間の休暇をとり、別れた夫の姉である寄子のもとを訪れる。若くして妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみ・好浩、息子の春樹とその親友・圭太など、人々との出会いは穏やかな日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。友梨は寄子の彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで彼女の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨自身にも変化が起こりはじめる。 深田監督とは初タッグとなる松たか子が、癒えない喪失を抱えながら彫刻制作に没頭する寄子という複雑なキャラクターを体現。寄子の彫刻のモデルをつとめる友梨を石橋静河、寄子の幼なじみで役場に勤める好浩を松山ケンイチが演じる。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.

synopsis: . 愛に国境はない。けれど、世界は私たちに国境を弾く . ヒットや流行のためではなく、たった一人の心を深く揺さぶるために生まれた映画レーベルの記念すべき第一作が、『LEONIDAS』がついに公開！その製作総指揮は本作の脚本・原案・劇中歌を担当したTOH YUSEI。短編『忘れられない』が世界10カ国以上で国際映画賞を受賞している 橘潤樹 が、監督・脚本・編集を務める初長編作。在日韓国人青年の葛藤と希望を通して、“境界(ボーダー)”の意味を静かに、そして力強く問いかける。第47回モスクワ国際映画祭、2025年横浜国際映画祭への選出を経て放たれる本作は、華やかさを競うための映画ではない。 「商業ではなく、心に届く映画をつくる」—— その信念をかたちにしたのがBROADWAY CINEMAの出発点である。 主人公・ヒロを演じるのは、『ハードタイムズ』『卍リバース』で圧倒的な存在感を放つ門間航。ヒロイン・アオイ役には、『相対性長屋論』などで国際的注目を集める永田凜。さらに仲野温、モクタール、SASHINI、朝香賢徹ら実力派キャストが脇を固め、物語に深い厚みを与えている。編集には、『ゴジラ-1.0』『永遠の0』で日本アカデミー賞最優秀編集賞を多数受賞している宮島竜治が参画し、世界標準の映像クオリティを実現。製作はクリエイティブアートカンパニー10NY、制作は『四月の永い夢』『静かな雨』などで国際的評価の高いTokyo New Cinemaが担当する。『LEONIDAS』は、レーベルの誕生を告げる作品であり、これから羽ばたく才能たちのはじまりの物語でもある。 . .
tmdb_overview_en: Hiro, a young Korean man in Japan, meets Aoi, a digital artist from a wealthy but restrictive family. As their relationship deepens, they visit a charkha studio, inspiring Hiro to create music again. Aoi rejects her family’s corporate expectations and stays at Hiro’s mother’s house. When Hiro gets an unexpected music opportunity in New York, they plan to go together, but Aoi’s father pressures them to separate.
synopsis_en: . Love has no borders. Yet the world makes us play with borders. . Not for hits or trends, but born to deeply move the heart of just one person—the commemorative first work of a film label, 'LEONIDAS,' is finally released! The executive producer is TOH YUSEI, who handled the screenplay, original concept, and in-film song for this work. Junki Tachibana, whose short film 'Unforgettable' has won international film awards in more than 10 countries, serves as director, screenwriter, and editor in his first feature-length work. Through the conflicts and hopes of a young Zainichi Korean man, it quietly and powerfully questions the meaning of 'borders.' Selected for the 47th Moscow International Film Festival and the 2025 Yokohama International Film Festival, this work is not a film meant to compete for glamour. 'To make films that reach the heart, not for commerce'—giving form to that conviction is the starting point of BROADWAY CINEMA. The protagonist Hiro is played by Wataru Monma, who showed overwhelming presence in 'Hard Times' and 'Manji Reverse.' The heroine Aoi is played by Rin Nagata, who has drawn international attention in works such as 'Relativity Nagaya Theory.' Furthermore, accomplished cast members including Atsushi Nakano, Mokutaru, SASHINI, and Kentetsu Asaka round out the supporting roles, giving the story deep richness. Editor Ryuji Miyajima, who has won numerous Japan Academy Prize Best Editing Awards for 'Godzilla Minus One' and 'The Eternal Zero,' participates in editing, realizing world-standard visual quality. Production is handled by creative art company 10NY, with production by Tokyo New Cinema, highly acclaimed internationally for works such as 'The Long Dream of April' and 'Silent Rain.' 'LEONIDAS' is the work that announces the birth of the label, and also the story of the beginning of talents about to take flight. . .

country: フランス・日本・ドイツ・ベルギー合作
synopsis: 「ドライブ・マイ・カー」「悪は存在しない」の濱口竜介監督が、パリを舞台に同じ名前の響きを持つ女性2人の魂の邂逅を描いたドラマ。がんの転移を経験しながら生き抜く哲学者・宮野真生子と、臨床現場の調査を積み重ねた人類学者・磯野真穂が交わした20通の往復書簡「急に具合が悪くなる」を原作に、偶然出会った2人の女性の交流と世界に対峙する姿を描き出す。 パリ郊外の介護施設「自由の庭」で施設長を務めるマリー＝ルー・フォンテーヌは、入居者を人間らしくケアすることを理想としながらも、人手不足やスタッフの無理解に悩まされていた。そんな中、日本人の舞台演出家・森崎真理と出会ったマリー＝ルーは、がん闘病中の彼女が描く演劇に勇気をもらう。同じ名前の響きを持つ偶然に導かれて交流を始める真理とマリー＝ルーだったが、あるとき真理は急に具合が悪くなる。真理の病の進行とともに2人の関係は深まり、互いの魂を通わせ合うようになっていく。 「ベネデッタ」のビルジニー・エフィラがマリー＝ルー、「ウルヴァリン：SAMURAI」などハリウッド映画にも出演する世界的ファッションモデルのTAOこと岡本多緒が真理を演じ、真理が演出する舞台の出演俳優・清宮吾朗役で「敵」の名優・長塚京三、吾朗の孫・窪寺智樹役で「見はらし世代」の注目若手俳優・黒崎煌代が共演。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、ビルジニー・エフィラと岡本多緒がそろって女優賞を受賞。岡本は日本人で初のカンヌ国際映画祭女優賞受賞を果たした。
tmdb_overview_jp: パリ郊外の介護施設「自由の庭」で施設長を務めるマリー＝ルー・フォンテーヌは、入居者を人間らしくケアすることを理想としながらも、人手不足やスタッフの無理解に悩まされていた。そんな中、日本人の舞台演出家・森崎真理と出会ったマリー＝ルーは、がん闘病中の彼女が描く演劇に勇気をもらう。同じ名前の響きを持つ偶然に導かれて交流を始める真理とマリー＝ルーだったが、あるとき真理は急に具合が悪くなる。真理の病の進行とともに2人の関係は深まり、互いの魂を通わせ合うようになっていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of a nursing home in the Paris suburbs, defies convention by adopting the 'Humanitude' method despite her team’s resistance. Her encounter with Mari Morisaki, a terminally ill Japanese playwright, transforms her life. Together, they turn the facility into a symbol of resistance and humanity against the system’s limits.
synopsis_en: Director Ryusuke Hamaguchi ("Drive My Car," "Evil Does Not Exist") portrays the spiritual encounter of two women with the same-sounding name in Paris. Based on the exchange of 20 letters between philosopher Makiko Miyano, who survived cancer metastasis, and anthropologist Maho Isono, titled "Suddenly Feeling Ill," the film depicts the connection between two women who meet by chance and their confrontation with the world. Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of the care facility "Garden of Freedom" on the outskirts of Paris, struggles with staff shortages and misunderstanding while striving for humane care. She meets Japanese stage director Mari Morisaki, who is battling cancer, and draws courage from her theater work. Guided by the coincidence of their similar-sounding names, Marie-Lou and Mari begin a friendship. But one day, Mari suddenly falls ill. As her illness progresses, their bond deepens, and their souls connect. Virginie Efira ("Benedetta") plays Marie-Lou, and Tao Okamoto, a global fashion model who has appeared in Hollywood films like "The Wolverine," plays Mari. Kyozo Nagatsuka ("Enemy") plays Goro Seimiya, an actor in Mari's play, and Koyo Kuroki ("The Generation of the Looking-Ahead") plays Tomoki Kubodera, Goro's grandson. Screened in the Competition section of the 79th Cannes Film Festival in 2026, Virginie Efira and Tao Okamoto jointly won the Best Actress award. Okamoto became the first Japanese person to win the Cannes Best Actress award.

program_title: 第39回東京国際映画祭 共催企画 生誕100年ユーセフ・シャヒーン監督特集
tmdb_overview_jp: ロンドンで心臓の手術を受ける男は、これまでの人生に思いを巡らせる。まるで、裁判にかけられているかのように、男は今まで犯してきた数々の過ちを振り返る。
tmdb_overview_en: After we last see him in "Alexandria, Why?" Egyptian filmmaker Yehia Mourad is in his thirties, and successful in his work, he has grown distant from his wife and children and suﬀers a symbolic blockage of the heart while shooting the final scenes of his latest film. After being flown to England for evaluation, it's determined that Yehia must undergo emergency surgery.  Fact and fiction blend seamlessly—with healthy doses of cleverly absurdist fantasy—as the film explores the various personalities and forces that have made Yehia (and Youssef Chahine) the man he has become.
synopsis_en: A man undergoing heart surgery in London reflects on his life. As if standing trial, he looks back on the many wrongs he has committed throughout his life.

tmdb_overview_jp: 口のきけない少女が、異国の地で殺人事件を目撃。犯人から必死に逃げ回るが、殺し屋の依頼人は父の商談相手だった……。絶体絶命のピンチを機転で乗り切る少女の姿を描いたサスペンス!
tmdb_overview_en: Combining a family vacation with business, Walter Richmond takes his wife and their 10-year-old, mute daughter, Melissa , to the Netherlands -- where Melissa inadvertently witnesses a murder. Unable to tell anyone what she's seen, the frightened girl vanishes in an attempt to elude the killers. Meanwhile, her parents try desperately to piece together the puzzle leading to Melissa's disappearance.
synopsis_en: A mute girl witnesses a murder in a foreign land. She desperately flees from the killer, but the person who hired the assassin turns out to be her father's business associate... A suspense film depicting a girl who uses her wits to survive a life-or-death crisis!

country: イギリス 原題または英題：Count Basie: Through His Own Eyes
synopsis: スウィングジャズの黄金時代を築いたアメリカのジャズピアニスト、カウント・ベイシーの人生と音楽に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 20代でジャズピアニストとして活動を始めたカウント・ベイシーは、仕事で訪れたミズーリ州カンザスシティで多くの一流ミュージシャンと出会い、1928年にブルー・デヴィルズに加入。さらにベニー・モーテン楽団でも研鑽を積んだ後、自らの名を冠したベイシー楽団を結成する。ジャズとブルースを融合させ、リズムに革命をもたらした彼は「キング・オブ・スウィング」と称され、日本でも世代を超えて多くのジャズファンや演奏家から愛され続けている。 本作では、表舞台での華々しい活躍のみならず、これまでベイシー自身があまり語ってこなかったプライベートにも焦点を当てる。家族が撮影したホームビデオや写真アルバム、手紙などの貴重な資料を通して、脳性麻痺の障がいを持って生まれた娘ダイアンや、アフリカ系アメリカ人の人権啓蒙運動を支援した妻キャサリンへの家族愛が明らかになる。さらに、現在も活動を続けるベイシー楽団のメンバーや、クインシー・ジョーンズ、アニー・ロスら友人たちも登場し、彼らが語るベイシー像や数々のアーカイブ資料を通し、その足跡と20世紀アメリカの激動の社会史を浮かび上がらせていく。監督は「ルーツ・ロック・レゲエ」など数多くの音楽ドキュメンタリーを手がけてきたイギリス出身のジェレミー・マー。
synopsis_en: A documentary exploring the life and music of Count Basie, the American jazz pianist who built the golden age of swing jazz. Starting his career as a jazz pianist in his twenties, Count Basie met many top musicians in Kansas City, Missouri, joined the Blue Devils in 1928, and later honed his skills with the Bennie Moten Orchestra before forming his own Basie Orchestra. Fusing jazz and blues and revolutionizing rhythm, he was hailed as the 'King of Swing' and remains beloved by jazz fans and musicians across generations in Japan. The film focuses not only on his public triumphs but also on his private life, which Basie rarely discussed. Through home videos, photo albums, and letters from his family, it reveals his love for his daughter Diane, born with cerebral palsy, and his wife Catherine, who supported the African American civil rights movement. Featuring interviews with current Basie Orchestra members, friends like Quincy Jones and Annie Ross, and archival materials, the documentary traces his legacy and the turbulent social history of 20th-century America. Directed by British filmmaker Jeremy Marre, known for many music documentaries including 'Roots Rock Reggae.'

movie_title: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
country: 日本・中国・韓国
tmdb_overview_en: In 2023, over 80,000 people went missing in Japan, with 30,000 dying alone. Ten percent remained unidentified, known as “muenbotoke” (buddhas without connections).  Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident. Guided by the diary, they embark on a journey into the past to uncover the man’s identity, which is deeply intertwined with Ueno’s post-war history. Along the way, they meet those whose lives the ghost touched, each revealing a story of a man who willingly cut ties with his family. Satsuki’s dreams and memories lead her astray, uncovering a bitter truth. Her search for answers about the vanished finds resolution in Toshi, who waits for the third reincarnation of his late wife.
clean_title_jp: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
movie_title_jp: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
movie_title_original: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
synopsis_en: Set in Ueno Park in Tokyo, this human mystery, a Japan-China-Korea co-production, explores human connections while focusing on "disappearance" as a way of life. A homeless man known as "Gojo" in Ueno has died. No one knows his real name, what he did in life, or why he ended up in a tent in the park. Satsuki, a social worker, with the help of Toshi, a man living in the park after losing his wife, searches through the homeless network to uncover Gojo's identity, using his diary as a clue. Eventually, the existence of a woman comes to light, and it's revealed that Gojo had cut ties with his family. This fact also profoundly shakes Satsuki's own life. Kadowaki Mugi stars as Satsuki, a social worker carrying a certain loss from her own past, and Takenaka Naoto co-stars as Toshi, a homeless man who accompanies Satsuki. The director and screenwriter is Wang Qii, who spent his childhood in Japan and studied filmmaking in the UK. Wayne Wang, known for directing "Smoke" and "The Joy Luck Club," is credited as co-writer and project planner.

country: アメリカ・ベルギー・フランス・イギリス合作 原題または英題：Mothers' Instinct
synopsis: アン・ハサウェイとジェシカ・チャステインが共演したサイコスリラー。作家バーバラ・アベルの小説をオリビエ・マッセ＝ドゥパス監督が映画化した2018年のベルギー映画「母親たち」をリメイクし、隣人で親友同士のふたりの主婦が、ある事故をきっかけにお互いへの疑念と妄想を暴走させていく姿を描く。 1960年代、アメリカ。親友同士のセリーヌとアリスは、大都市郊外の隣り合った家に暮らしている。お互い裕福な家庭で同じ年のひとり息子を持つ彼女たちは、完璧で幸せな生活を送っていた。しかしある日、セリーヌの息子が不幸な事故に遭ったことで、ふたりの関係性は一変する。喪失感に苦しむセリーヌは、次第にアリスの息子テオに心を通わせるようになっていく。アリスはその様子に疑念を持ちはじめ、やがてふたりは狂気と妄想の渦に呑み込まれていく。 セリーヌをハサウェイ、アリスをチャステインが演じ、母親ゆえの愛情や苦しみ、そして悲劇的な事故をきっかけに巻き起こる緊張感に満ちた駆け引きを圧巻の演技で表現する。共演は「わたしは最悪。」のアンデルシュ・ダニエルセン・リー、「いまを生きる」のジョシュ・チャールズ。「青いパパイヤの香り」「博士と彼女のセオリー」などで知られるフランスの撮影監督ブノワ・ドゥロームが長編初メガホンをとり、自ら撮影監督も務めた。
tmdb_overview_jp: 1960年代アメリカ、大都市郊外の隣同士の家に住む親友のセリーヌ（アン・ハサウェイ）とアリス（ジェシカ・チャステイン）。お互い裕福な家庭で同い年の一人息子を持つふたりは、完璧で幸せな生活を送っていた。しかしある日、セリーヌの息子が不幸な事故に遭ったことで関係性は一変。喪失感に苦しむセリーヌは、次第にアリスの息子・テオに心を通わせるようになっていく。その様子に疑念を持ち始めるアリス。彼女は私の家族を奪おうとしているのか？それともただの思い違いか…。徐々にアリスの行動はエスカレートしていき、やがてふたりは狂気と妄想の渦に飲み込まれていくー。
tmdb_overview_en: Housewives Alice and Celine are best friends and neighbours who seem to have it all. However, when a tragic accident shatters the harmony of their lives, guilt, suspicion and paranoia begin to unravel their sisterly bond.
synopsis_en: In 1960s America, best friends Celine and Alice live next door to each other in a suburban neighborhood. Both come from wealthy families and each has an only son the same age, living a perfect, happy life. But one day, Celine's son is involved in a tragic accident, and their relationship changes completely. Consumed by loss, Celine gradually begins to grow close to Alice's son, Theo. Alice starts to grow suspicious. Is she trying to take my family away? Or is it all just a misunderstanding... Alice's behavior escalates step by step, and soon both women are swallowed into a vortex of madness and delusion.

country: 台湾
tmdb_overview_en: Two friends who haven't seen each other for thirteen years reunite. One is a successful concert pianist just back from a European tour and the other has just started a new business.
synopsis_en: Edward Yang × Christopher Doyle! A masterpiece heralding the dawn of Taiwanese New Cinema by these two guiding lights of world cinema!

country: フランス
synopsis: 南フランスの港町マルセイユ。若者ボニはピザ屋で働きながら、どこにも属さない日々を送っている。ある日、長く離れていた妹ネネットが突然現れ、彼の部屋に転がり込む。行き場を失ったネネットは、ある秘密を抱えていた。彼女は妊娠していたのだ。しかしその事実をボニに打ち明けることはない。ぎこちない同居生活のなかで、二人は互いに踏み込めない距離を保ったまま時間を過ごしていく。ボニはパン屋の女性に心を寄せるが、その想いを現実に結びつけることができない。ネネットは自らの身体と向き合い、未来を選び取ろうとする。残酷な世界のなかで、欲望と優しさは静かに二人の関係を変えていく。言葉にならない感情が、ゆっくりと滲み出していく。
tmdb_overview_en: Teenage siblings Nenette and Boni were raised apart as a result of their parents' divorce. Their mother, who doted on her son Boni, has died. He works for an interesting couple as a pizza baker, and is surprised and enraged when his younger sister, having run away from boarding school, suddenly turns up. There's a problem that they must confront.
synopsis_en: In the port city of Marseille in southern France. Young Boni works at a pizzeria, spending his days belonging nowhere. One day, his long-estranged younger sister Nenette suddenly appears and crashes at his place. Having nowhere to go, Nenette carries a secret: she is pregnant. But she never reveals this fact to Boni. In their awkward cohabitation, the two spend time maintaining a distance they cannot cross. Boni develops feelings for a woman who works at a bakery, but cannot turn those feelings into reality. Nenette confronts her own body and tries to choose her future. In a cruel world, desire and tenderness quietly transform their relationship. Unspoken emotions slowly seep through.

synopsis: 舞台はベルギーの港町オステンドのホテル。宿泊しに来た新婚のステファンとヴァレリーはどこかぎこちない。ホテルの滞在客はこの二人だけだったが、そこに謎めいた優雅な伯爵夫人エリザベート・バートリーと秘書イローナがやってくる。エリザベートは新婚夫婦に接近し、禁断の世界へと引き込んでいく。彼女は一体何者なのか? 何が狙いなのか…?
tmdb_overview_jp: ベルギー、オステンド。海辺の退廃的なホテルで、新婚のステファンとヴァレリーは、謎めいたバートリー伯爵夫人とその秘書イロナに出会う。
tmdb_overview_en: Ostend, Belgium. In a decadent seaside hotel, Stefan and Valerie, a newlywed couple, meet the mysterious Countess Báthory and Ilona, her secretary.
synopsis_en: The setting is a hotel in the Belgian port town of Ostend. Newlyweds Stefan and Valerie, who have come to stay, seem somewhat awkward together. The two are the hotel's only guests—until the mysterious and elegant Countess Elizabeth Bathory and her secretary Ilona arrive. Elizabeth draws close to the newlywed couple and leads them into a forbidden world. Who is she really? What is her aim...?

synopsis: かいせつ 『塀の中の懲りない面々』の脚本を手掛けた鈴木が監督した、原作続編の映画化。休憩中のソフトボールが生き甲斐の受刑者たちが、刑務所内でかつて行われた伝説の看守との対抗試合を夢見るが・・・。受刑者役の顔ぶれが個性的！

synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the sequel to the original work, directed by Suzuki, who wrote the screenplay for "The Unruly Guys Behind Bars." Inmates whose sole purpose in life is playing softball during breaks dream of a legendary match against the guards that once took place in the prison... The cast of inmates is wonderfully unique!

synopsis: かいせつ ヤクザの家業を継がずに銀行マンになったトオル(仲村)は、仕事も恋も順風満帆だったが、やがて思いもしない抗争に巻き込まれてしまう―。小林信彦の短編を森田が大胆に脚色し映画化した、一風変わったヤクザ映画。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Despite his efforts of living a normal life as a banker, the life of Toru, the only son of the Yubari Family, becomes disrupted by trouble brought on by his father. When his father’s battle against his rival group the Miike Family ignites, Toru becomes more involved in the turf war than he wished for.
synopsis_en: Toru (Nakamura), who became a bank employee instead of inheriting the family yakuza business, had everything going well in both work and love, but eventually gets caught up in an unexpected gang war. A quirky yakuza film adapted for the screen by Morita, who boldly reworked Kobayashi Nobuhiko's short story.

synopsis: かいせつ 「ヤングジャンプ」に連載された人気漫画を、人気絶頂のアイドル二人の主演で映画化。革ジャンが似合うイカした美人教師・エリーと男子生徒との、禁断の恋の駆け引きを描く。80年代の大人びた若者達の、今見ると驚きの習性も見所。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Based on the comic by Mako Takami.
synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the popular manga serialized in "Young Jump," starring two idols at the peak of their popularity. It depicts the forbidden love game between a cool, beautiful teacher named Ellie who looks great in a leather jacket and a male student. The surprisingly mature habits of 80s youth, which are shocking when viewed today, are also a highlight.

synopsis: かいせつ 日本アニメ界の巨匠が手掛けた伝説の劇場版。「ウチは日本一不幸な少女や！」―大阪・通天閣近くの商店街で、ろくでなしの父親に代わってホルモン焼き屋を切り盛りする浪花っ子・チエちゃんの奇抜な日常を描いた人情喜劇の傑作。

tmdb_overview_jp: バクチ好きの父親、テツに代わり自宅のホルモン屋を切り盛りしている逞しい大阪の女子小学生の竹本チエ。そんなチエは時々テツと別居中の母ヨシ江と父に秘密で会っており縁日での休みを満喫するが、その現場をテツに見られてしまい…。
tmdb_overview_en: Chie Takemoto is a dependable girl who struggles to help her troublesome father run a small tavern in Osaka. Unbeknown to her dad, she occasionally visits her mother who left him not too long ago. She plans on trying to reunite them, but not until her father gets a job.

synopsis_en: A legendary theatrical film from a master of the Japanese anime world. "I'm the unluckiest girl in Japan!" — A masterpiece of heartwarming comedy depicting the eccentric daily life of Chie-chan, a Naniwa girl who runs a horumon grill shop in place of her good-for-nothing father in a shopping street near Tsutenkaku in Osaka.

country: フランス 原題または英題：La Venue de l'avenir
synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

tmdb_overview_en: Matthias is a master of pretense, from cultured boyfriend to perfect son or marital coach. He makes a career of being someone else. The real challenge begins when he has to be himself.
synopsis_en: A perfect son, a cultured lover, a thug for those who want to play hero on a date—'My Companion' is an agency that provides ideal individuals for any situation. Matthias, their top performer, perfectly plays the required roles, living through various personalities every day. However, when his girlfriend Sofia tells him 'I don't feel the real you' and they break up, his perfect mask begins to quietly peel away. Furthermore, an unexpected incident with a client causes Matthias's gears to gradually start grinding, and eventually the boundary between reality and fiction becomes blurred...

synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

country: 韓国 原題または英題：The Ugly
synopsis: 「新感染　ファイナル・エクスプレス」のヨン・サンホ監督が2018年に発表した自身初のグラフィックノベルを映画化したサスペンスミステリー。 生まれつき目が見えないハンデを乗り越え、著名な篆刻家（てんこくか）となったイム・ヨンギュ。息子のドンファンは偉大な父を敬い、事業を陰ながら支えていた。そんなドンファンに、警察から40年前に消息不明になった母チョン・ヨンヒの遺体が地中深くから発見されたとの知らせが届く。ヨンヒは何者かに殺された可能性があるという。あるドキュメンタリー番組のプロデューサーの提案で、ドンファンは母の死の真相を探り始める。調査を進める中で、ドンファンはヨンヒが「醜い顔」をしていたという証言を次々と耳にし、ショックに打ちひしがれる。やがて、ドンファンは母の死をめぐるある事実に直面する。 「ただ悪より救いたまえ」「密輸 1970」のパク・ジョンミンが主人公ドンファン役を務めたほか、回想シーンに登場する若き日のヨンギュ役も演じた。父ヨンギュ役は「小川のほとりで」のクォン・ヘヒョ、ヨンヒ役はヨン監督のNetflix映画「啓示」のシン・ヒョンビンが担当した。
tmdb_overview_en: One day while overseeing a documentary crew filming his blind father at work, Im Dong-hwan gets a phone call that his missing mother’s remains have been found after forty years. Determined to find the truth of her disappearance, Dong-hwan embarks on a twisted odyssey through his family’s traumatic past, uncovering dark secrets along the way.
synopsis_en: Yeong-gyu is a blind seal engraver who carves the most beautiful stamps in South Korea. To his son Dong-hwan, his father was 'a miracle itself.' But one day, the skeletal remains of his mother Yeong-hui, who disappeared 40 years ago, are discovered—and it holds the potential of being a 'murder.' To uncover the truth behind the death of the mother whose face he never knew, Dong-hwan traces the testimonies of those who knew her. Yet, all he hears are strange words: 'She had a face as ugly as a monster.' Why was his mother so disparaged? Is it the truth, or a distorted memory? What eventually emerges is not the 'face' of one woman, but the prejudice, malice, and collective madness lurking within humanity. The moment the sealed truth is revealed, a powerful shock that will go down in film history strikes the audience!

country: 日本
synopsis: 「佐々木、イン、マイマイン」「若き見知らぬ者たち」の内山拓也監督が、北村匠海を主演に迎えて撮りあげた自伝的作品。内山監督の故郷である新潟県を舞台に、自身の居場所とアイデンティティを模索する孤独な少年が、息をのむような大きな愛を知るまでの20年間を描く。 日本海沿いの町に暮らす少年・大地は、幼少期に暴君のようだった父の影響で言葉を発することができない。現在は母の亜樹と雑居ビル屋上のプレハブに暮らしているが、水商売で生計を立てる母はほとんど家に帰らず、生活も苦しい。やがて大地は亜樹とともに叔母の家に身を寄せるが、彼の居場所はどこにもなく、ひとりで過ごすうちに内気になっていく。そんなある日、父の行方を求めて生家を訪ねたことをきっかけに、大地の運命は大きく揺らぎはじめる。 主人公・大地の青年期を北村匠海が演じ、自分のもとを離れた父への静かな怒りと、母に対する憎しみと愛という相反する感情に揺れる心の内を体現。大地の母・亜樹を宮沢りえ、父・大原を永瀬正敏、大地の少年期を榎本司、加藤庵次、穐本陽月の3人が演じた。2025年・第26回東京フィルメックスのコンペティション部門で審査員特別賞を受賞。また、第76回ベルリン国際映画祭パノラマ部門にも正式出品された。
synopsis_en: Director Takuya Uchiyama, who swept newcomer awards at film festivals with "Sasaki, In, My Mind" and continued with "Young Strangers," consistently gazing at the youth of young people resisting reality and trying to grasp something, leaving a vivid impression on the film world, releases this passionate work—an autobiographical film set in his hometown of Niigata in winter, telling the story of a boy searching for a place to belong and his identity. Playing the adolescent protagonist Daichi is Takumi Kitamura. He brilliantly embodies the quiet anger toward his father who left him and his mother, and the heart wavering between love and hatred—contradictory emotions—toward his mother who raised him single-handedly. As his mother Aki, Rie Miyazawa gives her all to portray a mother whose innocent nature creates a life that instills loneliness in Daichi, yet whose every detail reveals a certain tenderness toward her son. And as his father Ohara, Masatoshi Nagase, with full maturity, shows a man who transforms from a tyrannical figure into one living out a sorrowful remaining life. Also, as the young Daichi, Tsukasa Enomoto, Anji Kato, and Hazuki Akimoto each express the loneliness, love, and life force swirling deep in his heart with innocent yet powerful gazes, driving the entire story forward. Daichi, a boy living in a town along the Sea of Japan, stopped speaking due to the influence of his father, who was like a tyrant during his early childhood. He now lives with his mother Aki, but Aki, forced to make a living through night work, rarely comes home, and their life is hard. Eventually they move in with his aunt, but he has no place anywhere, and spending time alone, he grew introverted. Daichi decides to visit his old home in search of his father's whereabouts. From this point on, his fate is greatly shaken——— Poverty with no emotional anchor, small salvation amid the loneliness of living so as not to be found by anyone, complicated feelings toward his mother. Daichi seems to live as if being swept along, yet he never stops walking. The 20 years until he grasps a faint light and comes to know a breathtaking, immense love are depicted through a perspective rooted in realism, following the boy's figure throughout.

country: 日本・フランス・シンガポール・フィリピン合作
synopsis: 「淵に立つ」「恋愛裁判」などの深田晃司監督が、松たか子を主演に迎えて撮りあげた人間ドラマ。第39回岸田國士戯曲賞を受賞した平田オリザの代表作「東京ノート」に着想を得て、深田監督自らオリジナル脚本を執筆。「東京ノート」の精神を受け継ぎつつ、岡山県奈義町をモデルにした「ナギ」を舞台に新たな物語を描き、企画の立ち上げから9年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 自然豊かな町・ナギで、ひとり創作に打ち込む彫刻家の寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍する友梨が数日間の休暇をとり、別れた夫の姉である寄子のもとを訪れる。若くして妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみ・好浩、息子の春樹とその親友・圭太など、人々との出会いは穏やかな日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。友梨は寄子の彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで彼女の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨自身にも変化が起こりはじめる。 深田監督とは初タッグとなる松たか子が、癒えない喪失を抱えながら彫刻制作に没頭する寄子という複雑なキャラクターを体現。寄子の彫刻のモデルをつとめる友梨を石橋静河、寄子の幼なじみで役場に勤める好浩を松山ケンイチが演じる。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門出品。
tmdb_overview_jp: 近くの山から切り出される木でひとり彫刻を作る寄子。ある日、東京と台湾で建築家として活躍してきた友梨は、 数日間の休暇をとって、別れた夫の姉・寄子のもとを訪れる。都会にはない「ナギ」での穏やかな生活。妻を亡くした寄子の幼なじみの好浩、そして息子の春樹とその親友の圭太――人々との出会いは、日常に小さな揺らぎをもたらしていく。  やがて、彫刻のモデルを毎晩つとめるなかで寄子の知られざる喪失に触れ、友梨にも変化が起きていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Yoriko, an artist living in rural Nagi, is haunted by a former love affair she cannot bear to mourn. When Yuri, a recently separated architect, travels from Tokyo to visit her friend and former sister-in-law, both women find themselves at a crossroad, each searching for ways to let go of the past and define their identities. Yuri's brief escape from the city settles into a quiet confrontation of loss and probing for the two women in bucolic Nagi.
synopsis_en: Yoriko carves sculptures alone from wood cut from a nearby mountain. One day, Yuri, who has been active as an architect in Tokyo and Taiwan, takes a few days off to visit Yoriko, the sister of her ex-husband. Life in the countryside, with its "calm" not found in the city, unfolds gently. Encounters with Yoshihiro, Yoriko's childhood friend who lost his wife, and his son Haruki and Haruki's best friend Keita, bring small ripples to everyday life. Eventually, as she serves as the model for his sculptures every night, Yuri touches upon Yoriko's hidden loss, and changes begin to take place within her as well.

synopsis: . 愛に国境はない。けれど、世界は私たちに国境を弾く . ヒットや流行のためではなく、たった一人の心を深く揺さぶるために生まれた映画レーベルの記念すべき第一作が、『LEONIDAS』がついに公開！その製作総指揮は本作の脚本・原案・劇中歌を担当したTOH YUSEI。短編『忘れられない』が世界10カ国以上で国際映画賞を受賞している 橘潤樹 が、監督・脚本・編集を務める初長編作。在日韓国人青年の葛藤と希望を通して、“境界(ボーダー)”の意味を静かに、そして力強く問いかける。第47回モスクワ国際映画祭、2025年横浜国際映画祭への選出を経て放たれる本作は、華やかさを競うための映画ではない。 「商業ではなく、心に届く映画をつくる」—— その信念をかたちにしたのがBROADWAY CINEMAの出発点である。 主人公・ヒロを演じるのは、『ハードタイムズ』『卍リバース』で圧倒的な存在感を放つ門間航。ヒロイン・アオイ役には、『相対性長屋論』などで国際的注目を集める永田凜。さらに仲野温、モクタール、SASHINI、朝香賢徹ら実力派キャストが脇を固め、物語に深い厚みを与えている。編集には、『ゴジラ-1.0』『永遠の0』で日本アカデミー賞最優秀編集賞を多数受賞している宮島竜治が参画し、世界標準の映像クオリティを実現。製作はクリエイティブアートカンパニー10NY、制作は『四月の永い夢』『静かな雨』などで国際的評価の高いTokyo New Cinemaが担当する。『LEONIDAS』は、レーベルの誕生を告げる作品であり、これから羽ばたく才能たちのはじまりの物語でもある。 . .
tmdb_overview_en: Hiro, a young Korean man in Japan, meets Aoi, a digital artist from a wealthy but restrictive family. As their relationship deepens, they visit a charkha studio, inspiring Hiro to create music again. Aoi rejects her family’s corporate expectations and stays at Hiro’s mother’s house. When Hiro gets an unexpected music opportunity in New York, they plan to go together, but Aoi’s father pressures them to separate.
synopsis_en: . Love has no borders. Yet the world makes us play with borders. . Not for hits or trends, but born to deeply move the heart of just one person—the commemorative first work of a film label, 'LEONIDAS,' is finally released! The executive producer is TOH YUSEI, who handled the screenplay, original concept, and in-film song for this work. Junki Tachibana, whose short film 'Unforgettable' has won international film awards in more than 10 countries, serves as director, screenwriter, and editor in his first feature-length work. Through the conflicts and hopes of a young Zainichi Korean man, it quietly and powerfully questions the meaning of 'borders.' Selected for the 47th Moscow International Film Festival and the 2025 Yokohama International Film Festival, this work is not a film meant to compete for glamour. 'To make films that reach the heart, not for commerce'—giving form to that conviction is the starting point of BROADWAY CINEMA. The protagonist Hiro is played by Wataru Monma, who showed overwhelming presence in 'Hard Times' and 'Manji Reverse.' The heroine Aoi is played by Rin Nagata, who has drawn international attention in works such as 'Relativity Nagaya Theory.' Furthermore, accomplished cast members including Atsushi Nakano, Mokutaru, SASHINI, and Kentetsu Asaka round out the supporting roles, giving the story deep richness. Editor Ryuji Miyajima, who has won numerous Japan Academy Prize Best Editing Awards for 'Godzilla Minus One' and 'The Eternal Zero,' participates in editing, realizing world-standard visual quality. Production is handled by creative art company 10NY, with production by Tokyo New Cinema, highly acclaimed internationally for works such as 'The Long Dream of April' and 'Silent Rain.' 'LEONIDAS' is the work that announces the birth of the label, and also the story of the beginning of talents about to take flight. . .

country: フランス・日本・ドイツ・ベルギー合作
synopsis: 「ドライブ・マイ・カー」「悪は存在しない」の濱口竜介監督が、パリを舞台に同じ名前の響きを持つ女性2人の魂の邂逅を描いたドラマ。がんの転移を経験しながら生き抜く哲学者・宮野真生子と、臨床現場の調査を積み重ねた人類学者・磯野真穂が交わした20通の往復書簡「急に具合が悪くなる」を原作に、偶然出会った2人の女性の交流と世界に対峙する姿を描き出す。 パリ郊外の介護施設「自由の庭」で施設長を務めるマリー＝ルー・フォンテーヌは、入居者を人間らしくケアすることを理想としながらも、人手不足やスタッフの無理解に悩まされていた。そんな中、日本人の舞台演出家・森崎真理と出会ったマリー＝ルーは、がん闘病中の彼女が描く演劇に勇気をもらう。同じ名前の響きを持つ偶然に導かれて交流を始める真理とマリー＝ルーだったが、あるとき真理は急に具合が悪くなる。真理の病の進行とともに2人の関係は深まり、互いの魂を通わせ合うようになっていく。 「ベネデッタ」のビルジニー・エフィラがマリー＝ルー、「ウルヴァリン：SAMURAI」などハリウッド映画にも出演する世界的ファッションモデルのTAOこと岡本多緒が真理を演じ、真理が演出する舞台の出演俳優・清宮吾朗役で「敵」の名優・長塚京三、吾朗の孫・窪寺智樹役で「見はらし世代」の注目若手俳優・黒崎煌代が共演。2026年・第79回カンヌ国際映画祭コンペティション部門に出品され、ビルジニー・エフィラと岡本多緒がそろって女優賞を受賞。岡本は日本人で初のカンヌ国際映画祭女優賞受賞を果たした。
tmdb_overview_jp: パリ郊外の介護施設「自由の庭」で施設長を務めるマリー＝ルー・フォンテーヌは、入居者を人間らしくケアすることを理想としながらも、人手不足やスタッフの無理解に悩まされていた。そんな中、日本人の舞台演出家・森崎真理と出会ったマリー＝ルーは、がん闘病中の彼女が描く演劇に勇気をもらう。同じ名前の響きを持つ偶然に導かれて交流を始める真理とマリー＝ルーだったが、あるとき真理は急に具合が悪くなる。真理の病の進行とともに2人の関係は深まり、互いの魂を通わせ合うようになっていく。
tmdb_overview_en: Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of a nursing home in the Paris suburbs, defies convention by adopting the 'Humanitude' method despite her team’s resistance. Her encounter with Mari Morisaki, a terminally ill Japanese playwright, transforms her life. Together, they turn the facility into a symbol of resistance and humanity against the system’s limits.
synopsis_en: Director Ryusuke Hamaguchi ("Drive My Car," "Evil Does Not Exist") portrays the spiritual encounter of two women with the same-sounding name in Paris. Based on the exchange of 20 letters between philosopher Makiko Miyano, who survived cancer metastasis, and anthropologist Maho Isono, titled "Suddenly Feeling Ill," the film depicts the connection between two women who meet by chance and their confrontation with the world. Marie-Lou Fontaine, director of the care facility "Garden of Freedom" on the outskirts of Paris, struggles with staff shortages and misunderstanding while striving for humane care. She meets Japanese stage director Mari Morisaki, who is battling cancer, and draws courage from her theater work. Guided by the coincidence of their similar-sounding names, Marie-Lou and Mari begin a friendship. But one day, Mari suddenly falls ill. As her illness progresses, their bond deepens, and their souls connect. Virginie Efira ("Benedetta") plays Marie-Lou, and Tao Okamoto, a global fashion model who has appeared in Hollywood films like "The Wolverine," plays Mari. Kyozo Nagatsuka ("Enemy") plays Goro Seimiya, an actor in Mari's play, and Koyo Kuroki ("The Generation of the Looking-Ahead") plays Tomoki Kubodera, Goro's grandson. Screened in the Competition section of the 79th Cannes Film Festival in 2026, Virginie Efira and Tao Okamoto jointly won the Best Actress award. Okamoto became the first Japanese person to win the Cannes Best Actress award.

country: 日本
synopsis: スマホに触れている時だけ見える透明な怪物に狙われた少女の物語を没入感たっぷりに描いた青春ホラー。2021年の縦型短編映画「スマホラー！」で注目を集めた西山将貴監督が長編初メガホンをとり、自身が学生時代に抱えていた孤独や居場所のなさといった“影”を物語の核に、構想から6年の歳月をかけて完成させた。 ミックスルーツを持つエレナは、田舎町の高校に転校するがクラスになじめず、明るく話しかけてくる隣席のアカリにも心を開くことができずにいた。そんな中、スマホにつながったイヤホンを常に手放さないクラスの問題児・猫歌（にゃん）の死をきっかけに、エレナの周囲で奇妙な現象が起こりはじめる。イヤホンを通じて聞こえる足音と、スマホを手にしている時だけ見える「怪物」に常に追いかけられるようになったエレナは、やがて猫歌のようにスマホを手放せなくなってしまう。 自身も14歳から映画制作を続ける監督で俳優のシエラ璃砂がエレナ役で主演を務め、エレナの友人アカリを奥野みゆ、クラスの問題児・猫歌を平澤瑠菜が演じた。VFXを担当するのは、これまで西山監督の全作品でタッグを組み、アカデミー賞視覚効果賞を受賞した「ゴジラ－1.0」のCG制作にも参加したCao Moji（佐藤昭一郎）。イギリスの第33回レインダンス映画祭にて国際長編映画賞にノミネート。
synopsis_en:
An immersive youth horror film, this story follows a young girl targeted by a transparent monster visible only when she touches her smartphone. Director Masaki Nishiyama, who garnered attention for his 2021 vertical short film *Sma-Horror!*, makes his feature-length debut with this project. Drawing from the "shadows" of loneliness and alienation he felt during his own student years, Nishiyama spent six years bringing this vision to life.

Elena, a girl of mixed heritage, transfers to a high school in a rural town. Struggling to fit in, she finds herself unable to open up to Akari, a cheerful classmate who tries to befriend her. However, following the death of the class troublemaker, Nyan—who was never seen without earphones plugged into her phone—strange phenomena begin to occur around Elena. Haunted by footsteps heard through her earphones and pursued by a "monster" visible only when she holds her smartphone, Elena soon finds herself unable to let go of her device, just like Nyan.

Sierra Risa, an actor and director who has been making films since age 14, stars as Elena. Miyu Okuno plays her friend Akari, while Runa Hirasawa portrays the troubled Nyan. The VFX are handled by Cao Moji (Shoichiro Sato), a long-time collaborator of Nishiyama who also contributed to the CG for the Academy Award-winning *Godzilla Minus One*. The film was nominated for Best International Feature at the 33rd Raindance Film Festival in the UK.

tmdb_overview_jp: 12世紀のスペイン。ある哲学者が仕える君主の背後で、政敵たちが国家を脅かす陰謀を画策。哲学者と彼の深遠な教えは、君主を追い込むために利用されてしまう。
tmdb_overview_en: In the 12th century's Andalusia lives Ibn Rushd a prominent Islamic philosopher with his wife Zeinab and daughter Salma. The principality is ruled by Khalifa ElMansour who has two sons, ElNasser, an intellectual that likes Ibn Rush and is in love with his daughter Salma. The younger son Abdallah is more into dancing and poetry, spending most of his times with the gypsy family and getting the daughter pregnant. The Khalifa is depending on the extremists to build his army granting them more power which they use to combat artists and philosophers. The extremists succeed in recruiting Abd Allah and train him to kill his father. Events go on where Marawan, the gypsy singer, is killed and Ibn Rushd's books are burnt. Adapted from the real life of Ibn Rushd AlMasir is Chahine's statement against extremism.
synopsis_en: 12th-century Spain. Behind the monarch served by a philosopher, political rivals plot a conspiracy that threatens the nation. The philosopher and his profound teachings are used to corner the king.

country: イギリス 原題または英題：Count Basie: Through His Own Eyes
synopsis: スウィングジャズの黄金時代を築いたアメリカのジャズピアニスト、カウント・ベイシーの人生と音楽に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 20代でジャズピアニストとして活動を始めたカウント・ベイシーは、仕事で訪れたミズーリ州カンザスシティで多くの一流ミュージシャンと出会い、1928年にブルー・デヴィルズに加入。さらにベニー・モーテン楽団でも研鑽を積んだ後、自らの名を冠したベイシー楽団を結成する。ジャズとブルースを融合させ、リズムに革命をもたらした彼は「キング・オブ・スウィング」と称され、日本でも世代を超えて多くのジャズファンや演奏家から愛され続けている。 本作では、表舞台での華々しい活躍のみならず、これまでベイシー自身があまり語ってこなかったプライベートにも焦点を当てる。家族が撮影したホームビデオや写真アルバム、手紙などの貴重な資料を通して、脳性麻痺の障がいを持って生まれた娘ダイアンや、アフリカ系アメリカ人の人権啓蒙運動を支援した妻キャサリンへの家族愛が明らかになる。さらに、現在も活動を続けるベイシー楽団のメンバーや、クインシー・ジョーンズ、アニー・ロスら友人たちも登場し、彼らが語るベイシー像や数々のアーカイブ資料を通し、その足跡と20世紀アメリカの激動の社会史を浮かび上がらせていく。監督は「ルーツ・ロック・レゲエ」など数多くの音楽ドキュメンタリーを手がけてきたイギリス出身のジェレミー・マー。
synopsis_en: A documentary exploring the life and music of Count Basie, the American jazz pianist who built the golden age of swing jazz. Starting his career as a jazz pianist in his twenties, Count Basie met many top musicians in Kansas City, Missouri, joined the Blue Devils in 1928, and later honed his skills with the Bennie Moten Orchestra before forming his own Basie Orchestra. Fusing jazz and blues and revolutionizing rhythm, he was hailed as the 'King of Swing' and remains beloved by jazz fans and musicians across generations in Japan. The film focuses not only on his public triumphs but also on his private life, which Basie rarely discussed. Through home videos, photo albums, and letters from his family, it reveals his love for his daughter Diane, born with cerebral palsy, and his wife Catherine, who supported the African American civil rights movement. Featuring interviews with current Basie Orchestra members, friends like Quincy Jones and Annie Ross, and archival materials, the documentary traces his legacy and the turbulent social history of 20th-century America. Directed by British filmmaker Jeremy Marre, known for many music documentaries including 'Roots Rock Reggae.'

movie_title: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
country: 日本・中国・韓国
tmdb_overview_en: In 2023, over 80,000 people went missing in Japan, with 30,000 dying alone. Ten percent remained unidentified, known as “muenbotoke” (buddhas without connections).  Satsuki works part-time at an NGO near Ueno Park, indifferent to her job and the faces of those seeking help, until she stumbles upon the diary of a deceased homeless man. Toshi, a fellow drifter in the park, tells her that her encounter with the man’s ghost is no accident. Guided by the diary, they embark on a journey into the past to uncover the man’s identity, which is deeply intertwined with Ueno’s post-war history. Along the way, they meet those whose lives the ghost touched, each revealing a story of a man who willingly cut ties with his family. Satsuki’s dreams and memories lead her astray, uncovering a bitter truth. Her search for answers about the vanished finds resolution in Toshi, who waits for the third reincarnation of his late wife.
clean_title_jp: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
movie_title_jp: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
movie_title_original: ゴースト・オブ・ウエノ
synopsis_en: Set in Ueno Park in Tokyo, this human mystery, a Japan-China-Korea co-production, explores human connections while focusing on "disappearance" as a way of life. A homeless man known as "Gojo" in Ueno has died. No one knows his real name, what he did in life, or why he ended up in a tent in the park. Satsuki, a social worker, with the help of Toshi, a man living in the park after losing his wife, searches through the homeless network to uncover Gojo's identity, using his diary as a clue. Eventually, the existence of a woman comes to light, and it's revealed that Gojo had cut ties with his family. This fact also profoundly shakes Satsuki's own life. Kadowaki Mugi stars as Satsuki, a social worker carrying a certain loss from her own past, and Takenaka Naoto co-stars as Toshi, a homeless man who accompanies Satsuki. The director and screenwriter is Wang Qii, who spent his childhood in Japan and studied filmmaking in the UK. Wayne Wang, known for directing "Smoke" and "The Joy Luck Club," is credited as co-writer and project planner.

country: アメリカ・ベルギー・フランス・イギリス合作 原題または英題：Mothers' Instinct
synopsis: アン・ハサウェイとジェシカ・チャステインが共演したサイコスリラー。作家バーバラ・アベルの小説をオリビエ・マッセ＝ドゥパス監督が映画化した2018年のベルギー映画「母親たち」をリメイクし、隣人で親友同士のふたりの主婦が、ある事故をきっかけにお互いへの疑念と妄想を暴走させていく姿を描く。 1960年代、アメリカ。親友同士のセリーヌとアリスは、大都市郊外の隣り合った家に暮らしている。お互い裕福な家庭で同じ年のひとり息子を持つ彼女たちは、完璧で幸せな生活を送っていた。しかしある日、セリーヌの息子が不幸な事故に遭ったことで、ふたりの関係性は一変する。喪失感に苦しむセリーヌは、次第にアリスの息子テオに心を通わせるようになっていく。アリスはその様子に疑念を持ちはじめ、やがてふたりは狂気と妄想の渦に呑み込まれていく。 セリーヌをハサウェイ、アリスをチャステインが演じ、母親ゆえの愛情や苦しみ、そして悲劇的な事故をきっかけに巻き起こる緊張感に満ちた駆け引きを圧巻の演技で表現する。共演は「わたしは最悪。」のアンデルシュ・ダニエルセン・リー、「いまを生きる」のジョシュ・チャールズ。「青いパパイヤの香り」「博士と彼女のセオリー」などで知られるフランスの撮影監督ブノワ・ドゥロームが長編初メガホンをとり、自ら撮影監督も務めた。
tmdb_overview_jp: 1960年代アメリカ、大都市郊外の隣同士の家に住む親友のセリーヌ（アン・ハサウェイ）とアリス（ジェシカ・チャステイン）。お互い裕福な家庭で同い年の一人息子を持つふたりは、完璧で幸せな生活を送っていた。しかしある日、セリーヌの息子が不幸な事故に遭ったことで関係性は一変。喪失感に苦しむセリーヌは、次第にアリスの息子・テオに心を通わせるようになっていく。その様子に疑念を持ち始めるアリス。彼女は私の家族を奪おうとしているのか？それともただの思い違いか…。徐々にアリスの行動はエスカレートしていき、やがてふたりは狂気と妄想の渦に飲み込まれていくー。
tmdb_overview_en: Housewives Alice and Celine are best friends and neighbours who seem to have it all. However, when a tragic accident shatters the harmony of their lives, guilt, suspicion and paranoia begin to unravel their sisterly bond.
synopsis_en: In 1960s America, best friends Celine and Alice live next door to each other in a suburban neighborhood. Both come from wealthy families and each has an only son the same age, living a perfect, happy life. But one day, Celine's son is involved in a tragic accident, and their relationship changes completely. Consumed by loss, Celine gradually begins to grow close to Alice's son, Theo. Alice starts to grow suspicious. Is she trying to take my family away? Or is it all just a misunderstanding... Alice's behavior escalates step by step, and soon both women are swallowed into a vortex of madness and delusion.

country: 台湾
tmdb_overview_en: Two friends who haven't seen each other for thirteen years reunite. One is a successful concert pianist just back from a European tour and the other has just started a new business.
synopsis_en: Edward Yang × Christopher Doyle! A masterpiece heralding the dawn of Taiwanese New Cinema by these two guiding lights of world cinema!

country: フランス
synopsis: 南フランスの港町マルセイユ。若者ボニはピザ屋で働きながら、どこにも属さない日々を送っている。ある日、長く離れていた妹ネネットが突然現れ、彼の部屋に転がり込む。行き場を失ったネネットは、ある秘密を抱えていた。彼女は妊娠していたのだ。しかしその事実をボニに打ち明けることはない。ぎこちない同居生活のなかで、二人は互いに踏み込めない距離を保ったまま時間を過ごしていく。ボニはパン屋の女性に心を寄せるが、その想いを現実に結びつけることができない。ネネットは自らの身体と向き合い、未来を選び取ろうとする。残酷な世界のなかで、欲望と優しさは静かに二人の関係を変えていく。言葉にならない感情が、ゆっくりと滲み出していく。
tmdb_overview_en: Teenage siblings Nenette and Boni were raised apart as a result of their parents' divorce. Their mother, who doted on her son Boni, has died. He works for an interesting couple as a pizza baker, and is surprised and enraged when his younger sister, having run away from boarding school, suddenly turns up. There's a problem that they must confront.
synopsis_en: In the port city of Marseille in southern France. Young Boni works at a pizzeria, spending his days belonging nowhere. One day, his long-estranged younger sister Nenette suddenly appears and crashes at his place. Having nowhere to go, Nenette carries a secret: she is pregnant. But she never reveals this fact to Boni. In their awkward cohabitation, the two spend time maintaining a distance they cannot cross. Boni develops feelings for a woman who works at a bakery, but cannot turn those feelings into reality. Nenette confronts her own body and tries to choose her future. In a cruel world, desire and tenderness quietly transform their relationship. Unspoken emotions slowly seep through.

synopsis: 舞台はベルギーの港町オステンドのホテル。宿泊しに来た新婚のステファンとヴァレリーはどこかぎこちない。ホテルの滞在客はこの二人だけだったが、そこに謎めいた優雅な伯爵夫人エリザベート・バートリーと秘書イローナがやってくる。エリザベートは新婚夫婦に接近し、禁断の世界へと引き込んでいく。彼女は一体何者なのか? 何が狙いなのか…?
tmdb_overview_jp: ベルギー、オステンド。海辺の退廃的なホテルで、新婚のステファンとヴァレリーは、謎めいたバートリー伯爵夫人とその秘書イロナに出会う。
tmdb_overview_en: Ostend, Belgium. In a decadent seaside hotel, Stefan and Valerie, a newlywed couple, meet the mysterious Countess Báthory and Ilona, her secretary.
synopsis_en: The setting is a hotel in the Belgian port town of Ostend. Newlyweds Stefan and Valerie, who have come to stay, seem somewhat awkward together. The two are the hotel's only guests—until the mysterious and elegant Countess Elizabeth Bathory and her secretary Ilona arrive. Elizabeth draws close to the newlywed couple and leads them into a forbidden world. Who is she really? What is her aim...?

synopsis: かいせつ ヤクザの家業を継がずに銀行マンになったトオル(仲村)は、仕事も恋も順風満帆だったが、やがて思いもしない抗争に巻き込まれてしまう―。小林信彦の短編を森田が大胆に脚色し映画化した、一風変わったヤクザ映画。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Despite his efforts of living a normal life as a banker, the life of Toru, the only son of the Yubari Family, becomes disrupted by trouble brought on by his father. When his father’s battle against his rival group the Miike Family ignites, Toru becomes more involved in the turf war than he wished for.
synopsis_en: Toru (Nakamura), who became a bank employee instead of inheriting the family yakuza business, had everything going well in both work and love, but eventually gets caught up in an unexpected gang war. A quirky yakuza film adapted for the screen by Morita, who boldly reworked Kobayashi Nobuhiko's short story.

synopsis: かいせつ 「ヤングジャンプ」に連載された人気漫画を、人気絶頂のアイドル二人の主演で映画化。革ジャンが似合うイカした美人教師・エリーと男子生徒との、禁断の恋の駆け引きを描く。80年代の大人びた若者達の、今見ると驚きの習性も見所。
program_title: 80年代ノスタルジアⅢ
tmdb_overview_en: Based on the comic by Mako Takami.
synopsis_en: A film adaptation of the popular manga serialized in "Young Jump," starring two idols at the peak of their popularity. It depicts the forbidden love game between a cool, beautiful teacher named Ellie who looks great in a leather jacket and a male student. The surprisingly mature habits of 80s youth, which are shocking when viewed today, are also a highlight.

synopsis: かいせつ 日本アニメ界の巨匠が手掛けた伝説の劇場版。「ウチは日本一不幸な少女や！」―大阪・通天閣近くの商店街で、ろくでなしの父親に代わってホルモン焼き屋を切り盛りする浪花っ子・チエちゃんの奇抜な日常を描いた人情喜劇の傑作。

tmdb_overview_jp: バクチ好きの父親、テツに代わり自宅のホルモン屋を切り盛りしている逞しい大阪の女子小学生の竹本チエ。そんなチエは時々テツと別居中の母ヨシ江と父に秘密で会っており縁日での休みを満喫するが、その現場をテツに見られてしまい…。
tmdb_overview_en: Chie Takemoto is a dependable girl who struggles to help her troublesome father run a small tavern in Osaka. Unbeknown to her dad, she occasionally visits her mother who left him not too long ago. She plans on trying to reunite them, but not until her father gets a job.

"I'm the unluckiest girl in Japan!" — A masterpiece of heartwarming comedy depicting the eccentric daily life of Chie-chan, a Naniwa girl who runs a horumon grill shop in place of her good-for-nothing father in a shopping street near Tsutenkaku in Osaka.

synopsis: かいせつ 『塀の中の懲りない面々』の脚本を手掛けた鈴木が監督した、原作続編の映画化。休憩中のソフトボールが生き甲斐の受刑者たちが、刑務所内でかつて行われた伝説の看守との対抗試合を夢見るが・・・。受刑者役の顔ぶれが個性的！

Inmates whose sole purpose in life is playing softball during breaks dream of a legendary match against the guards that once took place in the prison... The cast of inmates is wonderfully unique!

director: セドリック・クラピッシュ
country: フランス 原題または英題：La Venue de l'avenir
synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.
