synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

synopsis: かいせつ 鏡花原作の二度目の映画化。大正期の花柳界で張り合う二人の芸者の哀しき愛の物語。鏡花の妖美な世界を、市川崑が絢爛たる色彩美で描く。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Ichikawa's 1956 adaptation of Nihonbashi was the first to take the work of Kyoka Izumi—  until then regarded as a writer of common tragic melodramas—and re-evaluate it as a tanbi-ha work of decadence, aestheticism, and intrigue. Ichikawa's film presents the tragic plot of the young geisha who is unable to enact her love for a man publicly in any way other than a histrionic story of torment, a heart-rending tale of lovers being crushed by fate. Instead, Ichikawa shows the contest of wills that transpires as two geisha, Oko and Kiyoha fight for the top spot in Nihonbashi, the pinnacle of the Tokyo geisha world. Nihonbashi is an elegant, if steely, exposition of manners. The young doctor, Shinzo Katsuragi, is the object of affection for both women, but appears to be more the choice reward for the plotting and thieving of these two early modern superwomen, than a lover they swoon over.
synopsis_en: The second film adaptation of an Izumi Kyoka original. A tale of tragic love between two geisha competing in the licensed quarters of the Taisho era. Ichikawa Kon depicts Kyoka's bewitching world with resplendent chromatic beauty.

synopsis_en: A young falconer wanders into the keep of Himeji Castle, where a woman from the demon realm resides... Tamasaburo, who performed this Izumi Kyoka play on stage, directs and stars in this fantastical period drama film adaptation.

synopsis: かいせつ 鏡花の悲恋ものを名脚本家・依田が脚色し、京・森の名コンビ主演で映画化した、名作と名高い野淵版。旅回りの女水芸師の一途な恋を描く。

synopsis: 「ノー・アザー・ランド　故郷は他にない」の監督を務めたイスラエル人ジャーナリストのユバル・アブラハームとラヘル・ショールが、パレスチナ・ガザ地区における民間人虐殺の真相に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 2023年10月7日のハマスによる襲撃をきっかけにイスラエル軍が開始したガザへの攻撃で、犠牲者は7万3000人以上にのぼるが、その大半は民間人だ。イスラエル軍は表向きには「民間人の犠牲は最小限に努めている」と主張するが、実際には民間人に被害が及ぶことを組織的に承認したうえで大規模攻撃を遂行していた。アブラハーム監督とショール監督は、夜のテルアビブのとある建物の屋上で、イスラエル軍の兵士や諜報員24人に極秘インタビューを実施し、ガザでの民間人殺害について「どのような指令を受けたのか」「何をしたのか」という証言を引き出していく。それぞれの言葉から浮かび上がったのは、イスラエル国家が組織的に作り上げた「虐殺を可能にするシステム」だった。 タイトルの「NAZA」は、イスラエル軍が標的であるハマス構成員を攻撃する際に、その巻き添えで犠牲になると予測される民間人の数を表す軍事用語。製作総指揮には「関心領域」のジョナサン・グレイザー監督が名を連ねた。2026年・第83回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門で審査員特別賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_jp: 夜のテルアビブ、とある建物の屋上でイスラエル人ジャーナリストのユヴァル・アブラハームとラヘル・ショールは、イスラエル軍の兵士と諜報員24名に極秘インタビューを行った。ガザでの民間人殺害について、どのような指令を受けたのか。何をしたのか。ある者はデジタル化された遠隔攻撃を「事務作業のようなものだ」と語り、ある者は「食糧配給所に人が集まったところを撃った」と証言する。ひとりひとりの言葉から浮かび上がるのは、イスラエル国家が組織的に作り上げた、人間を人間としてみなさない＜虐殺を可能にするシステム＞だった。
tmdb_overview_en: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
director_jp: ユヴァル・アブラハム
synopsis_en: On a rooftop of a building in Tel Aviv at night, Israeli journalists Yuval Abraham and Rachel Shor conducted a secret interview with 24 Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers. What orders were they given regarding the killing of civilians in Gaza? What did they do? One speaks of digitized remote attacks as "like office work," while another testifies, "We shot at people gathered at a food distribution point." What emerges from each person's words is a "system that enables massacre"—one that treats human beings as less than human—systematically constructed by the Israeli state.

synopsis: 「スパニッシュ・アパートメント」「ダンサー イン Paris」のセドリック・クラピッシュ監督が、ある家族に遺された古い屋敷と1枚の絵画をめぐる謎を、現代と19世紀ベル・エポックというふたつの時代を交差させて描いたドラマ。 ノルマンディーの草原に佇む古い屋敷。100年以上にわたり閉ざされていたその屋敷の相続権を持つのは、互いに面識のない30人以上の一族だった。土地開発のため屋敷を売るよう迫られ、一族を代表して屋敷の調査をすることになったセブ、アブデル、セリーヌ、ギイの親戚4人は、そこで印象派の作品らしき絵画と、先祖アデルの手紙や写真を見つける。19世紀にノルマンディーからパリへと旅をし、ベル・エポックの時代を生きた女性アデル。彼女と絵画にまつわる家族の秘密が解き明かされたとき、それぞれの人生に新たな扉が開かれる。 劇中には印象派の巨匠モネをはじめ、ルノワール、セザンヌら実在した芸術家たちが次々と登場。カルティエのCM撮影でクラピッシュ監督に見いだされたアブラム・バプレが現代パートの主人公セブ、「スザンヌ、16歳」のスザンヌ・ランドンが過去パートの主人公アデルを演じ、バンサン・マケーニュ、ポール・キルシェ、セシル・ドゥ・フランス、オリビエ・グルメら豪華キャストが脇を固めた。
tmdb_overview_en: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.
director_jp: セドリック・クラピッシュ
synopsis_en: A drama by Cédric Klapisch, director of 'The Spanish Apartment' and 'Dancer in Paris,' depicting a mystery surrounding an old mansion and a single painting left to a family, interweaving two eras: the present day and the 19th-century Belle Époque. An old mansion stands on the plains of Normandy. More than 30 family members who have never met each other hold inheritance rights to the mansion, which had been closed for over 100 years. Pressured to sell the mansion for land development, four relatives—Seb, Abdel, Céline, and Guy—are chosen to represent the family and investigate the mansion, where they find what appears to be an Impressionist painting, along with letters and photographs belonging to their ancestor Adèle. Adèle was a woman who traveled from Normandy to Paris in the 19th century and lived during the Belle Époque. When the family secret surrounding her and the painting is revealed, new doors open in each of their lives. The film features real-life artists such as Impressionist masters Monet, Renoir, and Cézanne appearing one after another. Abram Baple, discovered by Klapisch during a Cartier commercial shoot, plays present-day protagonist Seb, while Suzanne Lindon of 'Suzanne, 16' plays past-era protagonist Adèle, with a stellar supporting cast including Vincent Macaigne, Paul Kircher, Cécile de France, and Olivier Gourmet.

tmdb_overview_jp: 年老いた父と息子の交流を通して、家族の絆を描くドラマ。エグゼクティヴ・プロデューサーはスティーヴン・スピルバーグとフランク・マーシャル、キャスリーン・ケネディ。ウィリアム・ワートンの原作を基に、製作・監督・脚本はゲイリー・デイヴィッド・ゴールドバーグ、共同製作はジョゼフ・スターン、撮影はジャン・キーサー、音楽はジェームズ・ボーナーが担当。出演はジャック・レモン、テッド・ダンソンほか。
tmdb_overview_en: A busy executive learns during a meeting that his mother may be dying and rushes home to her side. He ends up being his father's caretaker and becomes closer to him than ever before. Estranged from his own son, the executive comes to realize what has been missing in his own life.
director_jp: ゲイリー・デヴィッド・ゴールドバーグ
synopsis_en: A drama depicting family bonds through the interaction between an aging father and his son. Executive producers are Steven Spielberg, Frank Marshall, and Kathleen Kennedy. Based on the novel by William Wharton, produced, directed, and written by Gary David Goldberg, co-produced by Joseph Stern, cinematography by Jan Kiesser, and music by James Horner. Starring Jack Lemmon, Ted Danson, and others.

tmdb_overview_jp: 夜のテルアビブ、とある建物の屋上でイスラエル人ジャーナリストのユヴァル・アブラハームとラヘル・ショールは、イスラエル軍の兵士と諜報員24名に極秘インタビューを行った。ガザでの民間人殺害について、どのような指令を受けたのか。何をしたのか。ある者はデジタル化された遠隔攻撃を「事務作業のようなものだ」と語り、ある者は「食糧配給所に人が集まったところを撃った」と証言する。ひとりひとりの言葉から浮かび上がるのは、イスラエル国家が組織的に作り上げた、人間を人間としてみなさない＜虐殺を可能にするシステム＞だった。
tmdb_overview_en: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
director_jp: ユヴァル・アブラハム
synopsis_en: On a rooftop of a building in Tel Aviv at night, Israeli journalists Yuval Abraham and Rachel Shor conducted a secret interview with 24 Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers. What orders were they given regarding the killing of civilians in Gaza? What did they do? One speaks of digitized remote attacks as "like office work," while another testifies, "We shot at people gathered at a food distribution point." What emerges from each person's words is a "system that enables massacre"—one that treats human beings as less than human—systematically constructed by the Israeli state.

synopsis: ギャンブル好きだが心を入れ替えて人生をやり直そうとしている男が、ある日、怪しい老人から「明日の夕刊」を買ったことをきっかけにして起こる悲劇を描いたミステリー。谷譲次、林不忘などジャンルごとに異なったペンネームを持つマルチ作家・牧逸馬の怪奇小説を木村が都会的なタッチで映画化している。
synopsis_en: A mystery depicting the tragedy that unfolds after a man who loves gambling but is trying to reform his life one day buys a 'tomorrow's evening edition' from a suspicious old man. Kimura adapts a bizarre tale by Boku Issa—a versatile author who wrote under different pen names for different genres, including Joji Tani and Fumio Hayashi—with an urban touch.

synopsis: 再開発のため立ち退きを迫られ、ほとんど誰もいなくなった新宿の一角に佇む商業ビルで、抵抗し居座り続ける彦六（徳川）。家族や愛人、階下の住人たちそれぞれの思惑が交錯し、土地ブローカーのいやがらせで暴動へと発展するなか、行方知れずだった息子・彦一（丸山）が戻ってくるが…。明け方の開放感と、美術・久保一雄による見事な夜の室内セットとの対比も見どころ。後の『からゆきさん』へと結実していく、社会の周縁に生きる人々やその共同生活のあり方を見つめる視点は、本作においても印象的である。
tmdb_overview_en: Hikoroku Laughs a lot
synopsis_en: In a corner of Shinjuku nearly emptied of people due to redevelopment, Hikoroku (Tokugawa) stands firm and refuses to leave a commercial building slated for demolition. The agendas of his family, mistress, and the tenants downstairs all intersect, and when a land broker's harassment escalates into a riot, his missing son Hikoichi (Maruyama) returns—but... The contrast between the sense of liberation at dawn and the magnificent nighttime interior set by art director Kazuo Kubo is also a highlight. The perspective of observing people living on the margins of society and their communal way of life—which would later come to fruition in Karayuki-san—is equally striking in this work.

synopsis: かいせつ 谷崎の未完の伝奇ものを巨匠・八住が脚色した浪漫活劇。室町時代の瀬戸内海を舞台に、絶世の美女を巡る騒乱を描く。八千草の麗しさが眼福。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Period romantic drama.
synopsis_en: A romantic adventure film adapted by master filmmaker Yazumi from Tanizaki's unfinished tale of the bizarre. Set in the Seto Inland Sea during the Muromachi period, it depicts the turmoil surrounding a woman of peerless beauty. Yachigusa's loveliness is a feast for the eyes.

movie_title_en: The House of the Sleeping Virgins
synopsis: かいせつ 老人たちが足繁く通う秘密の館。ベッドには決して目を覚まさない全裸の少女が横たわっていた―。川端が晩年に発表した異色の官能サスペンス。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: About an establishment where old men pay to sleep besides young girls that had been narcotized and happen to be naked, the sleeping beauties. The old men are expected to take sleeping pills and share the bed for a whole night with a girl without attempting anything of bad taste like putting a finger inside their mouths.
synopsis_en: A secret mansion frequented by old men. On the bed lay a completely naked girl who would never awaken—. An unconventional sensual suspense story published by Kawabata in his later years.

synopsis: かいせつ 鏡花の悲恋ものを名脚本家・依田が脚色し、京・森の名コンビ主演で映画化した、名作と名高い野淵版。旅回りの女水芸師の一途な恋を描く。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
synopsis_en: Screenwriter Yoda adapted Kyoka's tragic love story, starring the famed duo of Utaemon and Mori, in this Nobuchi version celebrated as a masterpiece. It depicts the devoted love of a traveling female water acrobat.

synopsis: かいせつ 鏡花原作の二度目の映画化。大正期の花柳界で張り合う二人の芸者の哀しき愛の物語。鏡花の妖美な世界を、市川崑が絢爛たる色彩美で描く。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Ichikawa's 1956 adaptation of Nihonbashi was the first to take the work of Kyoka Izumi—  until then regarded as a writer of common tragic melodramas—and re-evaluate it as a tanbi-ha work of decadence, aestheticism, and intrigue. Ichikawa's film presents the tragic plot of the young geisha who is unable to enact her love for a man publicly in any way other than a histrionic story of torment, a heart-rending tale of lovers being crushed by fate. Instead, Ichikawa shows the contest of wills that transpires as two geisha, Oko and Kiyoha fight for the top spot in Nihonbashi, the pinnacle of the Tokyo geisha world. Nihonbashi is an elegant, if steely, exposition of manners. The young doctor, Shinzo Katsuragi, is the object of affection for both women, but appears to be more the choice reward for the plotting and thieving of these two early modern superwomen, than a lover they swoon over.
synopsis_en: The second film adaptation of an Izumi Kyoka original. A tale of tragic love between two geisha competing in the licensed quarters of the Taisho era. Ichikawa Kon depicts Kyoka's bewitching world with resplendent chromatic beauty.

movie_title: リンカ リンカ あの夏の先
tmdb_overview_en: Samgyi returns to Lhasa to shoot a film about her childhood. Struggling with creative uncertainty, she finds herself in an endless cycle of arguments with her father. At a chance party, she meets Lhamo, the girl who inspired the character in her story. As the night quietly slips away, the summer that once lingered in fragments of memory gradually comes into full view...
clean_title_jp: リンカ リンカ〜あの夏の先
movie_title_jp: リンカ リンカ〜あの夏の先
synopsis_en: A drama by young Tibetan female director Khandroon, inspired by memories of her own childhood summers. Samkyi, a young woman aspiring to be a filmmaker, decides to make a film about her memories of Lhamo, a childhood friend from whom she has grown apart. Returning to her hometown in Tibet, which she left to attend middle school, she reunites with her father after a long time. As filming progresses, an adult Lhamo appears before Samkyi, but Samkyi realizes Lhamo's memories differ from her own. Through the bold structure of a meta-cinema, where a film is being made within the film, and a simple narrative style, the truth emerging from the space between reality and fiction is brought to light, while realistically portraying the youth of Lhasa, the Tibetan city that is also director Khandroon's hometown. "Linka" in the title is a Tibetan word meaning summer picnic or garden. The film won both the Best Film Award and the International Federation of Film Critics Award at the Hong Kong International Film Festival's Young Cinema Competition, considered a gateway for young Asian directors. It was screened under the title "One Night, Three Summers" in the "Asia's Future" section of the 38th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2025.

movie_title: 新選組［トーキー連鎖劇版］／海軍爆擊隊
synopsis: 1931年創立の劇団前進座は、やがて映画にも進出。34年には久保栄の「新選組」を連鎖劇として企画するが実現しなかった。その後、日活やP.C.L.とも提携して次々と傑作を送り出す中で、第9作となるのが映画『新選組』（1937）だが、並行して企画されたのが新橋演舞場での連鎖劇「新選組」上演である。当館が2004年に受贈した前進座旧蔵の連鎖劇用・可燃性ポジから同年に不燃化したプリントを上映する。演舞場での公開以来、戦後初上映となる。
synopsis_en: The theater troupe Zenshinza, founded in 1931, eventually expanded into film. In 1934, they planned a chain drama adaptation of Sakae Kubo's Shinsengumi, but it was never realized. Later, while partnering with Nikkatsu and P.C.L. to produce a string of masterpieces, their ninth film was Shinsengumi (1937), and planned in parallel was a chain drama performance of Shinsengumi at the Shimbashi Embujo. This screening presents a print made in 2004 from flammable positive film for chain drama use that had been donated to the museum in 2004 from Zenshinza's former collection, which was converted to non-flammable stock that same year. It is the first public screening since its original run at the Embujo.
movie_title_jp: 新選組［トーキー連鎖劇版］／海軍爆擊隊

synopsis: 中国戦線で軍医から故郷の牧場を託された3人は、閉鎖を企む高利貸しから牧場を守ろうと従業員一同と奮闘する。国家総動員法成立と同年の公開で、銃後の意識の啓発を企図して製作された。生産の場を働く者たちの共同体として捉え、資本の脅威に対抗するさまが、社会主義的とも評された『麦秋』（キング・ヴィダー、1934）も彷彿とさせ興味深い。本作でデビューの江波和子は、高利貸しの社長令嬢であるヒロインを演じている。
synopsis_en: Three men entrusted with their hometown ranch by an army doctor on the China front struggle alongside all the employees to protect the ranch from a moneylender plotting to shut it down. Released in the same year the National Mobilization Law was enacted, it was produced with the intent of raising home-front awareness. It is fascinating how the production site is conceived as a community of workers resisting the threat of capital, evoking King Vidor's Our Daily Bread (1934), which was also described as socialist. Kazuko Enami, making her debut in this film, plays the heroine, the daughter of the moneylender company's president.

synopsis: かいせつ 谷崎の未完の伝奇ものを巨匠・八住が脚色した浪漫活劇。室町時代の瀬戸内海を舞台に、絶世の美女を巡る騒乱を描く。八千草の麗しさが眼福。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Period romantic drama.
synopsis_en: A romantic adventure film adapted by master filmmaker Yazumi from Tanizaki's unfinished tale of the bizarre. Set in the Seto Inland Sea during the Muromachi period, it depicts the turmoil surrounding a woman of peerless beauty. Yachigusa's loveliness is a feast for the eyes.

synopsis: かいせつ 鏡花原作の二度目の映画化。大正期の花柳界で張り合う二人の芸者の哀しき愛の物語。鏡花の妖美な世界を、市川崑が絢爛たる色彩美で描く。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: Ichikawa's 1956 adaptation of Nihonbashi was the first to take the work of Kyoka Izumi—  until then regarded as a writer of common tragic melodramas—and re-evaluate it as a tanbi-ha work of decadence, aestheticism, and intrigue. Ichikawa's film presents the tragic plot of the young geisha who is unable to enact her love for a man publicly in any way other than a histrionic story of torment, a heart-rending tale of lovers being crushed by fate. Instead, Ichikawa shows the contest of wills that transpires as two geisha, Oko and Kiyoha fight for the top spot in Nihonbashi, the pinnacle of the Tokyo geisha world. Nihonbashi is an elegant, if steely, exposition of manners. The young doctor, Shinzo Katsuragi, is the object of affection for both women, but appears to be more the choice reward for the plotting and thieving of these two early modern superwomen, than a lover they swoon over.
synopsis_en: The second film adaptation of an Izumi Kyoka original. A tale of tragic love between two geisha competing in the licensed quarters of the Taisho era. Ichikawa Kon depicts Kyoka's bewitching world with resplendent chromatic beauty.

movie_title_en: The House of the Sleeping Virgins
synopsis: かいせつ 老人たちが足繁く通う秘密の館。ベッドには決して目を覚まさない全裸の少女が横たわっていた―。川端が晩年に発表した異色の官能サスペンス。
program_title: 泉鏡花と幻想・耽美の文芸映画
tmdb_overview_en: About an establishment where old men pay to sleep besides young girls that had been narcotized and happen to be naked, the sleeping beauties. The old men are expected to take sleeping pills and share the bed for a whole night with a girl without attempting anything of bad taste like putting a finger inside their mouths.
synopsis_en: A secret mansion frequented by old men. On the bed lay a completely naked girl who would never awaken—. An unconventional sensual suspense story published by Kawabata in his later years.

movie_title: リンカ リンカ あの夏の先
tmdb_overview_en: Samgyi returns to Lhasa to shoot a film about her childhood. Struggling with creative uncertainty, she finds herself in an endless cycle of arguments with her father. At a chance party, she meets Lhamo, the girl who inspired the character in her story. As the night quietly slips away, the summer that once lingered in fragments of memory gradually comes into full view...
clean_title_jp: リンカ リンカ〜あの夏の先
movie_title_jp: リンカ リンカ〜あの夏の先
synopsis_en: A drama by young Tibetan female director Khandroon, inspired by memories of her own childhood summers. Samkyi, a young woman aspiring to be a filmmaker, decides to make a film about her memories of Lhamo, a childhood friend from whom she has grown apart. Returning to her hometown in Tibet, which she left to attend middle school, she reunites with her father after a long time. As filming progresses, an adult Lhamo appears before Samkyi, but Samkyi realizes Lhamo's memories differ from her own. Through the bold structure of a meta-cinema, where a film is being made within the film, and a simple narrative style, the truth emerging from the space between reality and fiction is brought to light, while realistically portraying the youth of Lhasa, the Tibetan city that is also director Khandroon's hometown. "Linka" in the title is a Tibetan word meaning summer picnic or garden. The film won both the Best Film Award and the International Federation of Film Critics Award at the Hong Kong International Film Festival's Young Cinema Competition, considered a gateway for young Asian directors. It was screened under the title "One Night, Three Summers" in the "Asia's Future" section of the 38th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2025.

country: イギリス・アメリカ合作 原題または英題：Naza
synopsis: 「ノー・アザー・ランド　故郷は他にない」の監督を務めたイスラエル人ジャーナリストのユバル・アブラハームとラヘル・ショールが、パレスチナ・ガザ地区における民間人虐殺の真相に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 2023年10月7日のハマスによる襲撃をきっかけにイスラエル軍が開始したガザへの攻撃で、犠牲者は7万3000人以上にのぼるが、その大半は民間人だ。イスラエル軍は表向きには「民間人の犠牲は最小限に努めている」と主張するが、実際には民間人に被害が及ぶことを組織的に承認したうえで大規模攻撃を遂行していた。アブラハーム監督とショール監督は、夜のテルアビブのとある建物の屋上で、イスラエル軍の兵士や諜報員24人に極秘インタビューを実施し、ガザでの民間人殺害について「どのような指令を受けたのか」「何をしたのか」という証言を引き出していく。それぞれの言葉から浮かび上がったのは、イスラエル国家が組織的に作り上げた「虐殺を可能にするシステム」だった。 タイトルの「NAZA」は、イスラエル軍が標的であるハマス構成員を攻撃する際に、その巻き添えで犠牲になると予測される民間人の数を表す軍事用語。製作総指揮には「関心領域」のジョナサン・グレイザー監督が名を連ねた。2026年・第83回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門で審査員特別賞を受賞。
tmdb_overview_jp: 夜のテルアビブ、とある建物の屋上でイスラエル人ジャーナリストのユヴァル・アブラハームとラヘル・ショールは、イスラエル軍の兵士と諜報員24名に極秘インタビューを行った。ガザでの民間人殺害について、どのような指令を受けたのか。何をしたのか。ある者はデジタル化された遠隔攻撃を「事務作業のようなものだ」と語り、ある者は「食糧配給所に人が集まったところを撃った」と証言する。ひとりひとりの言葉から浮かび上がるのは、イスラエル国家が組織的に作り上げた、人間を人間としてみなさない＜虐殺を可能にするシステム＞だった。
tmdb_overview_en: Filmed at night from Tel Aviv rooftops, this investigative documentary examines the civilian casualties of Israel's military operations in Gaza and the systems behind targeted killings of Palestinians.
director_jp: ユヴァル・アブラハム
synopsis_en: On a rooftop of a building in Tel Aviv at night, Israeli journalists Yuval Abraham and Rachel Shor conducted a secret interview with 24 Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers. What orders were they given regarding the killing of civilians in Gaza? What did they do? One speaks of digitized remote attacks as "like office work," while another testifies, "We shot at people gathered at a food distribution point." What emerges from each person's words is a "system that enables massacre"—one that treats human beings as less than human—systematically constructed by the Israeli state.

synopsis: ロシアの民話にもとづく俳優座の児童演劇（初演は1954年）を映画化した木村荘十二の戦後第1作。コニカラー・システムによる色彩の美しさは当時の批評でも絶賛された。現存するコニカラー・プリントは後半部分のみであるため、オリジナル（62分）に近い尺の白黒16mmプリントを併せて上映する。
synopsis_en: Soji Kimura's first postwar film, a cinematic adaptation of a children's play (premiered in 1954) by the Haiyuza theater company based on a Russian folk tale. The beauty of its colors, achieved through the Konica Color system, was highly praised by critics of the time. Since the surviving Konica Color print consists of only the latter half, it is screened together with a black-and-white 16mm print of nearly the original length (62 minutes).
movie_title_jp: 森は生きている［白黒版］／森は生きている

synopsis: 爆心地に近接していたことから甚大な被害を受けた長崎の城山小学校を舞台に、原爆で母親を失った3人の少年少女の友情を描く。現地の子どもたちを取材し、その生活風景から物語を着想する方法は、以後、木村の児童映画制作の根幹をなすこととなる。
synopsis_en: Set at Shiroyama Elementary School in Nagasaki, which suffered devastating damage due to its proximity to the hypocenter, this film depicts the friendship of three boys and girls who lost their mothers to the atomic bomb. The method of interviewing local children and drawing inspiration for the story from scenes of their daily lives would thereafter form the foundation of Kimura's children's filmmaking.

synopsis: かいせつ 書生・主税と芸者・お蔦の身分違いの悲恋を簡潔かつ情感豊かに描いた名作。雷蔵と名匠・三隅の名コンビによる鏡花原作の五度目の映画化。

synopsis_en: On a rooftop of a building in Tel Aviv at night, Israeli journalists Yuval Abraham and Rachel Shor conducted a secret interview with 24 Israeli soldiers and intelligence officers. What orders were they given regarding the killing of civilians in Gaza? What did they do? One speaks of digitized remote attacks as "like office work," while another testifies, "We shot at people gathered at a food distribution point." What emerges from each person's words is a "system that enables massacre"—one that treats human beings as less than human—systematically constructed by the Israeli state.

synopsis: 貨物船埼玉丸は3か月の遠洋航海を終え、荷を降ろすため帰国の途にあった。海員たちは家族や恋人に電報でそのことを伝える。しかし彼らはわずか2日後にはまた別の地に向かわねばならない。各々が過ごす限られた時間の悲喜こもごものドラマ。木村は半年にわたり海員たちと生活を共にして取材、海で働く男たちの日常を誇張することなく描きつつ、帰国を待つ女性たちの心情も入念に描き込んでいる。海員のなかに大映で俳優デビュー前の伊丹十三の姿を確認できる。
tmdb_overview_jp: ロックバンド「TUBE」のミュージックビデオをもとに製作された作品。2015年、デビュー30年のアニバーサリーイヤーを迎えたTUBEは、春夏秋冬で4枚のシングルを発売。その4作品のミュージックビデオを再編集し、一編にまとめた。2015年と30年前の1985年という2つの時代を背景に、2組の恋人たちの物語が描かれた。「TUBE 31 LIVE SCREEN 映画『渚の恋人たち』＆2015 LIVE at 武道館」と題し、15年6月1日に日本武道館で行われたTUBEのバースデーライブを収録した映像とともに、16年1月31日に一夜限定で上映された。
synopsis_en: The cargo ship Saitama Maru, having completed a three-month ocean voyage, was on its way home to unload its cargo. The sailors send telegrams to their families and lovers to let them know. But just two days later, they must set off again for another destination. This is a drama of the joys and sorrows each man experiences in his limited time ashore. Kimura spent six months living alongside sailors to research the film, depicting the daily lives of men who work at sea without exaggeration while also carefully portraying the feelings of the women waiting for their return. Among the sailors, one can spot Juzo Itami before his acting debut at Daiei.

movie_title: 愛することと生きること／末っ子大将
synopsis: 1957年に売春防止法が施行されたが、依然として対策が必要であるとの認識から、一般の理解と協力をより深めるべく製作された啓蒙映画。若い坑夫の実（左右田）と東京に出てきたものの街娼に身を落としていたたか子（小沢）は、ドヤ街の一室で自殺を図ったところを間一髪で救われる。やがて、婦人相談員の峰岸（平松）や民生委員の協力を得ながら、たか子は新たな人生へと一歩ずつ前進する。
synopsis_en: Produced as an educational film to deepen public understanding and cooperation, recognizing that measures were still needed even after the Anti-Prostitution Act took effect in 1957. A young miner named Minoru (Soda) and Takako (Ozawa), who came to Tokyo but fell into street prostitution, attempt suicide in a room in a flophouse district and are saved at the last moment. Eventually, with the help of a women's counselor named Minegishi (Hiramatsu) and a welfare commissioner, Takako takes one step at a time toward a new life.
movie_title_jp: 愛することと生きること／末っ子大将

movie_title_jp: リンカ リンカ〜あの夏の先
synopsis_en: A drama by young Tibetan female director Khandroon, inspired by memories of her own childhood summers. Samkyi, a young woman aspiring to be a filmmaker, decides to make a film about her memories of Lhamo, a childhood friend from whom she has grown apart. Returning to her hometown in Tibet, which she left to attend middle school, she reunites with her father after a long time. As filming progresses, an adult Lhamo appears before Samkyi, but Samkyi realizes Lhamo's memories differ from her own. Through the bold structure of a meta-cinema, where a film is being made within the film, and a simple narrative style, the truth emerging from the space between reality and fiction is brought to light, while realistically portraying the youth of Lhasa, the Tibetan city that is also director Khandroon's hometown. "Linka" in the title is a Tibetan word meaning summer picnic or garden. The film won both the Best Film Award and the International Federation of Film Critics Award at the Hong Kong International Film Festival's Young Cinema Competition, considered a gateway for young Asian directors. It was screened under the title "One Night, Three Summers" in the "Asia's Future" section of the 38th Tokyo International Film Festival in 2025.

synopsis: 「ノー・アザー・ランド　故郷は他にない」の監督を務めたイスラエル人ジャーナリストのユバル・アブラハームとラヘル・ショールが、パレスチナ・ガザ地区における民間人虐殺の真相に迫ったドキュメンタリー。 2023年10月7日のハマスによる襲撃をきっかけにイスラエル軍が開始したガザへの攻撃で、犠牲者は7万3000人以上にのぼるが、その大半は民間人だ。イスラエル軍は表向きには「民間人の犠牲は最小限に努めている」と主張するが、実際には民間人に被害が及ぶことを組織的に承認したうえで大規模攻撃を遂行していた。アブラハーム監督とショール監督は、夜のテルアビブのとある建物の屋上で、イスラエル軍の兵士や諜報員24人に極秘インタビューを実施し、ガザでの民間人殺害について「どのような指令を受けたのか」「何をしたのか」という証言を引き出していく。それぞれの言葉から浮かび上がったのは、イスラエル国家が組織的に作り上げた「虐殺を可能にするシステム」だった。 タイトルの「NAZA」は、イスラエル軍が標的であるハマス構成員を攻撃する際に、その巻き添えで犠牲になると予測される民間人の数を表す軍事用語。製作総指揮には「関心領域」のジョナサン・グレイザー監督が名を連ねた。2026年・第83回ベネチア国際映画祭コンペティション部門で審査員特別賞を受賞。

movie_title: 自然のしくみ ―ノミはなぜはねる― 他
synopsis: 人や動物に寄生するノミやツツガムシ、ダニなどは、なぜ巧みに宿主を見つけ出せるのか。東京大学伝染病研究所の研究成果をもとに、そのメカニズムを実験と観察によって解き明かす科学教育映画。寄生生物が呼気中の炭酸ガスを感知してウヨウヨと活動を始める仕組みを探求し、身近な現象の背後に潜む自然界の秘密に迫る。第5回教育映画コンクール銀賞を受賞。
synopsis_en: Why are fleas, chiggers, ticks, and other parasites of humans and animals able to find their hosts so skillfully? Based on research from the Institute of Infectious Diseases at the University of Tokyo, this science education film unravels the mechanisms through experiments and observation. It explores how parasites sense carbon dioxide in exhaled breath and begin swarming into activity, delving into the secrets of the natural world hidden behind familiar phenomena. It won the Silver Prize at the 5th Educational Film Competition.
movie_title_jp: 自然のしくみ ―ノミはなぜはねる― 他

synopsis: 卒業式を迎えた子どもたちは、仲間と知恵を出し合って学ぶことの喜びを語り、新しい未来へ向けて歩み出す。方言や学力差、家庭環境の違いを乗り越え、教師や保護者とともに成長する姿に、戦後民主教育の理念が息づく。地域に根ざした学校教育の日常を見つめながら、人々の連帯のなかに社会への希望を見出し続けた木村の理想を体現する重要作である。
tmdb_overview_en: 1962 Japanese movie
synopsis_en: The children, having reached their graduation ceremony, speak of the joy of learning by pooling their wisdom with their peers, and set out toward a new future. In their overcoming of differences in dialect, academic ability, and family environment, and in their growth together with teachers and parents, the ideals of postwar democratic education live on. This is an important work that embodies Kimura's ideals—gazing at the everyday reality of community-rooted schooling while continually finding hope for society in people's solidarity.

tmdb_overview_en: Based on renowned Japanese writer Natsume Soseki's same-titled short story collection, Ten Nights of Dreams brings ten fantastical dream sequences to film with great visual and psychological panache. In a village at the foot of Mount Osore in Aomori Prefecture, a young boy, 'I', lives with his mother in an old house after losing his father. The boy's only solace is having an itako (a spirit medium) summon his father's spirit to talk to him.
